Title: Staff Compliance Data Analyst
Description:
Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot, based on 55,000+ reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here).

Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,600+ Qontoers serving over 600,000+ customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

Join us as a Staff Compliance Data Analyst to build the analytics foundations that power Qonto's compliance execution. You'll own a brand-new scope — monitoring KYC/KYB funnels, remediation campaigns, and financial exposure — working cross-functionally with Product, Ops, Risk & Compliance, and Internal Control, under the guidance of Alma, our Lead Data Analyst.

👩‍💻🧑‍💻 As a Data Analyst at Qonto, you will


Build compliance process monitoring from scratch: You'll build and own the data infrastructure that powers compliance monitoring at Qonto — from onboarding funnel analytics to remediation financial exposure — giving product, operations and compliance teams the self-service tools they need to make decisions without waiting on a data request.
Model and transform data with dbt: With the collaboration of Analytics Engineer Team, you'll build end-to-end transformation pipelines from source to consumption layer, keeping metric definitions clean and trusted by non-technical stakeholders.
Turn regulatory questions into self-service assets: You'll partner with Product, Ops, Risk & Compliance, and Internal Control to scope and ship analytical tools
Own the KYC/KYB funnel analytics end-to-end: You'll deliver insights from CS initiation through KYB validation — refusal reasons, document gaps, lead-time distributions — so teams can act on friction fast.
Track remediation campaigns and financial exposure: You'll measure MRR secured, at risk, or lost across active campaigns, with peak intensity in Q4 (budget season) and May-June (reforecast).


🤔 What You Can Expect


A greenfield, strategically critical scope: Qonto is under close regulatory scrutiny — you'll build analytics foundations that matter company-wide, not just for your team.
Senior, cross-functional exposure from day one: Product, Ops, Risk & Compliance, Internal Control — few DA roles give you this breadth of senior stakeholder access at this level.
Real ownership in the Modern Data Stack: You'll build in Omni and dbt with a high degree of autonomy — no legacy to untangle, just foundations to create.
A team where AI is a first-class tool: Unlimited access to AI tools (Claude, Cursor, and more) to evolve how you work, not just output more.


➡️ Your future manager

Your manager will be Alma, our Lead Data Analyst for Ops & Finance. Alma knows exactly what it takes to build an analytics function that actually changes decisions, and she'll push you to do the same.

Alma reports to Erwan, Director of Business Analytics who oversees the entire Analytics function and ensures alignment across teams.

Description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

Role Overview

The FP&A Business Analyst at eBay is a fantastic opportunity to join our world-class team in Berlin. This role plays a pivotal part in driving growth and excellence in information technology. It focuses on performance analysis, revenue forecasting, and turning data insights into actionable strategies that support our ambitious business objectives.

You will be part of a cross-functional, data-driven team. Collaborating with partners across Marketing, Risk, Product, and Engineering will be essential to provide clear insights and scalable solutions. Our team is committed to crafting business strategy, enhancing decision-making, and supporting balanced growth through analytics and planning excellence.

What You'll Accomplish


Monitor business performance by tracking important metrics, analyzing trends, and identifying risks and opportunities
Conduct variance analysis (actuals vs. forecast/plan) and determine actionable corrective measures
Prepare and present regular performance reports and dashboards for leadership
Develop and manage short- and long-term forecasts aligned with business goals, and lead annual, quarterly, and monthly topline planning cycles
Deliver timely, high-quality analyses to address business questions, investigate data discrepancies, and support evolving priorities
Improve data workflows and reporting processes by implementing automation and scalable solutions
Collaborate with partners across Marketing, Risk, Product, and Engineering to align initiatives with broader business objectives
Find opportunities to use modern technologies, including AI and advanced analytics, to improve reporting, efficiency, and decision-making



What You'll Bring


8+ years of experience applying data analytics to solve complex business problems
Strong hands-on expertise in SQL; proficiency in Python preferred; advanced Excel skills required
Experience in forecasting and financial modeling
Demonstred ability to work with large, complex datasets and perform deep-dive analyses to uncover insights and trends
Demonstrated experience presenting to senior leadership groups and collaborating with cross-functional and geographically distributed teams
Experience building automated workflows, data pipelines, and scalable reporting systems
Effective communication skills with the ability to translate analytical findings into clear business insights and recommendations
Ability to operate effectively in a dynamic environment with strong ownership and a structured problem-solving approach
Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business Analytics, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent experience



Additional Information


Candidates who are available to join at short notice will be preferred.

Title: Global Business Analyst (m/f/d)
Description:
Hybrid | Full time | Senior (5+ years)

Sense the Power

Trench Group is a global leader in high-voltage power transmission components and systems. Headquartered in Berlin with over 100 years of experience, the company leads the portfolio of high-voltage power transmission components and systems. With product groups including bushings, coils, and instrument transformers, the company is a system-critical player in the energy transition and sustainable energy future. These intelligent and technologically advanced solutions are used for measurement, protection, and connection within the power grid. We operates globally with more than 2,500 employees across nine factory locations and four regional sales hubs.

Your Mission

As part of our Sales Finance team, you play a key role in creating transparency across global sales performance. You transform complex sales data into meaningful insights for management and actively contribute to improving our reporting landscape.

In this role, you work closely with Finance and Sales teams across HQ, factories, and Sales Hubs worldwide. You support Regional Sales, Key Account Management, and Business Development by providing reliable data, clear analyses, and decision‑ready dashboards.

Your Tasks:


Own Global Sales Reporting: You take end‑to‑end ownership of our Sales Data Cube, ensuring accurate and consistent monthly data flows and acting as the central contact for all global sales reporting topics.
Build Dashboards That Matter: You design and continuously enhance management reports and visualizations using Power BI and Tableau, enabling full transparency on sales performance and trends.
Bridge Sales, Finance & IT: Working at the interface of Sales, Finance, factories, and IT/SAP, you reconcile figures, perform plausibility checks, and ensure all stakeholders operate with one consistent set of numbers.
Drive Pipeline & Partner Reporting: Using Salesforce Reporting, you create pipeline analyses and Business Partner dashboards to support target setting, performance tracking, and management decision‑making.
Shape the Future of Sales Finance: You actively drive digitalization and automation, from implementing new tools (e.g. Offer Management, Contract Revisions) to rethinking how data is collected, processed, and reported globally.



Requirements:


Degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, or a comparable field
Extensive experience in Sales Finance, Controlling, Reporting, or Business Analysis
Strong analytical mindset with the ability to structure and explain complex data
Experience creating management reports and dashboards (Power BI, Tableau)
Confident communicator with senior stakeholders across functions and regions
Fluent in English; German language skills are a plus



We offer:


Growth with Purpose: Join a globally growing energy company with a vision and a bright future in the energy transition
Strong Teams, Big Energy: Work in highly professional, international teams defined by respect, appreciation, and a shared drive to shape the future of energy
Fair Rewards: Competitive pay, monthly vouchers for shopping, well‑being, or personal development, plus subsidized lunch and membership in a corporate benefits program
Personal & Professional Development: Learn and grow in an international environment with hands‑on experience and continuous development opportunities
Modern Working Environment: A modern way of working, 30 days’ vacation, and a tariff agreement combined with contemporary offices, height‑adjustable desks, free fruit & coffee, and regular team events

Description:
Lovehoney Group is the world’s leading sexual wellbeing company, with the mission to elevate pleasure through innovative technologies, a data-driven approach, and foster creative and fresh perspectives on intimacy. We offer exciting brands with innovative, high-quality sex toys, lingerie, and accessories in a streamlined online shopping experience.

At Lovehoney, we employ over 800 passionate and progressive individuals across 11 global offices, each person contributing a unique blend of talents to our diverse workforce. We are proud to be a company that thrives by doing things differently, challenging expectations and stereotypes while making a positive impact on our customers’ lives.

Join us at Lovehoney, where pleasure combines with creativity, data, and innovation!

We are currently looking for a Finance Data & Systems Analyst who will be integral to driving high-level performance across Lovehoney Group. Partnering directly with Finance, FP&A, and Data teams, your focus will be on enabling better decision-making through reliable data, advanced analytics, and digital solutions. In this role, you will combine your understanding of Finance processes with your analytical expertise and ability to drive automation, AI adoption, and continuous improvement across Finance.

What You Will Do

Finance Data & Analytics:


Act as the Finance representative and key business partner for collaboration with the Data team, ensuring Finance requirements are understood and translated into scalable data solutions.
Partner with stakeholders across Finance to identify data needs, improve reporting capabilities, and enable data-driven decision-making.
Develop, maintain, and optimise Finance datasets, reports, and dashboards to provide accurate and actionable insights.
Support data quality, governance, and documentation initiatives to ensure consistency and transparency of Finance data.
As part of the payment processing commercial team, lead the development of KPI dashboards and ensure that insights, drivers and performance trends are communicated to stakeholders regularly.



FP&A Systems / Pigment:


Own the development and maintenance of Pigment models, including understanding and managing infrastructure, data flows, and dimensions.
Manage and prioritize Pigment tickets and improvement requests from the FP&A team, ensuring timely resolution and continuous improvement of the platform.
Support the team in leveraging Pigment capabilities effectively for budgeting, forecasting, reporting, and analysis.
Run regular reporting from Pigment.



Automation & AI:


Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and improve efficiency through data solutions and technology.
Drive the adoption and responsible use of AI within Finance by identifying relevant use cases, supporting implementation, and promoting AI-enabled ways of working.



What You Should Bring

Essential:


Understanding of Finance processes and business performance management.
Experience building and maintaining BI solutions and dashboards.
Experience acting as a bridge between Finance teams and Data/Technology teams.
Strong SQL skills and experience working with data platforms and analytical tools.
Understanding of data flows, data models, and reporting infrastructure.
Experience managing priorities, resolving issues, and supporting users of digital platforms.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
Structured, problem-solving mindset with a continuous improvement approach.



Desirable:


Experience of FP&A and hands-on experience with FP&A systems (such as Pigment, Anaplan, Workday, Vena, etc), including model structure, dimensions, and data integrations.
Experience of working with ERP data would be beneficial.
Interest and experience in applying AI and automation to improve business processes.
Payment processing reporting experience.



What We Can Offer You


A welcoming workplace full of drinks, snacks, friendly faces and fun team-building events.
Access to unique discounts at high street retailers, hotels, and service providers, in addition to a 50% discount on all Lovehoney products to explore and discover new ways to have fun.
Enjoy a hybrid work model that fosters flexibility and work-life balance, with three days per week in-office and the opportunity to work remotely for up to 4 weeks per year, alongside 25 days’ holiday, plus an additional day for each year you are with Lovehoney, providing ample time for relaxation, rejuvenation, and exploration.
Access to customized training opportunities to support your unique learning journey, complemented by biannual feedback cycles, offering valuable insights into your performance and growth areas, enhancing your development within the company.
Recognising the significance of physical and mental health, we proudly provide gym benefits in addition to a mental wellbeing platform, to ensure our employees thrive both professionally and personally.
Stay secure at work and at home with a complimentary 1Password Family account. All Lovehoney Group employees can invite up to five family members to join, offering your household a safe and simple way to manage passwords and sensitive information safely and easily.



Our interview process


CV review
Interview with one of our Talent Acquisition Team Members
Hiring Manager Interview (MS Teams)
Hiring Team Interview, including tasks (onsite)
Leadership Interview (MS Teams)



Lovehoney Group is an equal opportunities employer. We promise that every qualified person will be evaluated according to skills regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

If you require accommodations during the interview process due to a disability, please inform your Talent Acquisition Specialist so that we can ensure a smooth and inclusive experience for all candidates.

At Lovehoney Group, we embrace innovative technologies to enhance our recruitment process. We leverage artificial intelligence during screening interviews for CV reviews and note-taking. We prioritize transparency and respect your preferences, so you'll have the option to opt out of recording and AI-driven note-taking while still receiving full and fair consideration for the role.

We currently have a hybrid work model supporting a blend of in-office and remote work (3 days per week in-office).

If we sparked your interest and you are open to embarking on your professional path with us, please visit our Lovehoney careers page to apply: https://jobs.eu.lever.co/lovehoneygroup

Our privacy policy is available here: https://www.lovehoneygroup.com/privacy-policy/

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Title: Consultant Data Analytics Global Transformation Tax (w/m/d)
Description:
Für unseren Geschäftsbereich Steuerberatung suchen wir dich zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt  als Consultant Data Analytics Global Transformation Tax (w/m/d). Das erwartet dichTeam – Als Teil unseres Global Transformation Tax Teams arbeitest du gemeinsam mit Kolleg:innen aus Tax, Tech und Finance an innovativen End-to-End-Lösungen, die Unternehmen fit für externe regulatorische Anforderungen und die interne Transformation machen.Analyse – Du entwickelst clevere, pragmatische Lösungsansätze zur Strukturierung, Verarbeitung und Validierung von Finanzdaten.Automatisierung – Mit Tools wie der Microsoft Power Platform oder Alteryx entwickelst du smarte Workflows und Prototypen – z. B. für Pillar 2, Tax Control Frameworks oder andere Compliance-Herausforderungen.Visualisierung – Du kreierst interaktive Dashboards und Reports in Power BI, die für die Steuerfunktion und das Management aus Finanzdaten wertvolle Erkenntnisse generieren.Integration – Du verknüpfst Tools, Datenquellen und Systeme – sei es via API, komplexer Datenmodelle oder Connector. Das bringst du mit
Du hast deinen Masterabschluss in (Wirtschafts-)Informatik oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs (bald) abgeschlossen.
Du hast bereits erste Erfahrung z. B. durch Praktika, Uni-Projekte oder Selbststudium mit Datenverarbeitung, Datenmodellierung und -visualisierung und verfügst über solide Kenntnisse in Power BI, Power Automate, Power Apps und idealerweise Python.
Du liebst es, mit Zahlen zu arbeiten, Tools auszuprobieren und kreative Lösungen zu finden.
Du bringst Neugier, Eigeninitiative und echten Teamgeist mit.
Du beherrschst die Sprache Deutsch auf dem Level C2 und verfügst über sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
 

 

Deine Benefits

Flexibilität – In Abstimmung mit deinem Team erwartet dich ein Mix aus gemeinsamen Bürotagen und Home Office. Dabei gibt es keine Kernarbeitszeiten – im Rahmen der betrieblichen Anforderungen und arbeitsrechtlichen Vorgaben kannst du deine Arbeitszeit flexibel gestalten. Zusätzlich hast du die Möglichkeit, temporär in über 40 Ländern zu arbeiten.Berufsexamen – Durch unsere interne Academy, internationale Erfahrungen durch Secondments und kontinuierliches Mentoring entwickelst du dich stetig weiter. Zusätzlich unterstützen wir dich bei dem Erlangen der Berufsexamina: Wirtschaftsprüfer:in, Voll-WP, Steuerberater:in und Aktuar:in. Freizeit – Überstunden kannst du auf deinem Jahresarbeitszeitenkonto (JAZ) sammeln und nach arbeitsintensiven Phasen durch Freizeit ausgleichen. Restliche Überstunden werden einmal jährlich ausgezahlt. Zusätzlich stehen dir 30 Urlaubstage im Kalenderjahr zur Verfügung. Gesundheit – Deine Gesundheit liegt uns am Herzen: Neben einer eigenen betrieblichen Krankenkasse bieten wir auch Vorsorgeuntersuchungen sowie Sportangebote an. Nimm an unserem kostenlosen Betriebssportprogramm teil oder profitiere von vergünstigten Beiträgen in diversen Fitnessstudios oder einer Urban Sports Club-Mitgliedschaft. Das ist noch nicht alles – Wir möchten ein positives Arbeitsumfeld schaffen: Ein Umfeld, in dem flexibles und kreatives Arbeiten möglich ist, in dem Arbeit anerkannt und Leistung honoriert wird und auf das wir stolz sind. Alle Benefits findest du auf unserer Karriereseite.   Bei PwC Deutschland arbeiten wir daran, entscheidende Herausforderungen zu lösen, nachhaltige Ergebnisse zu schaffen und das Vertrauen in die Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft auszubauen. Als Teil unseres Corporate Tax Teams behältst du bei nationalen und internationalen Steuerthemen den Durchblick für unsere Mandanten: Von der Buchführung und Steuererklärung über Restrukturierungen bis hin zu grenzüberschreitenden Transaktionen. Dafür sind deine Expertise und deine Ideen gefragt. Mit einem tollen Team an deiner Seite erlebst du eine erfrischende Mischung aus der Arbeit mit Zahlen und dem direkten Kontakt zu unseren Mandanten.  Kontakt Du hast Fragen zu dieser Position oder deiner Bewerbung?Melde dich gerne bei Alisa Kullmann unter +49 69 95852697.

Title: Business Analyst, Delivery Promise (m/w/x)
Description:
Engineered in Berlin. Driving the Future of Europe.



At AUTODOC, we are proud to be a homegrown European success story. Founded in Berlin in 2008 and still headquartered in the heart of the continent today, we have evolved from a local specialist into Europe’s leading online platform for the automotive aftermarket.



Our strength lies in our unique identity: we are a digital-first, e-commerce powerhouse with strong German roots and an expansive reach across 27 European countries. This continental focus allows us to blend our heritage with high-tech innovation, staying agile and closely connected to the markets we serve.



Today, our team of more than 5,500 professionals from over 50 different countries is redefining mobility through cutting-edge technology. Bring your talent and expertise to a company that is building a sustainable, tech-driven future for drivers everywhere.



Come join us and impact the future of AUTODOC!





Popis nabídky práce



When a customer orders a product, the "Estimated Delivery Date" (EDD) isn't just a number, it’s a commitment. As our Business Analyst for Delivery Promise, you will own the data engine driving EDD precision and End-to-End (E2E) cycle time.



We are seeking a Business Analyst, Delivery Promise to join our Fulfillment Excellence Team. This role focuses on maintaining and improving our Estimated Delivery Date (EDD) accuracy and the End-to-End (E2E) Total Cycle Time data infrastructure.



By combining data analytics with project management, the candidate will identify the root causes of operational delays and translate data insights into cross-functional corrective measures. This position impacts delivery reliability, customer satisfaction, and supply chain efficiency.



Key Responsibilities



EDD Model Development & Implementation: Design, build, test, and deploy predictive EDD models (focusing on optimizing protection buffers) across delivery regions. Collaborate with Data Science, Logistics, and IT teams to integrate these models into existing systems and refine them based on operational feedback.



Performance Reporting & Analysis: Monitor delivery performance metrics, specifically EDD accuracy and E2E Total Cycle Time. Utilize SQL, Excel, and Power BI to build dashboards, conduct trend analyses, and perform root-cause bucketization to categorize delivery delays.



Process Improvement: Partner with cross-functional teams across Operations, Supply Chain, and Customer Service to identify operational inefficiencies. Design and implement solutions to improve delivery reliability and align cycle-time performance with business objectives.



Stakeholder Management & Communication: Serve as the point of contact for EDD and cycle-time performance. Translate data into business insights and collaborate with cross functional teams (Vendor Operations, Warehouse teams, Last Mile transportation) to manage end-to-end supply chain impacts.





Kvalifikace



Experience: A minimum of 3 years of professional experience in a data analytics role, preferably within Supply Chain, Logistics, or Operations.

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Data Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline.

Technical Proficiency: Proficiency in SQL, Excel, and Power BI for data extraction, manipulation, and visualization.

Analytical Capabilities: Experience in KPI monitoring, root-cause analysis, and data-driven process optimization.

Project Management: Cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to drive initiatives across multiple departments.

Advanced Tech: Familiarity with advanced data ecosystems, including knowledge of programming languages (e.g., Python, R), exposure to ML orchestration, or experience operating in cloud data warehouse environments (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery) is nice to have.

Languages: Full professional proficiency in English (both written and verbal) is mandatory; German, Czech, Polish, or Russian is nice to have.





Další informace



Vacation: Annual vacation of 30 calendar days and 1 additional day off on your birthday.

Wellbeing: Mental Wellbeing Program.

Growth: Learning & Development opportunities (over 650 courses on soft and hard skills on our e-learning platform).

Perks: AUTODOC Corporate Discount.

Language Classes: Free English and German language classes (after probation period).

Flexibility: Flexible working hours and hybrid work model.

Future Security: Company pension scheme (Betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit Allianz).







This job was posted on 21. 8. 2026, and is considering applications up to 6 weeks from this date.

Title: Sales Business Analyst - hybrid (w/m/d)
Description:
Deine Aufgaben


Du entwickelst KPIs, Dashboards und Management-Reports kontinuierlich weiter
Du analysierst die Vertriebsperformance, identifizierst Trends und Abweichungen und leitest daraus konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen ab
Du schaffst Transparenz über relevante Kennzahlen und unterstützt datenbasierte Entscheidungen
Du unterstützt die Weiterentwicklung und Pflege unseres CRM-Systems und wirkst beim Rechtemanagement mit

Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

Title: Business Analyst, Payments Experience
Description:
Description

This role is open to be in Munich or Berlin.

As a Business Analyst on the Payment Acceptance & Experience Marketing team you will own analytics for our emerging business efforts.

Your primary focus will be leveraging your passion for digging into data, structuring problems, and building analyses to identify actionable insights from application data and digital marketing channels, both on Amazon and off. You enjoy being creative in your use of data-driven tools and methodologies to understand marketing levers and are eager to initiate new ideas, approaches and actions to move the business forward.

Responsibilities


You will own reporting and insights to identify and evaluate opportunities to drive funnel conversion.
Develop and streamline necessary dashboards and one-off analyses, providing ability to surface business-critical KPIs, monitor the health of marketing channels and effectively communicate performance.
Partner with stakeholders and Business Intelligence teams to acquire necessary data for robust analysis.
Convert data into insights including implications and recommendations that are specific and actionable for the Marketing team and across the business.
Partner with other analysts as well as data engineering and technology teams to support building a best-in-class marketing platform and data infrastructure.
Work with stakeholders to identify key metrics used to evaluate marketing performance.
Identify, implement, and analyze a/b tests and campaigns.
Use customer centric data analysis, data visualization, segmentation and a/b testing to optimize across channels and within campaigns.
Stay current on best practice in Marketing Analytics methodologies and trends.
Communicate insights using data visualization and presentations to stakeholders.


About The Team

This role sits within the Payments Acceptance and Experience EU Acquisition & Engagement team, which drives customer acquisition and lifecycle growth for payment products across Europe. As a Business Analyst, you’ll be a critical function in this team. You will also be part of an exciting transformation, defining how we integrate AI capabilities into our everyday operations and customer experiences. We work closely with Product, Analytics, Creative, Legal, and regional teams to create seamless, high-impact customer experiences. Our team is customer-obsessed, data-driven, and moves fast—and we’re looking for someone who has this mindset.

Basic Qualifications


Bachelor's degree or equivalent
Experience in business or financial analysis
Experience in Excel (including VBA, pivot tables, array functions, power pivots, etc.) and data visualization tools such as Tableau
Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
Knowledge of SQL


Preferred Qualifications


Experience in tax, finance or a related analytical field
Experience making business recommendations and influencing stakeholders

We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Title: Lead Business Analyst
Description:
Ready for a Challenge?

Then Just Eat Takeaway.com might be the place for you. We’re a leading global online food delivery platform, and our vision is to empower everyday convenience. Whether it’s a Friday-night feast, a post-gym poke bowl, or grabbing some groceries, our tech platform connects tens of millions of customers with hundreds of thousands of restaurant, grocery, and convenience partners across the globe.

All About The Role

In this role, you will lead the marketing and customer analytics strategy for Lieferando, our German market. You will focus on uncovering high-impact opportunities by analyzing campaign performance, customer behavior, and marketing mix models to optimize multi-million euro budgets. Your insights will directly shape how we maintain our market leadership and engage with millions of customers.

These are some of the key ingredients to the role


Lead Analytics Strategy: Shape the roadmap for Germany’s marketing analytics, creating data products that translate business needs into actionable solutions.
Technical Execution: Monitor customer dynamics and campaign impact using SQL, Python, and advanced analytics to guide "test and learn" marketing strategies.
Stakeholder Influence: Present complex data insights and strategic recommendations to senior management to drive budget optimization and business growth.
Mentorship: Act as a technical lead, coaching and mentoring other data professionals to cultivate a high-performing, agile environment.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with global and local teams to design metrics and build reporting suites using Tableau and Google BigQuery.


What will you bring to the table?


Proven Analytics Expertise: Demonstrated experience in e-commerce, platform, or consulting environments, with a track record of delivering recommendations to senior stakeholders.
Marketing Domain Mastery: Significant experience in marketing analytics and measurement; familiarity with marketing mix modeling or attribution is highly preferred.
Technical Proficiency: Advanced skills in SQL and Python for data extraction and analysis, alongside expertise in visualization tools like Tableau or Power BI.
Strategic Problem Solving: Proven ability to translate ambiguous business questions into technical data roadmaps and persuasive, data-driven narratives.
Advanced Methodology: Practical experience applying causal inference or regression analysis to business problems, paired with professional fluency in English.


Our Offer

Just like a well-balanced recipe: your skills and our offer are a perfect match! With us, you can expect:


💰 Competitive Compensation: A salary package that recognises your performance – complemented by an open feedback culture and regular performance reviews.
📝 Flexibility: A permanent employment contract with hybrid work options: three days per week in our Berlin-Kreuzberg office and two days working from the comfort of your home.
🏋️‍♀️ Urban Sports Club Membership: For your work-life balance and a clear head in your daily routine.
🍽️ Additional Perks: A monthly travel allowance of €59 and a €90 monthly Lieferando Pay credit to have delicious food delivered straight to your workspace.
🏠 Company Pension: A company pension scheme with a 20% employer contribution.
🌐 Diversity & Inclusion: A diverse and inclusive team with colleagues from over 99 nations, plus the opportunity to join our various communities and Employee Resource Groups (ERGs).
😎 Shared Experiences: After-work drinks, regular team events, social engagement activities, as well as our summer and/or winter parties.


Inclusion, Diversity & Belonging

No matter who you are, what you look like, who you love, or where you are from, you can find your place at Just Eat Takeaway.com. We’re committed to creating an inclusive culture, encouraging diversity of people and thinking, in which all employees feel they truly belong and can bring their most colourful selves to work every day.

What else is cooking?

Want to know more about our JETers, culture or company? Have a look at our career site where you can find people's stories, blogs, podcasts and more JET morsels.

Are you ready to take your seat? Apply now!

Title: Berater Value Strategy & RWE - Schwerpunkt Versorgungsdatenanalysen (m/w/d)
Description:
Die IGES GmbH ist auf gesundheitsökonomische und strategische Forschungs- und Beratungsdienstleistungen für internationale Arzneimittel- und Medizinproduktehersteller spezialisiert. Sie bietet Biotech-, Pharma- und Medizinprodukteunternehmen Lösungen für den Market Access, Preisbildung und Erstattung ihrer medizinischen Innovationen. Das Unternehmen ist in Frankreich, Deutschland, Italien, Spanien, Schweden, der Schweiz und Großbritannien vertreten und unterstützt auch bei multinationalen Produkteinführungen. IGES ist Teil der Athagoras Gruppe, die verschiedene Beratungsunternehmen für die Lifescience-Branche vereint.




Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams im Bereich Value Strategy & RWE suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt an unserem Standort in Berlin einen Berater Value Strategy & RWE - Schwerpunkt Versorgungsdatenanalysen (m/w/d)




Ihre Aufgaben




Strategische Beratung von Market Access, HE&OR- und RWE-Abteilungen von führenden Pharmaunternehmen und Emerging Biotechs
Mitarbeit in interdisziplinären Projekten zum Marktzugang innovativer Arzneimittel mit Schwerpunkt auf Routinedatenanalysen (Krankenkassen- und weitere Versorgungsdatensätze)
Konzeption, Durchführung und Auswertung von Sekundärdatenanalysen (einschließlich Datenaufbereitung, Kohortendefinition und statistischen Analysen)
Unterstützung bei HTA-relevanten Fragestellungen (z. B. Evidenzanforderungen, PICO-Scoping, Analysestrategien) und beim Transfer der Ergebnisse in Publikationen, Präsentationen und Projektberichte
Mitarbeit an der Konzeption und Durchführung von Real-World-Evidence-Studien zur Untersuchung von Wirksamkeit und Sicherheit innovativer Arzneimittel in der Versorgungspraxis
Durchführung systematischer Literaturrecherchen und strukturierte Auswertung zur Ergänzung von Routinedatenbefunden
Aktive Mitwirkung an der Weiterentwicklung interner Daten- und Methodenkompetenz, inkl. Vorbereitung für die Analysen von Gesundheitsdaten des FDZ Gesundheit
Mitarbeit bei der Erstellung und Veröffentlichung Publikationen in z.B. wissenschaftlichen Fachzeitschriften, Projektberichten und Ergebnispräsentationen




Ihre Qualifikation




Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium (Master/Diplom) in Public Health, Epidemiologie, Gesundheitsökonomie, Statistik, Biometrie, Medizinische Informatik oder vergleichbarer Fachrichtung
Mindestens 1–2 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung mit Routinedatenanalysen (z. B. Krankenkassen- oder Registerdaten) im akademischen oder industriellen Umfeld
Erfahrung in der Erstellung wissenschaftlicher Dokumente, z. B. Studienprotokolle, Studienberichte oder Publikationen
Fundierte Kenntnisse epidemiologischer und statistischer Methoden sowie Grundkenntnisse in HTA-/Market-Access-Anforderungen wünschenswert
Gute Programmierkenntnisse in R oder Python; Kenntnisse in SQL von Vorteil
Analytisches Denkvermögen, strukturierte und sorgfältige Arbeitsweise sowie ein hohes Maß an Eigeninitiative
Aufgeschlossene und kommunikationsstarke Persönlichkeit mit Teamorientierung und Kundenfokus
Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (wissenschaftliches Niveau)




Unser Angebot




Mitarbeit in abwechslungsreichen Projekten zu hochinnovativen Arzneimitteln an der Schnittstelle von Versorgungsforschung, Real-World Evidence und strategischer Beratung
Ein interdisziplinäres, kollegiales Arbeitsumfeld mit flachen Hierarchien, kurzen Entscheidungswegen und guten Entwicklungsperspektiven
Fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung durch anspruchsvolle Projektarbeit, viel Raum für eigene Ideen und individuell abgestimmte Weiterbildungen (z. B. Konferenzen)
Praktische Erfahrung in der Nutzung großer Routinedatensätze sammeln und frühzeitig Kompetenzen im Hinblick auf das FDZ Gesundheit aufbauen
Flexible Arbeitsgestaltung nach einer strukturierten Einarbeitung am Standort Berlin, inklusive Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten
Unbefristete Festanstellung mit marktgerechter Vergütung, flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, 30 Tagen Urlaub sowie zusätzlich frei an Heiligabend und Silvester




Wenn Sie diese Aufgabe reizt, freuen wir uns über Ihre aussagekräftigen Bewerbungsunterlagen (Anschreiben, Lebenslauf und Zeugnisse) unter Angabe Ihrer Gehaltsvorstellungen und des frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins hier über die Direktbewerbung oder per Mail an Frau Alina Weber (personal@iges.com). Für weiterführende Informationen steht Ihnen Frau Weber unter der Rufnummer 030/230 809-418 gern zur Verfügung.

Title: GTM Business Intelligence Manager (f/m/d)
Description:
Join the team rewriting the rules in private markets.

Moonfare delivers what few others can: the highly sought-after funds and hidden-gem investments that go beyond what most private banks offer. Every opportunity is subjected to a ruthless vetting process; the bar is unforgivingly high. The result? Institutional-quality portfolios for investors who demand more.

Our team combines finance veterans with talent from tech, consulting, law and industries you’d never expect. Headquartered in Berlin, we operate from eight offices across Europe, the US and Asia.

If you're ready to build what's next in private markets, let's talk.

GTM Business Intelligence Manager (m/f/d)

We are looking for a highly analytical, technically strong, and business-oriented GTM Business Intelligence Manager to own the intelligence, reporting, and performance governance of our Go-to-Market organization.


This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Marketing, Product, Revenue Operations, Business Intelligence, and Data Engineering. You will transform complex datasets into actionable business insights, monitor the health of our GTM funnel, and enable leadership to make data-driven decisions that improve business performance. Beyond analytics, you will act as a trusted business partner, ensuring our GTM processes remain scalable, data-driven, and aligned with company priorities. You will independently own key GTM intelligence and Revenue Operations domains, influence stakeholders across the organization, and drive work through expertise, sound judgment, and cross-functional collaboration.

 

Your Mission:

Own the analytical framework behind Sales performance and GTM decision-making, running funnel, conversion, segmentation, Pareto, cohort, and trend analyses that drive forecasting, target tracking, capacity planning, and business planning.
Own the monitoring and health of the lead lifecycle from acquisition through qualification and handoff, keeping key GTM metrics accurate and consistently measured, and partnering with Sales, Marketing, and Product to identify and fix conversion bottlenecks.
Become the subject matter expert in our CRM data model, investigating reporting discrepancies and data quality issues, and partnering with CRM administrators, Business Intelligence, and Data Engineering to improve reporting capability, automation, and data integrity.
Own operational reporting and performance measurement across Revenue Operations, monitoring SLA performance, ticket volumes, and delivery timelines, and coordinating the roadmap so initiatives are prioritised, tracked, and delivered in a structured way.
Act as the bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, translating business questions into analytical and technical requirements, and building trusted relationships across the organisation while protecting governance and agreed priorities.
Continuously challenge existing reporting and recommend simpler, more effective ways of measuring business performance, rather than letting complexity accumulate by default.

The next Moonfarian:

You bring deep, hands-on expertise in Excel, including Pivot Tables and complex formulas across large datasets.
You have strong CRM reporting experience, ideally with HubSpot or Salesforce, and a solid grasp of sales performance metrics, forecasting, funnel analytics, pipeline management, and commercial KPIs.
You have work with, or had some exposure to, SQL
You're naturally curious and enjoy solving complex business problems, using data to challenge assumptions and influence decisions rather than simply reporting numbers.
You remain calm under pressure, are comfortable engaging senior stakeholders on difficult messages, and can confidently push back when requests conflict with agreed priorities, governance, or business objectives.
You take ownership from problem identification through implementation, prioritising competing requests without losing focus, and communicating complex analyses in a clear, concise, and actionable way.
Experience in Revenue Operations, GTM Operations, or Sales Operations, familiarity with data modelling and governance principles, and prior SaaS or B2B experience are all a plus, though not required.

If you feel you do not meet all of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply!

Please Note: We can only accept applications from those eligible to live and work in Berlin. This is a hybrid role with office attendance required 4 days/week. We do not accept applications sent by email. You should submit your application directly through our careers website.

 

Invest in yourself:

Ownership and Impact: You are empowered to bring ideas, make decisions, and see your work directly contribute to Moonfare's success.
Transparent Environment: We believe in open communication. You will receive regular updates on company strategy, performance against our KPIs, and key business decisions.
Personal Growth: We support your development with an individual growth budget of €1,500 or 2% of your base salary (whichever is higher).
Invest in Your Future: We support your long-term financial goals with a company pension scheme, providing a 20% employer contribution.
Relax and Recharge: You start with 25 vacation days and you’ll receive one additional day for each year of tenure, up to a maximum of 30 days.
Daily Lunch: Enjoy a free lunch every day that you are in the Berlin office, with a weekly changing menu that includes salads, curries, pastas, and a variety of vegan and vegetarian options.
Subsidised Public Transport: We support your commute with a monthly subsidy for the Deutschland job ticket, making your travel easier and more affordable.
Fitness and Wellbeing: Stay active with a subsidised Urban Sports Club membership, giving you flexible access to a wide variety of sports and wellness activities across Germany.
A Culture of Excellence: Join a team of ambitious, smart, and committed professionals who are passionate about revolutionising private market investing.

Our Values:

Client-Centric Focus: Our clients come first, Moonfare comes second, and we prioritise ourselves third. Putting clients first means creating value for them is essential. Placing Moonfare second signifies that our individual professional future at Moonfare depends on the company's commercial success. Prioritising ourselves third reflects our humility in putting clients and Moonfare before personal interests.
Commitment to Excellence: We pursue excellence and honor our promises. We hold ourselves to the highest standards, taking responsibility for our failures, and celebrating our successes. We commit to deadlines and stick to them and we learn from our mistakes.
Win together: We are here to win and to celebrate our collective achievements. We are mission-focused and think and act like owners. We exemplify the attitude we expect and each of us commits to do what it takes to succeed.
Growth and Merit: We foster personal growth but each of us earns our place as a Moonfarian through merit. We hire, retain, and develop exceptional people and invest in empowering them to excel. We must all earn our place at the table every day.

We understand the important role that diversity plays in our success. Different backgrounds, experiences and ideas push us further and raise the bar. We’re committed to developing an inclusive and safe culture where everyone—regardless of colour, race, religion, sex, origin, sexuality, disability, marital status, citizenship or gender identity—knows that they are an integral part of the team and can bring their full potential to their work.

Title: Senior Campaign Analyst
Description:
Who we are

JustWatch delivers data-driven digital marketing for the global entertainment business. From the biggest blockbusters to award-winning shows, major sporting events, and best-selling console games. Not only are we entertainment obsessives ourselves, but we also own the world's largest streaming guide, which gives us unparalleled data and insights on audience behaviours and content tastes.




From a small startup, we've evolved into a 200+ strong team, based in Berlin, around the world, or working remotely. We've been all about building a profitable business while riding that wave of impressive growth.




Who we need

Our Campaign team consists of more than 75+ specialists - and it keeps growing: As our new Senior Campaign Analyst, you are the go-to person for all kinds of data-related requests, reports, and their automation. Your expertise will ensure that our campaigns are fueled by accurate data, actionable insights, and efficient reporting processes.




Learn where your talents can be developed, deliver at your peak, and create value in your work.

Join us and experience a workplace that's the perfect fit for your talent.




What you will be doing

Collaborate with our Business Intelligence department to maintain correct and clearly defined data and KPIs in campaign dashboards.
Stay informed about exceptions made for different clients, reflecting them in reports and analyses.
Accelerate the reporting process for the campaigns team.
Design and provide dashboards, along with data for weekly and monthly reports.
Ensure data sanity in our tools, Thoughtspot/Lightdash, and maintain data quality in external dashboards.
Proactively detect the optimisation potential in our media campaigns.
Conducting benchmarking and forecasting activities.




What we need from you

Proven experience in marketing analytics or a related field, with a deep understanding of business models and digital marketing channels.
Deep understanding of the channels we use (Meta, TikTok, DV360) and their relevant KPIs, including their definition.
Strong analytical skills and the ability to derive actionable insights from complex datasets, KPIs, and benchmarks.
Exceptional skills in Excel and Google Spreadsheets, with the ability to quickly set up reports with data from various sources efficiently.
Excellent communication skills, with the capacity to convey technical information to non-technical stakeholders effectively, and simplify complex scenarios, bringing clarity and focus.
Ability to remain composed and deliver error-free reports and dashboards even in high-pressure, stressful situations with tight deadlines, when faced with obstacles.
A can-do attitude and positive mindset with a proactive approach to overcoming challenges and a passion for driving continuous improvement.
Great conduct in English. German is a plus.
Constant learning, delivering results, and creating value are the core characteristics of everyone at JustWatch, and we are looking for these values in every person we hire.




What we offer you

An open-minded and international team that loves to collaborate to reach our goals.
We prioritise meaningful work over perks, and that true fulfilment comes from intrinsic motivation, personal growth, and making a lasting impact.
We believe in a permission-less environment that lets us focus on delivering value without overcomplicating things.
We trust our skilled professionals to maintain a no-nonsense attitude and create an environment that promotes innovation.
We are committed to helping you achieve your personal and professional goals, and we offer a collaborative and supportive environment to do so.
Truly a hybrid work environment. You are not required to come to the office, but you will want to.




Media is important to us, and we are always happy to hear from people who enjoy film! If you feel like you are missing some of the hard skills, don’t worry, we are hiring for the attitude, values, and personality.




If we caught your attention and you're eager to delve into our perspectives and thought processes, we recommend immersing yourself in our blog post, which elaborates on these subjects:

A company culture that really works
Audience as a Service
Or visit our blog here: https://www.justwatch.com/blog




How to apply

Just hit the apply button and leave us your CV, some basic info, and a short introduction that helps us get to know you. Tell us what motivates you, why you want to work at JustWatch, and how you think you can help us achieve our goals.




Please only apply if you are genuinely interested. Copy-paste mass applications will receive a copy-paste rejection email. The same goes for applications that rely heavily on AI-generated content. We want to get to know you as a person first, not your prompts.




If you have any questions, please reach out to our Talent Team via LinkedIn or apply directly through our jobs page.




Research shows women apply when meeting 100% qualifications, men at 60%. JustWatch welcomes all candidates, especially women and marginalized groups. Apply, let's talk and explore if you're a great fit.

Title: Senior Product Analyst, Geo Platform
Description:
About Bolt

Bolt is shaping a future where cities are built for people, not cars. What started as an ambitious project of a 19-year-old in 2013 has grown into a global mobility platform used by more than 200 million customers and 4.5 million driver and courier partners across 50 countries.

From ride-hailing and food delivery to scooters, e-bikes, and car-sharing, Bolt helps people move through cities every day. Small, autonomous teams drive this work, combining the speed and ownership of a startup with the scale of a global technology company backed by more than €1bn in funding.

And we're just getting started.

Why join Bolt?


Build the future of mobility and help transform how people live and move in cities.
Tackle challenges at scale that span technology, operations, regulation, and growth.
Take real ownership early. Small, lean teams mean your decisions matter from day one, and you'll learn fast alongside some of the best people in the industry.
Join one of Europe's leading technology companies, backed by world-class investors including Sequoia.


About The Role

At Bolt, Product Analysts are embedded directly into product teams, partnering with Product, Engineering and Data Science to identify opportunities, shape decisions and measure impact.

In the Platform Product group, we support products and capabilities that are built once centrally and used across Bolt. Within the Platform group, Geo domain builds the location intelligence behind how people and goods move — including routing, ETAs, search, maps, live traffic and navigation. One of Geo’s biggest bets is Bolt Navigation, our in-house turn-by-turn navigation experience built directly into the Bolt Driver app. We’re creating navigation around the specific needs of drivers today, with the potential to serve couriers and other Bolt use cases in the future.

As a Senior Product Analyst in the Geo domain, you’ll work on some of our most complex product analytics problems. What makes a route good? Why do drivers follow or deviate from a suggested route? Which real-world signals from drivers can improve our maps? And how do small improvements to a journey translate into marketplace impact at Bolt’s scale? You’ll be a thought partner to Product Managers, Engineers and Data Scientists — helping the team understand users, define success, discover opportunities, design experiments and decide what to build next.

Main Tasks And Responsibilities


Define what great navigation looks like: develop metrics and measurement frameworks across navigation quality, adoption, route quality, ETA accuracy, traffic, driver behaviour and the end-to-end journey.
Turn complex geospatial data into product insights: work with large-scale GPS, routing, search, map and behavioural data to understand what happens in the real world and where our products can improve.
Lead product discovery and deep dives: turn ambiguous questions into structured analyses, uncover root causes, size opportunities and translate findings into clear product recommendations.
Design and evaluate experiments: partner with product teams on experiment design and analysis, and use appropriate statistical or causal methods when conventional A/B testing is not enough.
Build learning loops around our products: connect product behaviour, driver feedback, experiments and marketplace outcomes to help Geo continuously improve routing, navigation and map quality.
Own measurement from discovery to launch and beyond: define success criteria before launches, ensure the right instrumentation is in place, evaluate results and identify the next iteration.


About You


You have strong experience in Product Analytics, Data Science or a similarly analytical product role, ideally within a technology or product company.
You have excellent product thinking and are comfortable taking an ambiguous product problem, structuring it and determining what evidence is needed to make a decision.
You can rank your SQL skills as “outstanding” and Python/R experience as “profound”.
You can prove your ability to lead experimentation: applied statistics, designing and analysing experiments, providing recommendations.
You have strong business and product judgement. You can move from detailed analysis to the bigger question of what should we do differently as a result?
Your verbal and written communication skills are outstanding and you are fluent in English.


Why you’ll love it here


Accelerate your professional growth with unique career opportunities.
Enjoy a rewarding salary and stock options, knowing that as Bolt succeeds, so do you.
Take care of your physical and mental health with our wellness perks.
Celebrate 5 years at Bolt with a 1-month paid sabbatical to recharge.
Connect with colleagues at annual company events and smaller team gatherings.
Balance flexibility and in-person collaboration with our hybrid model, including at least 12 monthly in-office days.


Some perks may differ depending on your location and role.

At Bolt, using AI daily is a baseline expectation for everyone. If there’s a faster, smarter way to do your work, we expect you to find it. You’re still responsible for the output, so the standard stays high when using AI tools.

Experience is great, but what we really look for is drive, intelligence, and integrity. So even if you don’t tick every box, please consider applying!

Everyone is welcome

Bolt is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where all qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to race, colour, nationality, religion, gender or gender identity, sexual orientation, age, or disability.

We welcome applications from all backgrounds and are happy to make reasonable accommodations throughout our hiring process. If you require any adjustments, please let us know.

Title: Analytical Consultant, Digital First
Description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: Munich, Germany; Berlin, Germany; Frankfurt am Main, Germany; Hamburg, Germany.Minimum qualifications:


Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
5 years of experience in media analytics, advertising sales, digital media and marketing, consulting, or financial analysis.


Preferred qualifications:


Experience in translating data into business recommendations, creating and delivering appealing insights-based presentations or business cases with clear recommendations and aligned with customers objectives.
Experience in data analyses and visualization (Google Sheets and Slides), scripting (Google SQL), Dashboard development (Looker Studio), and leverage AI for analytics.
Advertising experience from either the advertiser, agency or other media owner side.
Ability to work closely with multiple stakeholder and cross-functional teams and influence key stakeholders (internally and externally) across all levels.
Ability to communicate in German fluently as this is a client facing role.


About The Job

Digital First, a sector within LCS, is home to a variety of customers, from Travel, Media and Entertainment and many digital natives like marketplaces, aggregators and comparison websites. Our mission is to drive the success and sustainable growth of our Digital First customers through innovation and a customer-first mindset.

As an Analytical Consultant (AC), you will work with top clients across various industries to optimize their online advertising strategies and help them achieve their business objectives. In your role, you will be the point of contact for large customers on anything around data in the form of analysis and strategic insights and you will be a core consultant to the sales teams helping them drive Google’s business growth. You will dive deep into data to uncover hidden opportunities and commercial insights for customers – analyze their market coverage, Google auction performance, optimize their profitability and branding investments and align their efforts with target audiences. You will share these insights as a trusted consultant with the customers as well as to sales teams internally.

To scale your impact, you will help identify solutions and analyses that other customers and teams would benefit from and work together with a cross-functional team to scale and automate them. You promote data fluency by sharing insightful dashboards to visualize key metrics that support their business objectives as well as educating clients and partners on Google's tools. You collaborate with cross-functional teams to act as a data analyst, strategic advisor, and consultant, ultimately driving commercial value for our clients.

Google's Large Customer Sales (LCS) teams are strategic partners and industry thought leaders to the world's leading brands and agencies. We continuously challenge how customers think about their business and how Google can support growth. We focus on helping these players navigate profound industry shifts and drive outsized business performance by competitively selling Google's full suite of advertising solutions across Search, YouTube, Measurement, and more. As a member of our LCS team, you'll have the unique opportunity to sell at the forefront of technology, collaborating with executives, influencing market-shaping strategies, and delivering tangible results that significantly impact major global businesses and drive the growth of Google.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Germany: €98000 - €100000 (EUR) + 40% bonus target + equity + benefits

Responsibilities

Learn more about benefits at Google .


Conduct comprehensive bespoke analyses for our high-priority customers to uncover hidden opportunities to optimize their online advertising return on investment.
Consult with clients as a strategic consultant, clearly presenting data-driven insights and recommendations that align with their business goals.
Develop engaging narratives to deliver insights at scale for a wider customer base. Streamline processes by developing scalable templates, dashboards and scripts (together with gCare Insights).
Empower clients and partners with guidance on using Google's data tools via trainings and, democratize insights where needed through insightful dashboards and reports.
Work seamlessly with the teams and stakeholders to drive successful outcomes for clients (e.g., measurement and incrementality specialists).

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

Title: (Junior) Energy Data Scientist – Energiedaten & Automatisierung (MSB) (m/w/d)
Description:
Über uns

Bei VREY bauen wir das EnergyOS für Mehrfamilienhäuser.

In Deutschland stehen über 3,3 Millionen Mehrparteienhäuser – und sie sind das schwarze Loch der Energiewende. <1% Solardurchdringung. <2% Smart Metering. Kaum Flexibilität oder intelligentes Energiemanagement.

Gleichzeitig zwingt die Regulierung Eigentümer zu massiven Investitionen: Solar wird zur Pflicht, Smart Meter müssen in den nächsten 5 Jahren flächendeckend ausgerollt werden, Heizung und Mobilität elektrifizieren sich. Das Mehrfamilienhaus wird vom Betongold zum aktiven Teil der dezentralen Energieinfrastruktur.

Was fehlt, ist ein integriertes System, das diesen Wandel wirtschaftlich und operativ beherrschbar macht.

VREY kombiniert zertifizierten Messstellenbetrieb mit eigener Software und ermöglicht Eigentümern erstmals, ihren selbst erzeugten Solarstrom direkt an ihre Mieter zu verkaufen – einfach und ohne selbst zum Energieversorger zu werden (


42b EnWG).


Damit wird regulatorischer Zwang zu einer profitablen und planbaren Chance:


Zweistellige Renditen und Wertsteigerung für Eigentümer,
~20 % Stromkostenersparnis für Mieter, und
digitale Infrastruktur für Speicher, Wärmepumpen und Flexibilität.


Bereits heute betreuen wir eine dreistellige Anzahl an Projekten - darunter die größten Bestandshalter und Wohnungsbaugenossenschaften - in allen 16 Bundesländern. Damit gehören wir nach kürzester Zeit zu den führenden Anbietern im Markt.

Im Zuge unserer Seed-Finanzierung haben wir 3,3 Mio. € von führenden Impact- und Energy-VCs (u. a. Rubio Impact Ventures, HTGF, Kopa Ventures) eingesammelt. Mit dem frischen Kapital gehen wir in die nächste Wachstumsphase und bauen unser Team gezielt aus.

Wir stehen am Anfang eines strukturellen Marktumbruchs. Wer heute die Energieinfrastruktur im Mehrfamilienhaus definiert, prägt sie für Jahrzehnte. Werde Teil von VREY und baue mit uns das führende EnergyOS.

Dein Profil


Du hast bereits erste Erfahrungen im Consulting (Tier 1/Tier 2), High-Growth Start-ups (idealerweise Operations oder Prozessoptimierung), oder im Projektmanagement gesammelt und ein abgeschlossenes Studium in einem relevanten Bereich
Erfahrung oder starkes Interesse an Datenanalyse, Automatisierung und KI/LLM-Agents (z. B. Python, APIs, Umgang mit größeren Datenmengen)
Sehr gutes Zahlen- und Datenverständnis; Freude daran, Datenqualitätsprobleme systematisch und datenbasiert zu durchdringen
Idealerweise Erfahrung in der Energiewirtschaft / Marktkommunikation (MaKo, Messstellenbetrieb, GGV/Mieterstrom, Bilanzierung) - oder die klare Bereitschaft, sich schnell tief einzuarbeiten.
Strukturierte, gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise: du gibst dich nicht mit „Job abgeschlossen" zufrieden, sondern prüfst, ob das Ergebnis inhaltlich stimmt

Du suchst bewusst keinen 9-to-5-Job, sondern willst in einem schnelllebigen, gründer-nahen Umfeld Verantwortung übernehmen, Strukturen aufbauen und das Wachstum aktiv mitgestalten

Bei VREY bauen wir das EnergyOS für Mehrfamilienhäuser.

In Deutschland stehen über 3,3 Millionen Mehrparteienhäuser – und sie sind das schwarze Loch der Energiewende. <1% Solardurchdringung. <2% Smart Metering. Kaum Flexibilität oder intelligentes Energiemanagement.

Gleichzeitig zwingt die Regulierung Eigentümer zu massiven Investitionen: Solar wird zur Pflicht, Smart Meter müssen in den nächsten 5 Jahren flächendeckend ausgerollt werden, Heizung und Mobilität elektrifizieren sich. Das Mehrfamilienhaus wird vom Betongold zum aktiven Teil der dezentralen Energieinfrastruktur.

Dein Studium mit wirtschaftlichem, informationstechnischem oder naturwissenschaftlichem Schwerpunkt hast du erfolgreich abgeschlossen oder stehst kurz davor.

Darüber hinaus bringst du Know-how in Business Intelligence sowie modernen Analysemethoden wie Data Mining, Predictive Analytics oder Machine Learning mit.
Ebenso hast du bereits Erfahrungen im Prüfungs-/Beratungsumfeld gesammelt.
Du kannst sowohl auf Deutsch als auch auf Englisch einwandfrei kommunizieren und sicher präsentieren, da wir als Team international aufgestellt sind.

Title: Senior Analyst — People & Workforce Intelligence (PWI) (d/f/m)
Description:
Personio's intelligent HR platform helps small and medium-sized organizations unlock the power of people by making complicated, time-consuming tasks simple and efficient. Our team of 1,500 Personios is building user-friendly products that delight our 15,000+ customers and their 1.5 million employees. Ready to make an impact from day one?

This role requires 2 days per week in the office and is based in Munich, Berlin or Dublin.

We empower Personio's decision-making with reliable data and strategic insights, while improving productivity through scalable infrastructure and automation. Be part of our transformative journey in HR technology, where your contributions shape how a leading people management platform understands its own workforce.

The Senior Analyst — PWI sits within the Data, Systems & AI department and partners closely with the People & Workplace Intelligence (PWI) function. This role combines two capabilities that are most powerful together: building the data foundations that make reliable analysis possible, and delivering the analysis itself. You own the infrastructure — writing dbt models from raw sources — and you own the insight: turning that data into clear recommendations for People leadership and partners.

You will work closely with PBPs and People leadership to connect people data sources — HRIS, absence and attendance systems, and others — and enable a self-serve analytics capability across the people domain.

What You'll Do

Data Foundations


Build and own dbt models end-to-end — from raw source ingestion through to staging, intermediate, and reporting layers — for the PWI domain, covering HRIS, headcount, absence, attendance, and adjacent people data sources.
Design and maintain scalable warehouse schemas in Snowflake, with clear data lineage, documentation, and version-controlled code (Git).
Define, document, and steward metric definitions and the semantic layer for people data, ensuring reliable KPI logic and metric consistency across the domain.
Implement data quality testing, monitoring, and alerting so that data issues are caught early and fixed proactively — not discovered by stakeholders.


Analytical Delivery


Deliver structured analysis on headcount, attrition, absence and attendance, org design, manager effectiveness, and compensation for PBPs and PWI leadership — forming clear hypotheses and producing decision-ready outputs, not just data dumps.
Build and maintain intuitive dashboards and reporting that allow stakeholders to self-serve on day-to-day questions without requiring analyst involvement.
Support MBR and QBR cycles with data storytelling: own the narrative, not just the numbers.
Partner with PBPs to diagnose root-cause data gaps, translate urgent business needs into analytical deliverables, and systematically improve the quality of people data over time.


Stakeholder Partnership


Act as the embedded analytical partner for the PWI function — showing up proactively, anticipating needs, and flagging risks before they escalate.
Present findings directly to People leadership with confident, prescriptive recommendations.
Enable PBPs to work more independently with data through documentation, self-serve tools, and direct coaching.


What You Need To Succeed

Must-haves


5+ years in analytics engineering, analytics, or a hybrid of both — you have done both the building and the analysis, not just one side.
Expert-level dbt: you have built models from raw source data, written tests, managed documentation, and understand lineage end-to-end — not just maintained existing models.
Strong SQL: complex queries, performance optimization, ability to work across a Snowflake-based data warehouse without hand-holding.
Analytical rigour: you structure ambiguous problems into hypotheses, identify the right metrics, and produce outputs that lead to decisions — not more questions.
Clear communicator: you translate data into plain language for non-technical stakeholders, present confidently, and write documentation that people actually use.
Experience with BI tooling (HEX, Tableau, Looker, or equivalent) for building stakeholder-facing dashboards and reporting.
Comfortable with Git and version-controlled codebases as a daily practice.
High ownership: you diagnose root causes, drive work independently, and don't wait to be told what matters next.


Nice to have


Experience with people/HRIS data — Workday, BambooHR, or similar compensation and benefits tooling.
Python for analytical workflows and automation.
Exposure to AI/LLM tooling (Claude, GPT) for insight generation or workflow automation.


Why Personio

Personio is an equal opportunities employer, committed to building an integrative culture where everyone feels welcomed and supported. We embrace uniqueness and understand that our diverse, values-driven culture makes us stronger. We are proud to have an inclusive workplace environment that will foster your development no matter your gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.

At Personio, we value in-person collaboration while also offering flexibility. This role is office-based, with 3 days per week required in your contracted office location. The remaining days can be worked from home or in the office if you prefer. In addition, you’ll have 20 Flex Days per year to work remotely from other locations. Aside from our people, culture, and mission, check out some of the other benefits that make Personio a great place to work:


Receive a competitive reward package – reevaluated each year – that includes salary, benefits, and pre-IPO equity
Enjoy 28 days of paid vacation, plus an additional day after 2 and 4 years
Make an impact on the environment and society with 1 (fully paid) Impact Day
Receive generous family leave, child support, mental health support, and sabbatical opportunities
We enjoy gathering for meals, cultural initiatives, and events like local Summer Sessions and year-end celebrations. There's also healthy snacks, drinks, and a weekly catered lunch.

Title: Data Scientist (m/w/d)
Description:
Intro

Zur CKM Group gehören eine Vielzahl von Unternehmen sowie eine Klinik, die alle dazu beitragen, unserer Vision von einer gesünderen Welt näher zu kommen.

Unser Ziel ist es, durch präventive Dienstleistungsmedizin, eHealth und Public Health eine führende und wegweisende Rolle im Gesundheitssystem von morgen einzunehmen. Dabei setzen wir auf smarte Logistik, Digitalisierung, Diagnostik und individuelle Prävention. Wir denken Gesundheitsversorgung und Diagnostik neu und hinterfragen dazu stets den Status Quo.

Ein neuer Pfeiler dieser Vision ist GreenMedical: Mit unserem telemedizinischen Service gestalten wir den Zugang zu medizinischem Cannabis für Menschen mit chronischen Beschwerden so einfach, niedrigschwellig, erschwinglich und sicher wie möglich, und wollen dabei unterstützen, Symptome zu lindern und die Lebensqualität nachhaltig zu verbessern: https://greenmedical.health/de/cannabis

Du liebst es, aus Daten Erkenntnisse zu gewinnen und möchtest mit deinen Analysen echten Mehrwert schaffen? Dann werde unser  Data Scientist (m/w/d) und unterstütze uns beim Aufbau intelligenter Datenprozesse und datengetriebener Entscheidungen!

Deine Mission bei uns


Datenaufbereitung & Datenmodellierung: Aufbau, Pflege und Weiterentwicklung von Datenstrukturen und -flüssen in Zusammenarbeit mit der IT, mit dem Ziel konsistenter und nutzbarer Daten.
Analyse & Visualisierung: Entwicklung von KPIs, Durchführung fundierter Analysen sowie Übersetzung von Daten in klare, entscheidungsrelevante Visualisierungen (z. B. inGrafanaoder Power BI).
Strukturierung von Fragestellungen: Eigenständige Zerlegung komplexer, offener Anforderungen in konkrete Analysen, Datenmodelle und umsetzbare Schritte.
End-to-End Umsetzung: Verantwortung für die Umsetzung von Use Cases,von der initialen Fragestellung über Datenaufbereitung bis hin zu Dashboard und Interpretation.
Schnittstelle zu Fachbereichen: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Bereichen wie Marketing undOperationszur Klärung, Priorisierung und Weiterentwicklung von Anforderungen.
Monitoring & Reporting: Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung von Dashboards und Reports zur Überwachung von Datenqualität, Systemzuständen und operativen KPIs.
Datenlogik & Modelle: Entwicklung, Anwendung und Validierung von Berechnungslogiken und Modellen (z. B. Performanceanalysen, Forecasts).
Weiterentwicklung der Datenlandschaft: Identifikation von Verbesserungspotenzialen in Datenstrukturen, Tools und Prozessen sowie aktive Mitgestaltung der Weiterentwicklung.


Was du mitbringen solltest


Erfahrung: Mehrjährige Erfahrung im datenbezogenen Umfeld (z. B. Data Analytics, BI, Data Science).
Teamarbeit: Enge Zusammenarbeit im Team sowie aktiver Beitrag zur Weiterentwicklung von Arbeitsweisen und Qualitätsstandards.
Kommunikation: Fähigkeit, Anforderungen zu klären, zu hinterfragen und Ergebnisse adressatengerecht zu vermitteln.
Neugier & Weiterentwicklung: Interesse an neuen Technologien, Tools und Methoden sowie aktive Weiterentwicklung bestehender Ansätze.
Arbeitsweise: Fähigkeit, komplexe Fragestellungen eigenständig zu strukturieren und in umsetzbare Schritte zu übersetzensowie Fähigkeit, mit Annahmen zu arbeiten und diese iterativ zu validieren.
Ownership: Hoher Grad an Eigenverantwortung und proaktives Vorantreiben von Themen.
Problemlösung & Entscheidungsfähigkeit: Fähigkeit, Probleme eigenständig einzugrenzen, Hypothesen zu entwickeln und pragmatische Entscheidungen zu treffen.
Business-Verständnis: Erfahrung oder starkes Interesse an fachlichen Zusammenhängen (insbesondere Marketing und/oderOperations) sowie Fähigkeit, diese in Datenlogik zu übersetzen.


Was wir dir bieten


Gestaltungsspielraum & Eigenverantwortung: Bringe deine Ideen ein, übernimm Verantwortung und gestalte die Weiterentwicklung unserer Unternehmen aktiv mit.
Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Wir arbeiten hybrid mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten.
31 freie Tage: 30 Urlaubstage plus jeweils halbe Arbeitstage an Heiligabend und Silvester.
Weiterentwicklung: Wir fördern deine fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung durch individuelle Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten.
Betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit DYNO: Eine provisionsfreie bAV-Lösung, damit mehr von deiner Altersvorsorge dort ankommt, wo sie hingehört – bei dir.
Wellpass: Zugang zu deutschlandweiten Sport-, Fitness- und Gesundheitsangeboten – von Fitnessstudios über Yoga und Schwimmen bis hin zu Massagen.
Probonio & Corporate Benefits: Über unsere Mitarbeiterplattform erhältst du Zugang zu attraktiven Vergünstigungen, exklusiven Mitarbeiterangeboten und zahlreichen Rabatten.
Bike-Leasing: Nach erfolgreicher Probezeit hast du die Möglichkeit, ein Fahrrad oder E-Bike zu leasen.
Modernes Arbeitsumfeld: Arbeiten im Herzen von Friedrichshain-Kreuzberg mit Blick auf die Spree und eigener Dachterrasse.


Du hast Fragen? Wir sind für dich da.

Unser People & Culture Team begleitet dich während des gesamten Recruiting-Prozesses und steht dir jederzeit zur Seite. Wenn du Fragen hast oder etwas unklar ist, melde dich einfach bei unserem Recruiting-Team unter career@ckmgroup.de – wir freuen uns, von dir zu hören!

entschlossen ambitioniert: Wir fördern eine Kultur der Leistung und schätzen außergewöhnliches Engagement. Um aus Herausfordernungen Chancen zu machen, gehen wir die Extra-Meile.

divers authentisch: Wir setzten auf Vielfalt ohne Masken. Herausragende Ergebnisse werden von einzigartigen Menschne geschaffen, die mit Echtheit überzeugen.
