Title: Data Analyst, People Analytics
Description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

The People Analytics team at Lyft exists to build data trust — turning people data into clear, reliable insights that help our HR Business Partners, talent leaders, and executives make better decisions. We're a small, high-impact team in the middle of a meaningful BI transformation: we recently moved to ThoughtSpot as our primary analytics platform, and we're not just replicating old dashboards — we're rethinking what self-service analytics looks like for a People team. That includes exploring ThoughtSpot's AI capabilities to surface proactive insights, enable natural language querying, and reduce the friction between a business question and a data answer. There's real greenfield work here, and we're looking for someone who wants to help define what AI-powered people analytics looks like at Lyft.

We're looking for a Data Analyst to join our People Analytics team, based in Toronto. You'll report to the Senior Manager, People Analytics and serve as the first point of contact for incoming data requests across the People organization — triaging, scoping, and delivering on analytical needs ranging from quick ad-hoc pulls to fully built ThoughtSpot dashboards.

This role is well-timed: you'll be joining as we complete our migration from Tableau to ThoughtSpot, which means you'll have genuine influence over how we build our reporting layer and push into ThoughtSpot's AI features — think natural language search, AI-generated insights, and proactive anomaly detection applied to people data. This isn't a "maintain the dashboard" role. It's a chance to help build something new. You'll be a self-starter who is equally comfortable writing SQL and presenting findings to a VP.

Responsibilities:


Serve as the first point of contact for incoming data requests from across the People organization — scoping needs, setting expectations, and delivering high-quality analytical outputs
Build and maintain ThoughtSpot dashboards and liveboards for a broad stakeholder audience including recruiters, People Team members, HRBPs, managers, and executives
Explore and operationalize ThoughtSpot's AI capabilities — including Spotter and AI Highlights — to surface proactive insights for People stakeholders who may not know what question to ask yet
Build and administer survey programs in Qualtrics — including survey design, distribution logic, and close-out — and translate results into dashboards and ad-hoc analyses that inform People team decisions
Partner with Talent and People team leads to define key metrics and help them tell meaningful stories with their data
Translate analytical findings into clear, actionable insights for both People leadership and senior executives
Communicate fluently across technical and non-technical audiences — from SQL-level data discussions to exec-facing summaries
Collaborate with systems and operations partners to improve upstream data quality and enable better downstream analytics
Pull together ad-hoc datasets from disparate sources to answer discrete analytical questions quickly and accurately


Experience:


4+ years of experience in data or business analytics
3+ years of SQL experience, with comfort pulling from complex, multi-source data environments
Experience with ThoughtSpot or a comparable modern BI platform; enthusiasm for AI-assisted analytics and a curiosity about what those tools unlock for people data specifically
Familiarity with Workday or a comparable HCM (understanding the business processes and data model, not just surface-level reporting)
Familiarity with Greenhouse or a comparable ATS preferred
Experience with Qualtrics or a comparable survey platform, including hands-on program administration and the ability to move from raw survey data to a clean, stakeholder-ready analysis
Experience building and maintaining analytical models that others rely on
Understanding of the nuances of people and recruiting data — org structures, headcount definitions, privacy considerations, and the ways these datasets can surprise you


Benefits:


Extended health and dental coverage options, along with life insurance and disability benefits
Mental health benefits
Family building benefits
Child care and pet benefits
Access to a Lyft funded Health Care Savings Account
RRSP plan with company match to help save for your future
In addition to provincial observed holidays, salaried team members are covered under Lyft's flexible paid time off policy. The policy allows team members to take off as much time as they need (with manager approval). Hourly team members get 15 days paid time off, with an additional day for each year of service
Lyft is proud to support new parents with 18 weeks of paid time off, designed as a top-up plan to complement provincial programs. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible.
Subsidized commuter benefits and Lyft ride credits

Title: Data Analyst, Revenue Operations
Description:
About FacilityOS

FacilityOS is a fast-growing company redefining how facilities operate—bringing safety, security, and daily operations into one unified platform used by organizations around the world.

As we continue to scale globally, we’re building a team of driven, curious people who want to make an impact. You’ll be part of a dynamic, collaborative culture where individuals are trusted to take ownership, solve meaningful problems, and grow in their careers. Our team comes together in-office twice a week to connect, collaborate, and build momentum.

If you’re looking to do your best work alongside a great team in a high-growth environment, FacilityOS is the place to build your career.

About The Role

Revenue Operations at FacilityOS owns the data layer behind how we go to market and how we build that that layer out on Microsoft Fabric and Power BI, sourced primarily from Salesforce and our GTM stack.

We are hiring a Data Analyst to own the models and reporting that sit on top of it. This is not a dashboard-maintenance role. You will build the semantic models, write the transformation logic, and be the person the GTM leaders and CRO come to when a number doesn't reconcile.

The role suits someone who has spent two to four years doing real analytics work and wants ownership of a data platform rather than a queue of report requests.

What You'll Own


Semantic models and reporting. Build and maintain Power BI semantic models and reports covering pipeline, bookings, forecast accuracy, conversion, retention, and customer health. Own the definitions, not just the visuals.
Data pipelines in Microsoft Fabric. Build and maintain pipelines and notebooks bringing Salesforce and GTM system data into the lakehouse. Own transformation logic, refresh schedules, and data quality checks.
Analysis that changes decisions. Quarterly pipeline and coverage analysis, segmentation and territory work, win/loss and cohort analysis, and ad hoc investigation into why a metric moved. Bring a recommendation, not just a chart.
Data integrity across the GTM stack. Reconcile Salesforce against downstream systems, find and fix the breaks, and flag the process problems causing them.
Documentation. Metric definitions, model lineage, and runbooks that let someone else pick up your work.


Required

What we're looking for


2–4 years in an analytics, BI, or data analyst role, ideally supporting a B2B SaaS revenue or GTM function
Strong SQL — joins, window functions, CTEs, query tuning
Hands-on Power BI: data modelling, DAX, star schema design, performance optimization
Experience building or maintaining data pipelines in a cloud platform. Microsoft Fabric is what we run; Synapse, Databricks, Snowflake, or BigQuery experience translates
Python for data work — transformation, API pulls, automation
Working knowledge of the Salesforce data model (objects, relationships, reporting quirks)
Able to take an ambiguous business question, decide what analysis actually answers it, and present the result to leaders without hand-holding


Nice to have


dbt or an equivalent transformation framework
Experience with Gainsight, Gong, SalesLoft, Clay, ZoomInfo, or HubSpot
Exposure to SaaS revenue metrics — ARR, NRR, pipeline coverage, CAC payback
Git and a habit of version-controlling analytical work


How We Work

You will often be the most technical person in most rooms you're in. That means explaining your work clearly, pushing back when a request is the wrong question, and being direct about what the data does and doesn't support.

Why work at FacilityOS?

We Work Hard And Play Hard And We Do Both With Passion And Respect For One Another. Our Company Promotes a Fast-paced, Fun, Friendly, And Highly Collaborative Work Environment That Provides

🩺Comprehensive health coverage

🏠A Hybrid work environment

💡Opportunity for advancement and growth

🍕 Catered Events, Snacks, Drinks – You won’t go Hungry!

🥳 Birthday and Life Celebrations

🎉 Two annual parties in a year

FacilityOS Commitment

We believe that a diverse team is the key to innovation and growth. We are an equal opportunity employer that value diversity at our company and encourage all candidates to apply. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

FacilityOS will accommodate individuals with disabilities through each stage of the recruitment and selection process. Please advise us of any needs when your interview is booked, and we will do our best to meet your needs.

Please note that all candidates must be legally eligible to work in the location in which you applied.

Background and Reference Checks

Any offer of employment may be conditional upon full background checks including a criminal record check, a credit check and employment and educational verifications. A reference check will also be conducted.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process such as reviewing applications. These tools assist the recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. All advancement and hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us or click here.

FacilityOS thanks all candidates for their interest, however only those selected to continue in the process will be contacted.

Compensation Range: CA$85K - CA$95K

Hammond Power Solutions Inc. is a global manufacturer headquartered in Guelph, Ontario, Canada. HPS has grown to become the leader in North America in the custom design and manufacture of dry type transformers. For the past century, HPS has grown to deliver electrical power solutions to global markets and provides solutions for complex applications like, mining, rectifier, drives, traction, wind, solar and many other electrical power applications. The world relies on HPS to continually conceive and produce state-of-the-art transformer technology. We currently have an opening for a Software Developer, Data and AI– 12 month contract, come grow with us!

Reporting to the Manager, Software Development, this role designs, develops and maintains enterprise data solutions that support business operations and strategic decision-making, including data solution architecture, integration and transformation. The incumbent also contributes to AI project lifecycle activities --- data preparation, model implementation, deployment, and ongoing support --- while building scalable, cloud-ready software applications.

Working closely with business stakeholders across departments, this role gathers requirements, implements and delivers data and AI-driven solutions, and ensures effective knowledge transfer through user training and support.

Design end-to-end data solutions (data models, data warehouse, data marts, semantic layers and OLAP cubes) to support analytics, reporting and AI use cases.
Implement modernization and cloud migration for legacy warehouses and pipelines
Ensure data quality, lineage and observability across pipelines and models;
Design and deliver BI dashboards, self-service reports.
Document architecture, data flows and data definitions to support maintainability
Collaborate on AI/ML project design; translate business problems into data and modeling requirements.
Prepare datasets: cleaning, enrichment and feature engineering
Assist with model integration, deployment, monitoring and retraining procedures
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
Efficiently leverage AI-powered coding assistants to develop and deliver high-quality software solutions.
Create and maintain efficient, scalable, and secure code.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to continuous improvement.
Streamline business processes by creating seamless data flows.
Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to existing data systems and software applications.


Do you qualify? We are seeking:


Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or related field, or equivalent professional experience.
2+ years’ professional experience in SQL and ETL design, with solid understanding dimensional modelling and data warehousing concepts, ensuring efficient storage, retrieval and analysis of large datasets.
Experience with AI/ML technologies including: LLM, Prompt Engineering, Vector Databases, AI Agents, Agentic AI, AI-powered coding, and MCP.
Prior experience in Azure Technologies such as Data Fabric, Synapse, ADFS, App Service, CI/CD pipeline and Power BI.
AI-powered programming experience with Python, C or C#.
Strong problem-solving skills and a passion for software development.
Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.

• Understanding of the importance of vision and enthusiasm in creating and promoting change,

Title: Data Solutions Engineer
Description:
Location: Brampton, ON (Head Office) – Onsite

Employment Type: Full-Time

Department: IT & Data Analytics

Salary Range: $85,000 to $105,000 (compensation is based on experience)




Competitive compensation, annual performance bonus, comprehensive benefits, RRSP matching, paid vacation, and professional development opportunities.




Build solutions that make a real business impact.

 

At Weston Forest, we're looking for someone who enjoys solving business problems with technology.




This isn't a traditional Power BI developer role. It isn't just software development or data science.

We're looking for a well-rounded Data Solutions Engineer who enjoys partnering directly with business users to understand how they work, identify opportunities for improvement, and build practical technology solutions that make their jobs easier.




One day you might be designing an interactive dashboard for Sales. The next you could be developing an internal application to automate a manual process, improving data pipelines for Operations, or building reporting tools that help leaders make better business decisions.




If you're energized by variety, enjoy working across different business functions, and like seeing your work make an immediate impact, we'd love to hear from you.

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

 

As part of Weston Forest's Data Analytics team, you'll work closely with leaders across Sales, Operations, Finance, Purchasing, Inventory, Production, Credit, and other business areas to design and deliver innovative analytics and business solutions.

 

No two days are exactly alike. You'll have the opportunity to work on a wide variety of projects spanning analytics, application development, automation, business intelligence, and emerging technologies.

 

Your responsibilities will include:




Partnering with business stakeholders to understand challenges, gather requirements, and recommend practical technology solutions
Collaborate on the design and solution architecture of business, application, and data solutions, leveraging existing platforms, standards, and best practices to deliver consistent, scalable solutions.
Designing and developing intuitive business applications, dashboards, portals, and reporting solutions that present complex information in a clear, visually compelling manner, enabling faster and more informed business decisions.
Building automation tools that eliminate manual processes and improve productivity
Developing analytics solutions using SQL, Power BI, Python, and other technologies
Creating and maintaining reliable data integrations, reporting datasets, and semantic models
Supporting enterprise reporting, business intelligence, and data governance initiatives
Evaluating emerging technologies such as AI and machine learning where they provide measurable business value
Participating in solution design, testing, deployment, documentation, user training, and ongoing support
Continuously improving existing analytics and business solutions across the organization

 

WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE DIFFERENT:

 

Unlike many analytics positions, this role isn't limited to building reports or maintaining dashboards.

 

You'll have the opportunity to work across the full solution lifecycle—from understanding business challenges and gathering requirements to designing applications, developing automation, integrating data, creating analytics, and supporting users after implementation.

 

This is an opportunity to become a trusted technology partner to business leaders while helping shape Weston Forest's digital transformation and analytics strategy.

 

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

 

We're interested in curious people who enjoy learning, solving problems, and building practical business solutions.

 

You'll likely be successful if you have:




A degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Software Engineering, Business Analytics, Mathematics, or a related field
Three (3) or more years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, software development, data engineering, or a similar role
Strong SQL, Python, Microsoft Excel (including Power Query), and Power BI skills.
Experience designing and developing dashboards, business applications, and reporting solutions.
Experience with APIs, system integrations, and Git or other source control systems.
Experience with ETL/ELT processes, relational databases, and data warehousing.
Experience working directly with business users to gather requirements and deliver practical technology solutions
Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences
A passion for continuous improvement and delivering practical business solutions that create measurable value

 

NICE TO HAVE:

 

Experience with any of the following would be considered an asset:




· Experience applying AI technologies to practical business problems.

· Experience with AWS or similar cloud platforms.

· Experience with web technologies (e.g., HTML, CSS, JavaScript).

 

Don't meet every qualification? We encourage you to apply anyway. We're looking for someone with the right mindset, curiosity, and problem-solving ability—not just someone who checks every box.

 

WHY JOIN WESTON FOREST?

 

At Weston Forest, technology isn't just a support function—it's an enabler of business transformation.

 

You'll join a small, collaborative Data Analytics team that works closely with business leaders across the organization. Rather than being assigned a narrow area of responsibility, you'll have the opportunity to contribute across a broad range of initiatives, helping shape how analytics, automation, and technology are used throughout the business.

 

Working directly with leaders across Sales, Operations, Finance, Purchasing, Inventory, Production, Credit, and other business functions, you'll build solutions that improve business processes, enhance decision-making, and create measurable value.

 

You'll enjoy:




Meaningful work with visible business impact
Direct collaboration with decision-makers across the organization
The opportunity to build applications, automation, analytics, and reporting solutions—not just dashboards
Exposure to a wide variety of business challenges, technologies, and projects
A collaborative, entrepreneurial culture that encourages innovation and continuous improvement
Real autonomy, ownership, and opportunities for professional growth

 

If you're someone who enjoys solving problems, learning new technologies, and seeing your work make a difference, you'll fit right in.

 

Weston Forest – “You’ll Love Doing Business with Us”

 

WHO WE ARE:

 

Weston Forest is more than a distributor and remanufacturer of wood products—we're a trusted partner committed to empowering our customers' success.

 

Since 1953, we've grown from a family-owned business into one of North America's leading distributors of industrial wood products, panel products, custom packaging, and supply chain solutions. Every day, we help our customers Build, Package, and Deliver through innovative products, value-added services, and technology-driven solutions.

 

Our success is built on long-term partnerships, entrepreneurial thinking, and a commitment to continuous improvement. We're proud to be recognized as:

 

One of Canada's Best Managed Companies
A Great Place to Work®
Recipient of Canada's Most Admired Corporate Cultures Award
Canadian Business Excellence Award for Private Businesses recipient

 

At Weston Forest, we're investing in technology, analytics, and digital transformation to support the future of our business—and we're looking for talented people who want to help shape that future.

 

OUR CULTURE:

 

Our values guide everything we do.

 

People & Safety – Results matter, but people matter more.
Entrepreneurial Spirit – We continuously improve and embrace innovation.
Integrity – We do what we say.
Growth – We inspire personal and professional development.
Partnership – Your success is our success.
Community – More than just a place to work.

 

Our vision is simple: to be the right partner for our employees, customers, and suppliers.

 

READY TO JOIN US?

 

If you're passionate about solving business problems with technology and enjoy building practical, user-focused solutions that make a real impact, we'd love to hear from you.

 

Apply today and help shape the future of analytics, automation, and business technology at Weston Forest.

 

Equal Opportunity Employer

 

Weston Forest is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, barrier-free recruitment process and work environment. If you require accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process, please advise Human Resources. Any information received relating to accommodation will be treated confidentially.

One day you might be designing an interactive dashboard for Sales. The next you could be developing an internal application to automate a manual process, improving data pipelines for Operations, or building reporting tools that help leaders make better business decisions.


If you're energized by variety, enjoy working across different business functions, and like seeing your work make an immediate impact, we'd love to hear from you.

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

 

As part of Weston Forest's Data Analytics team, you'll work closely with leaders across Sales, Operations, Finance, Purchasing, Inventory, Production, Credit, and other business areas to design and deliver innovative analytics and business solutions.

 

No two days are exactly alike. You'll have the opportunity to work on a wide variety of projects spanning analytics, application development, automation, business intelligence, and emerging technologies.

 

Your responsibilities will include:


  • Partnering with business stakeholders to understand challenges, gather requirements, and recommend practical technology solutions
  • Collaborate on the design and solution architecture of business, application, and data solutions, leveraging existing platforms, standards, and best practices to deliver consistent, scalable solutions.
  • Designing and developing intuitive business applications, dashboards, portals, and reporting solutions that present complex information in a clear, visually compelling manner, enabling faster and more informed business decisions.
  • Building automation tools that eliminate manual processes and improve productivity
  • Developing analytics solutions using SQL, Power BI, Python, and other technologies
  • Creating and maintaining reliable data integrations, reporting datasets, and semantic models
  • Supporting enterprise reporting, business intelligence, and data governance initiatives
  • Evaluating emerging technologies such as AI and machine learning where they provide measurable business value
  • Participating in solution design, testing, deployment, documentation, user training, and ongoing support
  • Continuously improving existing analytics and business solutions across the organization

 

WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE DIFFERENT:

 

Unlike many analytics positions, this role isn't limited to building reports or maintaining dashboards.

 

You'll have the opportunity to work across the full solution lifecycle—from understanding business challenges and gathering requirements to designing applications, developing automation, integrating data, creating analytics, and supporting users after implementation.

 

This is an opportunity to become a trusted technology partner to business leaders while helping shape Weston Forest's digital transformation and analytics strategy.

 

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

 

We're interested in curious people who enjoy learning, solving problems, and building practical business solutions.

 

You'll likely be successful if you have:


  • A degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Software Engineering, Business Analytics, Mathematics, or a related field
  • Three (3) or more years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, software development, data engineering, or a similar role
  • Strong SQL, Python, Microsoft Excel (including Power Query), and Power BI skills.
  • Experience designing and developing dashboards, business applications, and reporting solutions.
  • Experience with APIs, system integrations, and Git or other source control systems.
  • Experience with ETL/ELT processes, relational databases, and data warehousing.
  • Experience working directly with business users to gather requirements and deliver practical technology solutions
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences
  • A passion for continuous improvement and delivering practical business solutions that create measurable value

 

NICE TO HAVE:

 

Experience with any of the following would be considered an asset:


· Experience applying AI technologies to practical business problems.

· Experience with AWS or similar cloud platforms.

· Experience with web technologies (e.g., HTML, CSS, JavaScript).

WHY JOIN WESTON FOREST?

 

At Weston Forest, technology isn't just a support function—it's an enabler of business transformation.

Rather than being assigned a narrow area of responsibility, you'll have the opportunity to contribute across a broad range of initiatives, helping shape how analytics, automation, and technology are used throughout the business.

Title: Business Intelligence Analyst
Company: College of Massage Therapists of Ontario
Description:
WHO WE ARE

The College of Massage Therapists of Ontario (CMTO) is a progressive regulatory body dedicated to protecting the public interest by upholding the highest standards for Registered Massage Therapists (RMTs). We hold RMT’s accountable for providing safe, ethical, and high-quality Massage Therapy care to the public.




At CMTO, we are dedicated to excellence in protecting the public interest, guiding registrants, and promoting the highest possible quality of the practice of Massage Therapy.




WORKING @ CMTO

This full-time, permanent position offers a competitive annual salary, a comprehensive benefits package, RRSP matching, and a professional development fund. At CMTO, we foster a collaborative team culture and a strong commitment to our mission. Our flexible, remote-first work environment allows staff to work remotely most of the time, while our office—located centrally, steps from TTC—is available when needed.

If you are looking to build a meaningful career in a highly varied role within a non-profit, regulatory organization, we want to meet you!




ABOUT THE ROLE

CMTO is seeking a Business Intelligence (BI) Analyst to support the transformation of complex data into clear, actionable insights to drive the College forward. The BI Analyst reports to the Manager, Projects and Data Analytics, provides insights that support regulatory operations, organizational performance and strategic decision-making.




KEY DUTIES

Collect, extract, integrate and analyze data from multiple sources to identify emerging risks.
Translate complex analytical findings into meaningful insights and practical recommendations tailored to technical and non-technical audiences.
Design and create impactful visualizations, dashboards, and reports using Microsoft Power BI to clearly communicate key business insights to stakeholders.
Develop and maintain data governance standards, reports, business terminology and data dictionaries to promote consistency, accuracy and standardization.
Investigate data quality issues, identify root causes and work collaboratively with organization teams to implement corrective actions and improvements.
Partner with business leaders to define KPIs, metrics, reporting requirements and analytical priorities.
Develop and maintain datasets, semantic models, dashboards and reporting solutions leveraging CMTO's Microsoft Azure Data Lakehouse environment to support enterprise reporting, analytics and decision-making.
Perform data validation, reconciliation and quality assurance projects to ensure the integrity, usability and reliability of organizational data used for reporting and analysis.
Support adoption of Power BI and self-service through user training, documentation, coaching and reporting best practices.
Identify opportunities to automate data collection, reporting and analytical processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.
Present analytical findings, trends and recommendations to senior leadership and organizational teams to support discussions and planning.




SKILLS

Advanced analytical, critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
Skilled in developing dashboards, reports and data visualizations and data storytelling.
Ability to translate data into actionable business insights and present findings.
Excellent organizational and time management skills.
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Demonstrated ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment;
Ability to work independently and contribute effectively within a team.
Adaptability and continuous improvement mindset.




QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor’s degree in mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, or equivalent business experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence or related field.
Minimum of 5 years of professional experience with at least 3 years of specialization in business intelligence or data analytics.
Expertise in designing, developing and maintaining Power BI dashboards, reports, semantic models and performance measurement frameworks.
Experience working with enterprise data platforms including Microsoft Azure Data Lakehouse, data pipelines, semantic models and Power BI reporting environments.
Experience with ETL processes, cloud-based storage solutions, and advanced Excel.
Knowledge of Microsoft Azure Data Lakehouse architecture, data engineering concepts, cloud-based analytics platforms, and emerging AI-enabled analytics capabilities.
Proficiency in SQL and data modeling, with experience using Python or other analytical programming languages.
Familiarity with data integration tools and AI-driven analytics is an asset.




LIFE at CMTO

Compensation and Time Off

Hiring salary: $90,000 - $100,000
15 vacation days plus 4 personal days
Office closure every year from December 25 to January 1




Benefits & Support

Group benefits starting on your first day
Health Care Spending Account
Annual professional development funding
Group Retirement Savings Plan
Maternity and parental leave top-up program




Work Environment

Remote-first workplace with in-office expectations 2 times per month on average
Collaborative, collegial team culture
Office located at 175 Bloor Street East, Toronto with easy transit and parking access




INTERESTED?

To be considered, apply online or via email to resumes@cmto.com on or before September 11, 2026. Please state the job posting title and your name in the subject line of the email.

All application reviews, assessments, and hiring decisions are made by people in accordance with Ontario employment and human rights laws.




CMTO is committed to equity, diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunity. We welcome applicants from all communities, including people of all religions, ethnicities, and racial backgrounds; persons with disabilities; LGBTQ2S+ communities; women; Indigenous Peoples; and anyone who may contribute to the diversity of perspectives within our organization.




CMTO upholds the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA). Title: Revenue Operations Analyst II
Description:
Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest.

About The Team

We're looking for a curious, driven analyst to join our Revenue Operations team. Revenue Operations serves as the backbone of the Revenue organization at Affirm. We follow a data-driven approach that combines elements of strategy, systems, process, and analytics to align go-to-market motions across the organization.

About The Role

As a Revenue Operations Analyst II, you will be a key partner to our Marketing, Business Development, and early Sales teams - focused on making the top of the funnel predictable, clean, and scalable. You'll design and optimize the processes, automation, and tooling that govern how leads, contacts, and accounts enter the revenue funnel, ensuring downstream teams can execute with confidence. The ideal candidate is equal parts tactical, building automation and workflows, and strategic thinking through lifecycle design, routing logic, and coverage models that scale with the business.

What You'll Do


Design and optimize top of funnel merchant lifecycle processes — from Marketing touch through Contact creation, Account readiness, and Discovery handoff — with an emphasis on automation, data quality, and clear documentation
Own and define lead routing logic, automation triggers, and lifecycle dependencies that govern how leads and accounts move through the top of funnel; partner with Business Systems for implementation
Own cross-functional initiatives end to end — managing stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Partnerships, Legal, Product, Revenue Ops, Analytics, and others
Support attribution tracking and funnel conversion analysis for Marketing, BDA, and early funnel performance to surface actionable insights
Own workflow automations (e.g., Slack notifications, cross-tool workflows, process triggers) that improve speed-to-lead and reduce manual work
Collaborate with the Business Systems team to improve Salesforce and adjacent GTM tooling for lead and account management efficiency; define processes to ensure data integrity at funnel entry
Partner with Revenue Enablement to train and support revenue teams on top of funnel processes and tooling changes


What We Look For


BA/BS or equivalent 4-year degree required
2+ years of revenue operations, sales operations, or marketing operations experience
Proficiency in Salesforce (experience as an administrator is a plus); familiarity with marketing automation platforms (e.g., Pardot, HubSpot)
Mastery of Excel / Google Sheets and a solid understanding of business intelligence tools
Experience with lead lifecycle management, lead routing tools (e.g., RingLead, LeanData), data enrichment tools (e.g., Clay, Zoominfo), or lead scoring and attribution frameworks is preferred
Proven ability to manage and maintain relationships with key stakeholders in a fast-paced environment, ensuring alignment and engagement throughout projects
Prior experience in data analysis, reporting, and funnel performance measurement
A strong sense of organization, a growth mentality, and a bias toward documenting and systematizing repeatable processes


Pay Grade - H

Equity Grade - 3

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

CAN base pay range per year: $77,000 - $127,000

Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company! The majority of our roles are remote and you can work almost anywhere within the country of employment. Affirmers in proximal roles have the flexibility to work remotely, but will occasionally be required to work out of their assigned Affirm office. A limited number of roles remain office-based due to the nature of their job responsibilities.

Benefits

We’re extremely proud to offer competitive benefits that are anchored to our core value of people come first. Some key highlights of our benefits package include:


Health care coverage - Affirm covers all premiums for all levels of coverage for you and your dependents
Flexible Spending Wallets - generous stipends for spending on Technology, Food, various Lifestyle needs, and family forming expenses
Time off - competitive vacation and holiday schedules allowing you to take time off to rest and recharge
ESPP - An employee stock purchase plan enabling you to buy shares of Affirm at a discount


We believe It’s On Us to provide an inclusive interview experience for all, including people with disabilities. We are happy to provide reasonable accommodations to candidates in need of individualized support during the hiring process.

[For U.S. positions that could be performed in Los Angeles or San Francisco] Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, Affirm will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and hereby freely and unambiguously give informed consent to the collection, processing, use, and storage of your personal information as described therein.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Vretta is looking for a Data Analyst to join our Data and Evaluation team. This position requires excellent communication skills, creative problem solving ability, and a sound technical ability to be able to understand requirements, develop technological solutions for data analysis, collaborate with the data engineering and development team, and maintain processes that support student learning and assessment. As a member of the Data and Evaluation team at Vretta, the Data Analyst must have the attitude and energy to innovate and build solutions that support student success.

Responsibilities


Validate technical requirements and communicate implementation strategies.
Develop APIs in collaboration with Instructional Designers, Data Engineers, and other members of the development and technical team to deliver projects.
Document APIs, especially in relation to the underlying data model.
Use existing code components to implement new projects.
Maintain and modify existing APIs.
Debug, test, and deploy software implementations.
Interact with key partners and internal users regarding timelines, technical issues, and infrastructure integration.
Provide recommendations for improvements in the overall development process.
Ensure work progress to schedule and keep (internal) customers informed of project progress.
Stay current with relevant research, techniques, technology, and other factors impacting the job.


Requirements


At least two years experience in software development.
Undergraduate degree in Computer Science (or equivalent).
Experience with modern Javascript (server-side javascript, package management, module loading).
Experience with R
Experience with REST APIs
Strong experience writing & understanding complex SQL queries
Ability to effectively communicate technical concepts to other technical staff members.
Superior time management skills, and the ability to prioritize tasks with minimal supervision.
High level of critical and logical thinking, analysis, and/or reasoning to identify underlying principles, reasons, or facts.


Experience With Any Of The Following Is An Asset


TypeScript
WebPack
MySQL, MariaDB
Linear Optimization
Statistical Techniques
Data modeling
Automated testing


About Vretta

Vretta is a multi-award winning organization that specializes in delivering assessment and learning experiences that support student-success at the primary, secondary, and post-secondary educational levels.

With over a decade of research and dedication in understanding how students succeed by interacting with rich and engaging technology-enhanced assessments, Vretta specializes in the innovative use of assessments to provide greater equity and strengthen the skills of students. We focus on modernizing assessment and learning solutions through creative design, backed by psychometric precision, delivering reliable, flexible and equitable learning and assessment experiences for students, educators, and administrators.

Applying

We are always looking for exceptional talent to join our team. This posting is intended to build a candidate pool for upcoming opportunities at Vretta. While we thank all applicants for their interest, only those selected for an interview will be contacted. If you are interviewed for this position, Vretta will provide you with a status update in compliance with the Employment Standards Act. Vretta is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for people with disabilities. If you require an accommodation, we will work with you to meet your needs, in all stages of the hiring process, within reason.

To stay in touch with Vretta and keep up-to-date on all open opportunities, follow us on LinkedIn, Facebook, and Twitter!

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Requisition ID: 269197

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

Team

The Data team within Global Finance & Risk Technology (GFRT) provides enterprise-level analytics, data services, governance support, and operational data management for Global Finance initiatives. The team plays a critical role in supporting financial close processes, financial reporting, data migration initiatives, system implementations, and ongoing operational activities while ensuring the delivery of high-quality Financial Data Management, Data Analysis, Data Quality, and Data Governance services across the organization.

Role


We are seeking a Data Analyst to support business operations through data analysis, reporting, process improvement, system implementation, and operational support activities.
The role is responsible for delivering analytical insights, managing data migration initiatives, supporting financial and operational processes, and developing solutions that improve efficiency, accuracy, and control effectiveness.
Working closely with business stakeholders, operations teams, finance partners, and technology teams, the position plays a key role in maintaining data integrity, supporting system transitions, and ensuring successful business outcomes.
The successful candidate will combine strong technical expertise in data engineering, programming, data analysis, data modeling, and database design with a solid understanding of finance, accounting, and operational processes.
This individual must be highly analytical, proactive, detail-oriented, and capable of working effectively with stakeholders across Finance, Operations, Technology, and Vendor teams. Experience supporting system implementations, data migrations, financial reconciliations, and process automation initiatives is highly desirable.


What will we expect from you?

Data Analysis & Reporting


Collect, validate, analyze, and interpret data from multiple business systems.
Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, and performance metrics to support decision-making.
Conduct ad hoc analysis and provide actionable recommendations to stakeholders.
Monitor data quality, identify anomalies, and investigate discrepancies.


Process Improvement & Automation


Identify opportunities to streamline and automate operational processes.
Develop and maintain reporting, reconciliation, and analytical solutions.
Support the implementation of process enhancements, system upgrades, and operational efficiencies.
Create and maintain process documentation, user guides, and operational procedures.


Data Migration & System Implementation


Support data migration initiatives involving the transition from legacy systems and local ledgers to enterprise platforms, including PeopleSoft 9.2 (PS92).
Coordinate data extraction, validation, transformation, and loading activities.
Establish and validate historical balances and reference data within the new system environment.
Perform reconciliation activities to ensure completeness and accuracy between source and target systems.
Collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to resolve migration and conversion issues.
Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT), parallel runs, production readiness, and go-live activities.
Provide post-implementation support, including issue investigation, defect resolution, process stabilization, and end-user assistance following deployment.


Stakeholder Management & Governance


Partner with business, operations, finance, and technology teams to gather requirements and deliver solutions.
Communicate findings, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders and management.
Support audit requests, control testing, and regulatory compliance requirements.
Maintain strong governance and control practices over data, reporting, and operational processes.


Operational Support


Support day-to-day operational and financial processes.
Prepare, review, and coordinate special entries, adjustments, corrections, and related operational transactions.
Investigate, resolve, and escalate operational issues as required.
Perform reconciliations and exception analysis to ensure data accuracy and completeness.
Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end operational activities.


What You Will Bring To Succeed


Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Accounting, Computer Science, Information Systems, Analytics, or a related field.
3 years of experience in data analysis, reporting, operations support, technology, or a related field.
Strong foundational knowledge of:
SQL and data analysis
Microsoft Excel and data manipulation
Reporting and dashboard development
Basic understanding of:
Database concepts and data structures
Data validation, reconciliation, and quality control processes
Software development or data engineering fundamentals
Experience through work, internships, co-op placements, or academic projects with:
Data analysis and reporting
Large datasets and data-driven decision-making
Process improvement or automation initiatives

Ability To


Analyze data and identify trends, issues, and anomalies
Translate business requirements into analytical solutions
Support testing, implementation, and operational activities
Learn new technologies and business processes quickly
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to work effectively both independently and within a team environment.


Nice-to-Have Skills


Python, ACL, SAS, VBA, or similar scripting and automation tools
BI and visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, OBIEE, ThoughtSpot)
ETL tools (DataStage, Informatica, or equivalent)
OFSAA or other financial data management platforms


Exposure To


Chart of Accounts (CoA/CoFA) design and financial hierarchies
Regulatory reporting and risk data environments
Data lineage, metadata repositories, and governance frameworks
PeopleSoft 9.2 (PS92) or comparable ERP platforms
Experience supporting:
Financial system migrations and ledger conversions
Financial Close processes
Audit and regulatory compliance initiatives


Soft Skills Required


Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset with the ability to resolve complex data and operational issues.
Highly detail-oriented with a focus on data accuracy, integrity, and control effectiveness.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across business and technology teams.
Ability to work proactively and independently in a fast-paced environment.
Strong collaboration skills with cross-functional teams and external partners.
Effective prioritization, organization, and multitasking abilities.
Demonstrated adaptability and willingness to learn new technologies and business processes.
Reflective and open-minded attitude, with the ability to incorporate feedback for continuous personal and professional growth.
Strong documentation, governance, and process management capabilities.


The Workplace


We are technology partners who help the business transform how our employees around the world work
We have an inclusive and collaborative working environment that encourages creativity, curiosity, and celebrates success!
You'll get to work with and learn from diverse industry leaders, who have hailed from top technology companies around the world
We foster an environment of innovation and continuous learning
We care about our people, allowing them to design how they work to deliver amazing results
We offer a competitive total rewards package, including a performance bonus, company matching programs (on pension & profit sharing), and generous vacation

Title: Senior Analyst, Marketing
Description:
Why Meridian?

At Meridian our aspiration is to integrate our purpose into everything we do for people, the planet, and communities. We believe that our greatest opportunity is to create opportunity and meet people where they are.

Factor us into your next career opportunity. We want you to grow with us and have an experience that’s different. This is a place where you can expect the unexpected.

Find our story here: About Meridian

The role: The Senior Marketing Analyst provides proactive, actionable, analytical support and business insight to

marketing department, as well as their stakeholders (LOBs). The role will have significant impact on Meridian’s marketing strategy, as they are responsible for segmenting, deploying and executing the communication of marketing campaigns, product launches and focused research. As a subject matter expert, the Senior Marketing Analyst demonstrates an ability to present complicated analytical material in a concise and compelling manner and, interpret insights in a meaningful way for

management and partners.

The role will support the advancement of analytics and data management, processes, and tools to contribute to the achievement of Meridian’s strategic and in year goals and improve business profitability. In partnership with colleagues, this role will maintain existing marketing reporting while working to improve and refine processes through the integration of AI and automation.

This is an 18 Month Contract opportunity

Key Responsibilities

Analysis & Insights


Measure the effectiveness of Marketing tactics (paid, organic, brand, email, website, social etc.) while you partner with the marketing team to set goals, measure results, and share actionable insights. Build and develop models that help to accelerate marketing’s long term strategic plans.
Analyze, prepare and present scheduled reports (i.e. key business performance indicators, and dashboards) and ad hoc reports (i.e. in support of organizational projects or initiatives) for the marketing team, both proactively and upon request.
Lead the development of management reporting that empowers leaders to take action, by converting data into meaningful information that identifies issues, opportunities and emerging trends.
Foster cross-functional collaboration across all MCU departments—particularly with Enterprise Analytics & Data, Data Governance and Culture, Member Experience Services, and Sales—to streamline communication, gather data, define terms and conditions, and consolidate information from multiple platforms into a centralized source for segmentation and reporting.
Leads qualitative and quantitative analysis of relevant industry and consumer behaviour trends to identify revenue opportunities and grow our capital base.
Assists with the development of various programs by collecting, analysing and collating Member and prospect information ensuring that Meridian delivers a personalized solution that is in relation to their transactional, advice or price-driven relationships while also considering long-term Member value.
Analyze prospect and Member-level information to determine the effectiveness of campaigns and generate additional profitability-enhancing strategies
Networks with other like-minded individuals within the Enterprise Analytics and Data community at Meridian, as well as industry events, to keep abreast of new solutions, resources, and analytical techniques


Execution


Employ Marketing experiments, test-and-learns, A-B testing, etc, with the focus to continually improve our Member experience and increasing KPIs such as response rates, balance growth and cross-sell
Identify key business opportunities for growth by profiling the existing Member base and assessing emerging needs through industry research and competitive analysis.
Proficient in leveraging diverse marketing deployment platforms (e.g., Acoustic, Dynamics, Soapbox, internal banking systems, Google, Meta) to scope, segment, and prepare audience lists, ensuring accurate and timely system integration and deployments.
Primary lead on verifying data quality, personalization, and quality execution across all transactional and Marketing communications and journeys. Ensuring adherence to industry regulations such as CASL & PII.
Collaborate with Enterprise Analytics team to develop models such as product profitability or propensity models
Support the improvement of marketing attribution using tools such as marketing mix modeling and multi-touch attribution


Communication & Business Solutions


Demonstrated ability to work with all levels of the organization (operational staff to Executive to Board of Directors) and the ability to obtain required information to support or develop analysis.
Interprets results and delivers information and/or presentations with impact
Effectively demonstrates the ability to explain complex information and concepts to different audiences, including professionals in a manner tailored to the audience and elicits receptivity
Coordinates the acquisition of data from various, relevant data sources and applies analytical skills to convert data into meaningful information.
Demonstrates an ability to leverage technology to streamline processes, tools and analysis and seeks out opportunities to leverage AI and other automation tools to increase department efficiency
Support CRM in partnership with Centre of Excellence on future enhancements and capabilities within the platform.
Review key marketing strategies to collect requirements and design solutions with marketing operations, IT and Digital teams, ensuring the necessary data is integrated into various platforms, such as CRM (Dynamics 365), to support the operation of marketing journeys, processes, and campaign measurement.
In partnership with Marketing Operations, conduct User Acceptance (UAT) and Post-Production testing to ensure proposed solutions work as intended.


Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities


Strong working knowledge of an analytics stack, working with analytics tools, data warehouses and data visualization tools
Strong financial acumen, excellent interpersonal skills and ability interacting with all levels of the organization, including Executive management
Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills. Ability to communicate detailed information in an impactful way
Strong process management skills, initiative, ability to manage competing priorities and attention to detail are critical
Technical writing experience in relevant areas, including queries, reports, and presentations
High level of proficiency in designing & developing custom analytics utilizing available or externally obtained data
Business and partnership focused with an understanding of how Marketing enables the business
Aptitude for investigating complex problems and a passion for creative problem-solving. Continuously innovates to achieve great results
A strong business acumen and can translate insights into actionable recommendations that align with business objectives
Ability to establish strong cross functional relationships with proven track record of working successfully with a divergent group of internal business partners
Highly motivated self-starter with high energy and a very positive attitude
Desire to propose changes that proactively seize market opportunities
Forward thinking with an openness to change to identify new opportunities
Ability to work independently and in a team-oriented environment
Possess a strong attention to detail; be concise without comprising the facts
Experience coaching and mentoring junior teammates
Able to handle confidential and proprietary information with discretion
Member Focus - Personally demonstrating that our Members are our highest priority.
Comfort learning and adopting new digital tools, with an openness to using AI‑enabled technology to enhance productivity, accuracy, and the Member experience


Education, Work Experience, And Professional Designations/Certifications


Degree or diploma in mathematics, statistics or computer science or related discipline
Experience in a financial institution environment with a strong understanding of financial metrics, segmentation and industry drivers.
Five (5+) years' in an analytics driven role with proven analytic skills, including mining, evaluation, analysis, and visualization (ability to analyse large datasets)
Strong SQL and PySpark skills in Fabric environment required, with the ability to learn other analytic tools
Practical experience in statistical analysis through the use of statistical packages including Excel, Power BI and SAS
Working experience in digital analytics using Google Analytics, and Data Studio.
Expert in diverse marketing deployment platforms (e.g., Acoustic, Dynamics, Soapbox, Google, Meta)
Demonstrated experience working in scripting languages such as Python or R, VBA, to set up automation and integrations is considered an asset.


This role represents an existing vacancy. Internal candidates are being considered as part of our standard process.

Salary Range: $59,800.00 to $89,800.00 CAD

Compensation for this role is based on a combination of skills, experience, and internal equity. Candidates with stronger alignment to the role’s requirements may be placed higher within the range. Your recruiter will share more information about our total rewards package during the hiring process.

Office Location: This is a hybrid work opportunity with the option to work from Toronto Corporate Office or St. Catharines office.

Meridian has a remote work policy that allows flexibility for employees to work remotely but also requires a minimum of one day per week in the office for purposeful meetings to collaborate, innovate, and build effective relationships with your team, your colleagues, and your leader, which is important to us.

What’s in it for you?


We have an inclusive and collaborative working environment that encourages teamwork, creativity, curiosity, and celebrates success.
We provide you with the tools and technology needed to delight your candidates and clients.
You will get to work with and learn from diverse industry leaders and colleagues, who have hailed from top organizations.
Hybrid work arrangements with in-person office time to collaborate, innovate, and build relationships with your colleagues.
This is not your typical “corporate” job. We work hard and we have fun!


Build the Future of Banking with Us

At Meridian, we’re not just adapting to the future—we’re shaping it. We see talent as a catalyst for sustainable growth, community impact, and future-readiness. As the financial landscape evolves, we’re looking for team members who bring:


Embedding & leveraging technology – Confidence and willingness to learn and integrate AI and emerging technologies into new ways of working. Experience with low/no code tools like the Microsoft Power Platform and generative AI productivity tools like Microsoft Copilot is considered an asset
Critical Thinking – The ability to analyze, evaluate and interpret information from various sources and apply logic and problem solving to make decisions.
Data Driven– Leverage data and insights to identify, prioritize and improve member experience and business efficiency.
Curiosity & Flexibility – Comfortable navigating and embracing change and uncertainty, ask more questions, explore more options. Continuously learn and grow.


Experience the Difference!

Meridian committed to promoting an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected and supported. We are dedicated to employing a workforce that reflects the diversity of our communities and Members in which we live and serve.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, or disability.

Please note that due to the volume of applications, only those under consideration will be contacted for an interview.

Thank you for your interest in Meridian Credit Union.

Follow us on Twitter at

@MeridianCareers

Connect with us on LinkedIn

Meridian only posts jobs on our official Careers Site, LinkedIn, and Indeed. If you find a Meridian job posting on any other site, please verify it by ensuring it directs back to our official career page. Meridian never asks candidates to apply through third‑party links that do not redirect to our Careers portal (UltiPro). For more tips on how to protect yourself from job scams visit Protect yourself from job scams | Meridian.

Title: People Analytics & Automation Specialist
Description:
About Opendoor

At Opendoor our mission is to tilt the world in favor of homeowners and those who aim to become one. Homeownership matters. It's how people build wealth, stability, and community. It's how families put down roots, how neighborhoods strengthen, how the future gets built. We're building the modern system of homeownership giving people the freedom to buy and sell on their own terms. We’ve built an end-to-end online experience that has already helped thousands of people and we’re just getting started.

About The Role

Opendoor's People team is scaling how we use data and AI to drive compensation strategy, recruiting operations, and overall HR decision-making. We are looking for a hands-on People Analytics & Automation Specialist to help us bridge the gap between complex data and strategic action.

This role prioritizes hands-on AI capability. We are looking for someone who has built agents and automations. Alongside that, a strong data mindset, the ability to handle confidential projects with high discretion, and a growth orientation. Compensation experience is not required, and we are open to candidates from diverse analytical backgrounds who are eager to learn it.

What You'll Do


AI Agents & Enablement: Design, build, and ship agents and AI-driven workflows for compensation and People Operations. Job evaluation support, offer recommendation modelling, market data analysis, comp cycle preparation.
Dashboards & Reporting: Build and maintain dashboards and reporting for People Operations / Total Rewards (headcount, leveling, compensation analytics) and, where it overlaps, for Talent Acquisition (open requisitions, recruiting funnel and conversion), so leadership has current, trustworthy data ahead of every planning cycle.
Compensation & Leveling: Own the execution side of compensation and leveling projects, comp benchmarking, market studies, leveling structures, and equity or compensation scenario planning, using an established methodology.
Process Automation: Automate recurring People Operations work that currently eats up disproportionate time, equity grant approvals, comp cycle prep, headcount tracking, and other reporting that shouldn't take as long as it does.
TA Analytics Support: Act as a dotted-line analytics partner to Ariana and Talent Acquisition, helping surface insights like compensation-related offer rejections or band placement of recent hires, and supporting the TA team's own data storytelling when priorities overlap.
Systems & Data Quality: Work alongside the Rippling/HRIS administrator to build automations on top of Rippling, and help close data-quality and integration gaps as the team's data infrastructure matures.
Data Storytelling: Translate raw people and compensation data into clear, decision-ready narratives for leadership. This is as much a storytelling role as a data-building one.
Proactive Planning: Get ahead of the calendar by building and testing the automations and dashboards needed for major HR cycles (the upcoming mid-year comp review, annual market study, open enrollment) before they're needed, rather than under pressure.


What You'll Need


You have designed and shipped an AI agent or automated workflow that other people actually use. We will ask you to walk through it in detail: what you built, where you placed human approval gates, what you iterated on, and what broke.
A genuine data mindset and growth orientation. Backgrounds in analytical functions that involve sensitive or complex data are all strong fits.
High discretion and sound judgment. This role regularly touches confidential compensation and people data, and experience managing confidential projects (financial, M&A, or similar) is more important than a specific comp title.
Strong data storytelling and communication skills, able to turn a data set into a clear, persuasive point for an executive audience.
Comfort with Google Sheets (our primary working tool for comp data) and general data/BI fluency; SQL or Snowflake experience is a plus as we build toward more automated data infrastructure, but not required today.
Familiarity with an HRIS (Rippling or similar), comp survey platforms (AON Radford, Mercer, or similar), and equity administration tools (Equity Edge or similar) is a strong plus, not a requirement, and can be learned on the job.
Ability to work independently across two sets of priorities (People Operations/Total Rewards as the primary focus, with lighter-touch support to Talent Acquisition) and to prioritize when demands compete.


Location

This role is based in one of our offices, in-person four days per week. We're looking for candidates who are enthusiastic about an in-office culture; people who want to build alongside their teammates, not from a distance.

Title: Manager, eCommerce Analytics & Insights
Description:
Established in 1973, Roots is a proudly Canadian lifestyle brand that celebrates authenticity, quality, and community. Inspired by the great outdoors, we create timeless, sustainable apparel and leather goods designed for comfort and everyday adventure. At Roots, we believe in fostering a culture of inclusivity, creativity, and teamwork – where every team member plays a role in shaping our brand’s legacy. If you bring passion to everything you do, lead with integrity, and believe in the power of collaboration to drive growth, we’d love to have you on our journey!

Nature & Scope → Your Role at Roots

You'll play a key analytical role behind Roots' digital business — turning ecommerce data into the insights that drive strategy, sharpen investment decisions, and support growth online. You're not just tracking what happened; you're helping the business understand why, and what to do next. Sitting at the intersection of Ecommerce, Marketing, and Analytics, you'll own the reporting rhythms, build the forecasts, and surface the opportunities that keep Roots' digital channel moving forward. This is a high-visibility role for someone who is commercially sharp, deeply curious, and passionate about connecting data to real business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities → How You’ll Make An Impact


Act as a key analytics partner for the Ecommerce and digital leadership team — proactively identifying trends, flagging risks, and providing insights to support decision-making.
Deliver the ecommerce performance reporting rhythm — including weekly trading dashboards, channel health reporting, and monthly and quarterly recaps — to support leadership visibility into the digital business.
Define, track, and evolve the KPI framework for ecommerce — including traffic, conversion, AOV, channel mix, and customer acquisition metrics — and translate performance into clear commercial narratives.
Develop and maintain ecommerce forecasts to support planning cycles and investment discussions, including weekly, monthly, and seasonal demand forecasts by channel, category, and key business driver.
Own the hindsighting process for ecommerce — conducting structured post-period reviews that compare actuals to plan, identify what drove variance, and translate learnings into sharper forecasts and better commercial decisions going forward.
Analyze the full digital funnel — from traffic source through to purchase — identifying drop-off points, conversion opportunities, and UX issues that can be acted on by the Ecom and product teams.
Partner with Paid Media, CRM, and Brand Marketing to evaluate campaign and channel effectiveness, connecting marketing spend to revenue outcomes and helping teams optimize where investment is deployed.
Monitor and interpret customer behaviour on-site — including search performance, product page engagement, wishlist trends, and mobile vs. desktop patterns — to surface assortment and experience insights.
Support the A/B testing and experimentation program — helping teams design tests, measure results rigorously, and build a culture of evidence-based iteration.
Answer the hard business questions through ad-hoc analysis — whether it's diagnosing a conversion drop, sizing a new market opportunity, or understanding the true ROI of a promotional event.
Build and maintain Power BI dashboards that give the Ecom and Marketing teams self-serve visibility into their most important KPIs — without needing to pull a report themselves.
Leverage AI and analytics tools to improve the speed, accuracy, and depth of insight generation — and bring a forward-looking perspective on where automation and machine learning can strengthen our ecommerce analytics capability.


Required

Qualifications & Experience → The Skills You Bring


6+ years of experience in ecommerce analytics, digital analytics, or a closely related field, ideally within retail or a consumer brand environment.
Deep understanding of ecommerce performance drivers — traffic, conversion, AOV, channel mix, customer acquisition, and retention — and proven ability to connect metrics to commercial outcomes.
Strong experience with BI tools (Power BI preferred) building dashboards and reports that stakeholders use consistently.
Proficiency with web analytics platforms (GA4 preferred) and the ability to interpret customer journey data across the full digital funnel.
Experience building and maintaining ecommerce forecasts and sales planning models, including seasonal and weekly demand forecasting.
Comfort with hindsighting and post-period analysis — able to close the loop between plan and actuals and turn variance analysis into forward-looking recommendations.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated experience presenting to commercial and executive audiences.
Ability to synthesize complex data into clear, decision-ready narratives for non-technical stakeholders.


Nice to Have


SQL or Python experience for self-serve data exploration and more complex analyses.
Familiarity with paid media platforms (Meta, Google, TikTok) and experience evaluating their performance holistically — beyond platform-reported metrics.
Experience with Snowflake or similar cloud data platforms.
Background in omnichannel retail — understanding how digital behaviour connects to in-store and loyalty outcomes.


You Are


A storyteller first — you know that a great insight is only as valuable as how well it's communicated.
Proactive and commercially minded, always connecting data back to business outcomes and growth opportunities.
Naturally curious and relentlessly diagnostic — you're never satisfied with "what happened" and always dig into the "why" to uncover the insight behind the number.
Organized and delivery-focused, able to manage a reporting cadence, a forecast cycle, and ad-hoc requests at the same time without dropping the ball.
Comfortable with ambiguity and skilled at prioritizing the questions that matter most in a fast-moving retail environment.


At Roots we appreciate that skills and expertise are cultivated through a range of experiences. We are committed to reflecting Canada's diverse landscape in our products, team, and workplace culture. We value your unique perspective and encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every listed requirement. Accommodations are available for applicants throughout the recruitment process.

Please note: Roots uses technology-assisted tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support parts of the recruitment process. These tools may be used to help review applications, assess qualifications, and support interview documentation. All hiring decisions are reviewed and made by our Talent team and key leaders involved in the recruitment process.

The posted salary range is intended to reflect the competitive market value of this role and is provided to support transparency in our hiring process. Final compensation will be determined based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to internal equity, relevant skills, demonstrated knowledge, experience, and overall fit for the position.
