Title: Pricing Analyst
Description:
Clio is the global leader in legal AI technology, empowering legal professionals and law firms of every size to work smarter, faster, and more securely.

We are transforming the legal experience for all by bettering the lives of legal professionals while increasing access to justice.

Summary:

We are currently seeking a Pricing Analyst to join our Marketing Team in Vancouver, Calgary, or Toronto.

What your team does:

The Monetization team leads Clio’s AI-first pricing and packaging strategy and execution across all regions, including initiatives for new and existing customer segments, products, plans, bundles and cross-portfolio upgrades. This is a highly strategic team contributing to Clio’s success in a highly cross functional role working across nearly all functions at Clio.

Who you are:

You're analytical and curious about customer behaviour, comfortable working through large volumes of data to find the story in the numbers. You like turning ad hoc, manual processes into something repeatable, and you enjoy building partnerships across the business. You're also detail-oriented, organized, and self-managing, with a habit of verifying your own work. You build in checks, flag what looks off, and hold a high bar for accuracy.

What you’ll work on:

As a Pricing Analyst, you'll own the execution and measurement of pricing changes, from account migrations in our billing systems and Salesforce to the modeling, reporting, and testing that tell us whether a change worked.


Own recurring price-based account migrations end to end, from cohort segmentation and batch processing through QA and post-migration validation, and build the formula-driven templates that make them repeatable and auditable at scale
Support the models that price new releases and size the impact of changes on existing customers, and help package the findings into recommendations
Partner with Data & Insights to build the dashboards and automated reporting that track realized vs. list price, discount depth, and ARPA by cohort, so the team catches problems early
Work across Billing Ops, Sales Ops, CS Ops, and Enablement to automate the manual steps in pricing execution and equip Sales and CS when prices change
Help design and run in-market price tests to validate willingness to pay before changes roll out broadly
Use AI tooling to compress the analysis and execution cycle, from generating and QA'ing migration cohorts to automating the handoff into Salesforce and building intuitive internal pricing calculators and price sheets


What you may have:


2+ years in financial or business analysis and modeling, preferably for B2B SaaS, including heavy spreadsheet work with nested logic and QA across large datasets
Hands-on experience in a subscription billing system (Zuora, Stripe, Chargebee, or similar) and a CRM like Salesforce, including bulk updates and data validation across large account sets
2+ years building dashboards and queries in Looker, Tableau, or similar
Experience with pricing analysis across SaaS charge models, such as subscription, usage-based, tiered, and per-seat
Experience running cross-functional projects in Asana or similar, coordinating with ops and GTM teams to keep work moving
Strong communication skills, with the ability to deliver clear status updates, business insights, and recommendations in written, presentation, and spoken form
Experience using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) to support analysis, workflows, and day-to-day productivity


Serious bonus points if you have:


Experience with Workato or similar integration and task-automation tools
Prior experience executing pricing or plan migrations at scale


This role is a backfill for an existing position.

What you will find here:

Compensation is one of the main components of Clio’s Total Rewards Program. We have developed a series of programs and processes to ensure we are creating fair and competitive pay practices that form the foundation of our human and high-performing culture.

Some highlights of our Total Rewards program include:


Competitive, equitable salary with top-tier health benefits, dental, and vision insurance
Hybrid work environment, with expectation for local Clions (Vancouver, Calgary, Toronto, Dublin, London, New York City and Sydney) to be in office min. twice per week.
Flexible time off policy, with an encouraged 20 days off per year.
$2000 annual counseling benefit
RRSP matching and RESP contribution
Clioversary recognition program with special acknowledgement at 3, 5, 7, and 10 years


The expected salary range for this role is $97,300 to $131,700 CAD. Initial placement within the range is informed by geographic region, experience, and skillset, with room to progress as impact and tenure grow. Final offer amounts will vary based on candidate profile.

Diversity, Inclusion, Belonging and Equity (DIBE) & Accessibility

Our team shows up as their authentic selves, and are united by our mission. We are dedicated to diversity, equity and inclusion. We pride ourselves in building and fostering an environment where our teams feel included, valued, and enabled to do the best work of their careers, wherever they choose to log in from. We believe that different perspectives, skills, backgrounds, and experiences result in higher-performing teams and better innovation. We are committed to equal employment and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

Clio provides accessibility accommodations during the recruitment process. Should you require any accommodation, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

Learn more about our culture at clio.com/careers

We're a Human and High Performing AI company, meaning we use artificial intelligence to improve all of our operations. In recruitment, AI helps us streamline the process for greater efficiency. However, we've built our systems to ensure that a human always reviews AI-generated output, and we never make automated hiring decisions.

Disclaimer: We only communicate with candidates through official @clio.com email addresses.

Title: MarTech Data & Insights Specialist
Description:
Company Description

About Us:

With a history that dates back over 80 years, Starcom is a global communications planning and media leader. We are an agency still grounded in our founding principle that people are at center of all we do. Each day, we apply this belief to harness the transformative power of data and technology to inspire and move people and business forward. With more than 7,000 employees in over 100 offices around the world, Starcom partners with the world's leading marketers and brands.

Within Canada, Starcom is a part of Publicis Media within Publicis Groupe, one of the world’s leading communications groups. Our team spans across our Windsor, Toronto and Montreal offices. We truly love the world of Media and Advertising. We see the planning and buying process as art. However, it is an art that is always best when backed by the science of empirical data.

You will be joining a well recognised agency with credentials:


Great Places to Work certified three years in a row
Only communications company to be ranked in LinkedIn’s Top 25 Great Places to Work
2022 Media Agency of the Year
2023 Media Agency of the Year finalist


What We Offer


Work Your World program enabling you to experience working from anywhere in Canada or overseas for up to 6 weeks a year
Extended long weekends throughout the year with an additional day off each long weekend
Wellness & Tech benefits to support what’s most important to you
Birthday leave
Extensive Learning & Development opportunities, including more than 15,000 learning programs via our online learning platform as well as a Professional Development Allowance
Local and Global Mobility within the Publicis Groupe network


Overview

The Data Activation Specialist will be responsible for utilizing digital platforms and transforming vast data sets into actionable insights that inform targeting and optimization; specifically,

connecting or extracting data, tracking, measuring, and analyzing and optimizing digital media for improved conversion and business performance. You will be part of a growing team, reporting to the Data Activation Manager and will have the opportunity to learn and grow in the emerging field of data strategy, data activation and data analysis.

Responsibilities


Ingest disparate digital data sources across Paid, Owned and Earned Digital Media into a consolidated environment for tracking
Learn how to set up automated process for data extraction, via API, SFTP, SQL etc.
Extract, transform and load data for ingestion into business intelligence platforms
Learn how to build dashboards in business intelligence platforms
Build and deploy semi-automated Excel and PowerPoint digital reporting solutions such as campaign performance tracking
Provide the Planning and Buying teams with analysis, insights and data-informed recommendations from the aforementioned reporting areas
Opportunity to work across key business intelligence platforms for digital media, mainly Datorama
Translate strategy into implementation tactics Data mapping and enhancement
Create segments relevant to objectives that can be pushed to relevant destinations for activation
Translate objectives into digital media measurement plans
Analyze and report on campaign performance through standardized ad-server attribution models
Learn how to build simplistic algorithmic attribution models and implement them
Work alongside data scientists to deploy more complex algorithmic attribution models
Make data-informed recommendations for optimizing digital media and content
Opportunity to work on key attribution platforms such as Google’s Data-Driven
Attribution model with DoubleClick, and proprietary Publicis Media platforms


Qualifications


3-4 years’ experience in Digital Media in Planning/Buying and/or 1 – 2 years Data Science experience
Technically competent and capable of working with and learning new digital and tech platforms
Strong numerical and analytical skills
Demonstrated ability to convert data analysis into meaningful action for brands
Experience with or strong knowledge of ad servers and web analytics platforms such as
DoubleClick, Adobe Media Optimizer, Sizmek, Google Analytics or Adobe Omniture
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Ability to cope under pressure and deliver to tight deadlines autonomously.


Additional Information

We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. Accommodations are available throughout the hiring process upon request.

Salary

Transparency matters to us. The salary range for this position is $45 - 50k per year. Actual compensation within this range will be based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, knowledge, skills, and applicable certifications. This range reflects what we reasonably expect to offer based on current market data.

AI Use

We use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our hiring process, such as reviewing applications or analyzing resumes. These tools assist our recruitment team but never replace human decision-making. We believe in a human-first approach, where your experience and potential are recognized by people.

Starcom is an equal opportunity employer with a strong commitment to diversity and inclusion. We create and nurture a vibrant work environment that celebrates, values and leverages all aspects of diversity and inclusiveness, attracts world-class talent and serves as the industry benchmark for best practices. We encourage applications from all qualified individuals and will provide appropriate accommodation for candidates with disabilities or accessibility needs throughout the recruitment process, upon request. Please contact our recruiter for any questions, accommodations or specific requests. We thank all candidates for their interest in Starcom however, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted

Title: Analyst, Data Strategy
Description:
About Four Seasons

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts is a global, luxury hotel management company. We manage over 130 hotels and resorts and 50 private residences in 47 countries around the world and growing. Central to Four Seasons employee experience and social impact programming is the company’s commitment to supporting cancer research, and the advancement of diversity, inclusion, equality and belonging at Four Seasons corporate offices and properties worldwide. At Four Seasons, we are powered by people and our culture enables everything we do.

Analyst, Data Strategy

As a Data Strategy Analyst, you will report to the Director, Data Strategy and Product Assurance and work closely with the Manager of Data Strategy, playing a crucial role in supporting the organization's data strategy and governance initiatives. Collaborating with cross-functional teams, you will gather data requirements, assist in developing and implementing comprehensive data strategies, and ensure the alignment of data usage with business goals.

You will leverage your data analytics expertise to help maintain data roadmaps, build process data flows, manage project management tools, support certification of products based on governance standards and help execute overall data strategy. This position will also work in collaboration with the delivery team, and product managers to ensure the analytics program is enabling the overall data strategy.

This role is based in our temporary location of 20 York Mills Rd, then the Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts, Toronto Corporate Office. This role involves interactions with both internal and external stakeholders at various levels.

What You’ll Be Doing


Support the manager in implementing relevant data governance policies and work closely with product owners to ensure data products are certified for use.
Assist in maintaining the data roadmap, ensuring alignment of data usage with evolving business strategies, emerging technologies, and data sources.
Develop and maintain productive relationships with data stewards, product owners, and other key stakeholders to facilitate collaboration and data stewardship.
Facilitation and maintenance of the ongoing data strategy and roadmap.
Support intake of new data products through stakeholder communication, maintenance of templates, and scheduling of oversight and governance meetings.
Collaborate with project managers and delivery teams to support the development and delivery of data products that provide value to the business.
Assist in strengthening the organization’s data foundation through the implementation of effective policies, standards, and key performance indicators (KPIs).
Work with the manager to create and maintain training materials, playbooks, and reference guides to promote consistent adoption of data governance practices across teams.
Provide ongoing support and training on product certification requirements.
Oversee implementation of data strategy.
Support the manager in tracking and reporting on budget utilization across data and analytics projects, highlighting key variances and potential risks.
Assist in preparing program level budget and spend summaries to inform planning and prioritization.
Collaborate with D&A teams to create initial cost and resource estimates for new project requests.
Program Budget and Performance Tracking.
Identify opportunities for innovation and continuous improvement in data management processes.
Communicate the value of data-driven decision making and foster a data-driven culture by promoting awareness and understanding of the importance of data.
Proactive research and promote use of data to enable FS strategy.


What You Bring


Bachelor’s in a relevant field (e.g. Data Management, Information Technology, Business Analytics, Informatics).
Strong understanding of data governance frameworks and principles.
Experience managing data lifecycle.
Demonstrated ability to align data strategy with business goals.
Experience in data strategy development and implementation.
Ability to adapt data strategies to evolving business needs and changing landscape.
Analytical mindset with the ability to identify trends, detect anomalies, and translate complex data sets into actionable insights and strategies.
Experience with data governance tools and technologies such as informatica.
Strong knowledge of data protection regulations, and compliance standards.
Applied experience in data governance and / or data management.
Knowledge of industry leading data governance practices.
Familiar with implementation and use various data governance tools and software.
Familiar with DMBOK principles.
Understand of complete data lifecycle and related data governance requirements.
Understanding of GDPR and related legislation.
Ability to manipulate, analyze and transform large datasets to understand trends and patterns.
Working knowledge of cloud computing platforms. MS Azure preferred (Microsoft Synapse, Azure Data factory, Azure Databricks, PowerBI).
Proficient in SQL or other programming languages.
Experience with data visualization and dashboarding (Power BI, Tableau).
Expert in Microsoft Office software (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Access).
Working knowledge of project management tools such as Monday.com and Jira.


Who You Are

Business / Analytics Skills


Works to understand the business need and how the data will be used to drive decisions into action plans that will grow the business.
Effectively navigates through ambiguity and complexity to provide clarity for the team and the requester.
Works well under pressure and can manage multiple tasks under time constraints.
Strong with process management including the development of processes and procedures.
Familiar with agile methodology and comfortable working in an agile environment.


Communication Skills


Works to understand the requester needs when building the upfront story to ensure clarity and actionability.
Listens carefully to understand requirements and seeks clarity as needed.
Provides well-structured reports and documents to convey analysis and insights that are clear, concise and reader-friendly.
Demonstrates understanding of the importance of storytelling by incorporating visual enhancements into presentations.
Strong interpersonal skills and team player.


Planning / Organizational Skills


Demonstrates the ability to organize and work with high volumes of data.
Establishes clear expectations to ensure smooth execution.
Handles multiple demands and conflicting priorities by quickly re-allocating time and resources.
Organizes self and the team in setting and managing priorities.
Demonstrates a relentlessly high standard for attention to detail and holds others to the same.
Delivers on commitments on time and on budget.


People Engagement


Takes the time to acknowledge the efforts and contributions of others.
Works to build relationships with colleagues to both provide and receive the best support.


Collaboration Skills


Works productively in a matrix environment to move projects along and foster a positive team attitude.
Proactively asks for input and ideas from others to demonstrate the power of the team.


Salary Range: $70,000 – $85,000 CAD

This role will be a Hybrid working model, which will require 3 days per week at our temporary 20 York Mills Road, Toronto, Ontario location with travel, as needed, to our Four Seasons Corporate Office located at 1165 Leslie Street, Toronto, Ontario

Four Seasons is committed to providing employment accommodation in accordance with the Ontario Human Rights Code and the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act. If contacted for an employment opportunity, please advise Human Resources if you require accommodation.

Data Migration Specialist

Jonas Software – Premier Division

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
What We're Looking For:

At TBWA\Canada, we look to uncover key business insights and solve complex creative problems with the power of data. We are looking for an avid Data Analyst that is looking for an exciting career in the world of media and advertising. This person has an obsession with ROI and optimizing stuff! This Data Analyst would be working with a client that is one of the top automotive companies in Canada.




What You'll Do:

Work closely with business stakeholders to understand business requirements; find and analyze appropriate data sources and provide data-driven solutions to key business problems
Help build, maintain, and improve the data pipelines and data warehouses that power the team’s reporting and analysis
Support the development and maintenance of media optimization models – e.g. market mix models and media investment planning – working alongside senior analysts
Help maintain and enhance existing machine learning models, and monitor and analyze their performance on an ongoing basis
Contribute to audience and ad campaign planning and measurement solutions on a proprietary data platform
Work closely with media, strategy, and creative teams in an agency setup to provide overall data analytics support for planning and executing media campaigns
Develop and maintain strategic business performance Tableau dashboards
Analyze competitive landscape and provide regular share of voice and share of market analyses and projections
Explain results of complex data solutions and advanced models to a broad business audience through data visualization and executive presentations




What You Bring:

Curiosity and attention to detail
2–3 years of experience in data analytics or data science, ideally in a media or marketing environment
Fluency in SQL and Python & MS Excel
Fluency with data, analytics, and visualization technologies (we use SQL, Python, Tableau)
Experience in media agency or marketing is a strong plus
Knowledge of media mix modeling, multi-touch attribution and other forms of ROI modeling
Experience with Google Marketing Products (GA360/4, DV360, SA360, GOOGLE ADS, CM360)
Ideal candidate would have: University Degree in Engineering/ Computer Science / Mathematics/ Statistics / Operations Research or a quantitative field




Who We Are:

TBWA is The Disruption® Company, a global agency collective of 10,000+ creative minds operating in over 80 countries. Named one of the World's Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company four years in a row, we are a disruptive brand experience company that uses creativity to help businesses acquire a greater share of the future.

We believe in doing the brave thing.




Doing the brave thing is about courage. It’s about never being a spectator. Speaking up with clarity and conviction and kindness. Not hedging our points-of-view with clients or each other. Saying what we think when it’s in the best interest of the idea or the people, even if it’s uncomfortable. Being willing to take smart risks. Making tough decisions without agonizing. And, being transparent and vulnerable in search of the best. This is the expectation for all of us. In turn, we commit to perpetuating a culture where bravery is rewarded and support is always within reach. TBWA\Canada develops strategies, advertising and brand experiences for some of the world's most iconic brands, with offices in Toronto, Edmonton and Montreal.




The Company:

At TBWA\Canada, Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging (DEIB) are our core values. We are committed to a diverse workforce and aim to maintain an inclusive and equitable workplace where employees feel valued, respected, and supported. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and lived experiences. If you require an accommodation during the recruitment process, please contact our Human Resources team and we would be happy to work with you to meet your needs.




The salary range for this position is $75,000- $85,000 per year. Compensation will be determined based on qualifications, relevant experience, and internal equity. This job description represents an active vacancy that we are currently hiring for.




AI Use:

TBWA\Canada uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our hiring process, such as enhancing job postings and analyzing resumes. These tools assist our recruitment team but will never replace the human judgement that guides our hiring decisions. We will only contact shortlisted candidates for this role.

TBWA\Canada / Omnicom Advertising Group will never contact you from a personal email account (@gmail.com, @hotmail.com, etc.) nor ask for money in exchange for recruitment services such as background screenings, equipment costs, etc. No financial information will be requested for recruitment purposes (bank account, credit card details, etc.). If you have provided personal information in connection with a fake job offer or interview and you are concerned, we suggest you take appropriate action and contact local law enforcement in your area, and contact our local Human Resources team.

Department: Diamond

Location: Toronto, ON

About The Job

Ready to push the limits of what’s possible? Join Sanofi in one of our corporate functions and you can play a vital part in the performance of our entire business while helping to make an impact on millions around the world.

Reporting directly to the Sales and Demand Insights Data Product Manager, the Data Analyst (L2) is responsible for managing, analyzing, and transforming commercial data into AI-ready, trusted assets that power business decisions across US Brands.

This role sits at the intersection of data engineering, analytics, and AI enablement. The ideal candidate brings a strong command of data management and analytics, hands-on AI fluency, and a commitment to Sanofi's AI-Ready Data principles: Understood, Trusted, Safe, and Shared.

About Sanofi

We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

Main Responsibilities

AI-ENABLED ANALYTICS AND INSIGHT GENERATION


Leverage AI and machine learning tools and techniques, including generative AI and statistical models, to identify patterns, trends, and high-leverage insights from large commercial datasets
Develop and maintain AI-ready datasets, ensuring data is structured, governed, and fit-for-purpose for use in AI and ML solutions across US Brands
Apply Sanofi's Responsible AI (RAISE) framework principles when building or consuming AI-powered analytics, ensuring transparency, fairness, and ethical use
Explore opportunities to integrate AI and ML capabilities such as predictive demand modeling, sales forecasting, and segmentation into the Sales and Demand Insights product


DATA ANALYSIS AND BUSINESS INTELLIGENCE


Analyze large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights that drive commercial decisions
Leverage data and facts to challenge conventional wisdom, form evidence-based conclusions, and identify high-leverage intervention points
Identify and analyze business needs that support the product strategy, harmonizing across business areas for a unified commercial data foundation for all US Brands
Communicate solution trade-offs clearly to frame and influence project decisions


DATA ENGINEERING AND AI-READY DATA DEVELOPMENT


Design and define ingestion processes to ensure efficient data flow and integration aligned with Sanofi's Data Mesh architecture
Build and maintain data pipelines that meet Sanofi's AI-Ready Data standards: quality-scored, classified, governed, and discoverable in the Data Marketplace
Develop detailed functional specifications and test cases based on business requirements
Apply strong understanding of data warehousing concepts including design patterns and ETL and ELT load strategies


DATA QUALITY AND GOVERNANCE


Implement and monitor Data Quality rules in line with Sanofi's AI-Ready Data standards covering accuracy, completeness, consistency, and timeliness
Ensure datasets are scored via Informatica CDGC and remediated when below defined quality thresholds
Support data classification, access policy definition, and privacy-by-design principles in compliance with Data Privacy, GxP, SOX, and cybersecurity requirements
Collaborate with Business Data Stewards and Digital roles to maintain shared data ownership and accountability


INNOVATION AND CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT


Proactively monitor industry, functional, and technology trends, particularly in AI and ML, generative AI, and commercial analytics
Identify new opportunities to leverage data and integrate internal and external sources to enhance business value
Aggregate and evaluate digital data sources including web, email, social media, and CRM to enrich commercial insights

Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field
Minimum 3 years of experience in data analysis, data manipulation, and data management
Expert proficiency in SQL and data querying
Proficiency in Python for data analysis and AI and ML workflows
Hands-on experience building or consuming AI-ready datasets and working with AI and ML platforms
Familiarity with Responsible AI principles and ethical data use including bias, fairness, and transparency
Experience with data warehousing, Snowflake, ETL and ELT pipelines, and cloud platforms
Strong team player with the ability to collaborate effectively in a fast-moving, agile environment

Experience in commercial pharmaceuticals, biotech, or healthcare
Familiarity with Sanofi's AI Foundry, Data Mesh, or Informatica CDGC
Knowledge of generative AI tools and large language model-based analytics applications
Experience with digital data sources including web analytics, CRM, email, social media, and TV
Knowledge of Six Sigma and Agile practices


Tools And Technologies


Snowflake, SQL, Python, Informatica, AWS
JIRA, Confluence
Microsoft Suite including Teams, Excel, and PowerPoint
Power BI or equivalent data visualization tools

Title: Pricing Analyst/Strategist
Description:
Position Overview

We’re looking for a highly analytical and commercially minded Pricing Specialist to help shape and execute our pricing strategy across Canada and the U.S. This is not a role for someone who simply maintains price lists. We’re looking for someone who is curious about why a product should be priced a certain way, how pricing impacts customer behaviour, margin and revenue, and how different pricing strategies should work across channels and markets.




You’ll work across our ecommerce business, sales channels and internal systems to help ensure our pricing is competitive, commercially sound and designed to maximise revenue and profitability.

This role is ideal for someone who loves data, enjoys solving puzzles and is comfortable moving between strategy and execution. One day you may be analysing competitor pricing and identifying opportunities across thousands of products; the next, you may be digging into ecommerce pricing logic, investigating why a price is displaying incorrectly or helping design a new pricing rule.




Key Responsibilities and How You’ll Make an Impact

Help develop and execute pricing strategy across our Canadian and U.S. businesses
Analyse pricing performance across products, categories, brands, customer segments and sales channels
Identify opportunities to improve revenue, margin, conversion and overall competitiveness
Monitor competitor pricing and market dynamics to understand where we are positioned and where opportunities exist
Develop pricing recommendations based on customer behaviour, competitive data, product economics and business objectives
Explore and refine ecommerce pricing logic, including how prices, promotions, discounts and customer-specific pricing are displayed online
Analyse price elasticity and test new pricing approaches and measure their impact

Description:
About The Role




This role sits on our Digital team, where your internal title will be Specialist, Digital, working primarily in a data analytics capacity across client engagements.




As a Specialist, Digital focused on Data Analytics, you are an early-to-mid career data professional with a strong foundation in analysis and a desire to grow both your technical and consulting skill set. Leveraging your analytics background, you will support the delivery of digital products for our clients through analytics and reporting solutions that help organizations better understand their data and make informed decisions.




In addition to your analytics work, you will gain exposure to broader areas of digital consulting, including digital product development, digital transformation, and user experience (UX/CX). You are interested in understanding how data supports product decisions, customer experiences, and overall business strategy.




You will work closely with senior analysts, data scientists, engineers, product managers, designers, and business stakeholders across a variety of client engagements. With guidance and mentorship, you will contribute to analytics initiatives including dashboarding, exploratory analysis, KPI tracking, and data quality validation, while also building broader consulting skills across areas such as project management, user experience, and design thinking.




You are curious, detail-oriented, and motivated to continuously improve your analytical and consulting capabilities.




What You’ll Do




Support client and internal teams in understanding business questions and translating them into analytical requirements
Analyze data to identify trends, patterns, and insights under the guidance of senior team members
Build and maintain dashboards and recurring reports to track key metrics and performance indicators
Assist in documenting metrics, definitions, and analytics processes
Collaborate with data engineers and other analysts to support data modeling and reporting layers
Communicate insights clearly through visualizations, summaries, and presentations
Proactively identify opportunities to improve reporting, data quality, and analytical workflows




Qualifications




Minimum 2+ years of experience in a data analyst, business intelligence, or analytics-focused role
Programming experience in Python, Bash scripting, R or related language
Working proficiency in SQL and experience querying cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift, BigQuery)
Experience with Business Intelligence and data visualization tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Power BI)
Foundational understanding of data modeling and analytics best practices
Experience defining and tracking KPIs and metrics
A/B testing and causal analysis
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail
Clear written and verbal communication skills
Ability to work collaboratively in cross-functional and consulting-style environments
Interest in learning about data governance, privacy, and security best practices

Comprehensive Health & Wellness Benefits Package
Retirement Planning
Parental Leave Program
Flexible Working Hours
Work from Home Flexibility
Service Recognition Programs
Socials, Outings & Retreats
Culture of Learning & Development

Title: Data & Strategy Operations Specialist
Description:
Job Description

Hey there, Future Data & Strategy Operations Specialist @ Better Collective! 👋

Our mission is to be the world’s leading digital sports media company, making sports entertainment more engaging and transparent for fans worldwide.

Better Collective is the team behind industry-leading sports and betting media brands such as Action Network, HLTV, RotoGrinders, The Nation Network, BolaVIP, and Playmaker , reaching 400M+ monthly visits across digital, social, mobile, and CTV platforms.

With FanReach at the core of our audience strategy, we’re transforming first-party data into a powerful monetization engine for advertisers. We connect high-intent sports fans with performance-focused brands through advanced data, contextual targeting, and scalable audience solutions.

We’re now looking for a Data & Strategy Operations Specialist to help stand up, implement, and operationalize our Data Management Platform (DMP) and contextual targeting solutions from the ground up.

This is a high-impact individual contributor role , ideal for someone who thrives in ambiguity, enjoys building systems from scratch, and knows how to turn complex data into commercial outcomes.

You’ll report directly to Derek Klimkowski and work closely with Commercial, Product, Tech, and Data partners across regions.

This role is for you if…

You’re a builder at heart. You’ve helped implement or operate a DMP, CDP, or audience data solution before, and you’re excited by the challenge of taking something from zero to one.

You’re equally comfortable going deep into technical details and stepping back to think strategically about monetization, scale, and market impact. You can work independently, but you know when and how to collaborate to move things forward.

Sports experience is a plus, curiosity, ownership, and execution mindset are essential.

How You’ll Make an Impact


Here are some of the ways you’ll contribute to our mission:
Own the day-to-day operation, maintenance, and optimization of Better Collective’s DMP and contextual targeting solutions.
Act as the primary point of contact with our DMP vendor and the internal go-to expert for audience data capabilities.
Build, analyze, and scale audience segments using first-party, contextual, and partner data.
Profile and segment advertising inventory to ensure scale, brand suitability, and commercial viability.
Collaborate with data providers and aggregators to strengthen and expand our data offering.
Work closely with Sales, RevOps, Media Planning, and Account Management teams to support data-driven media sales.
Help translate data and platform capabilities into clear commercial insights for internal stakeholders.
Support FanReach product development by providing actionable insights and operational feedback.
Ensure data practices align with privacy and compliance standards (GDPR, CCPA, etc.).


The Ideal Profile: Is This You?

Here’s What Helps People Succeed In This Role


5+ years of experience working with DMPs, CDPs, or audience data platforms , either at:
A DMP/vendor
An agency
A publisher or brand-side data team
Hands-on experience implementing or operating data platforms (not just strategy).
Strong understanding of first-party data, identity resolution, and activation across digital channels.
Experience with contextual targeting and brand suitability frameworks.
Comfortable working independently in a role with no direct reports , owning outcomes end-to-end.
Strong communication skills, able to explain complex data concepts clearly to non-technical audiences.
Organized, proactive, and confident working in environments without historical playbooks.
Nice-to-haves


Experience in sports media, iGaming, or performance advertising.
Global or multi-market experience (US, LATAM, EMEA).
Familiarity with programmatic, direct sales, and data licensing models.
Experience working with Google Ad Manager (GAM), with a solid understanding of analytics and the ability to apply data insights (e.g., Google Analytics, campaign and performance metrics) to inform strategy and decision-making.


Meet Your Manager & Team

You’ll report to Derek Klimkowski , a strategic leader focused on building scalable, data-driven commercial products. Derek values ownership, clarity, and collaboration, and will partner closely with you while giving you the autonomy to build and execute.

You’ll also collaborate with Commercial leadership, Product, Tech, and Data teams across regions.

What We Offer: Perks, Growth & Culture

We invest in our people. Here’s what it’s like to work at Better Collective:

Benefits & Perks


Full health benefits (medical, dental, vision)
PTO
401(k) with employer match
Life & disability insurance
Extended paid parental leave
Pet insurance
Employee Assistance Program with mental health resources


Your Growth & Our Culture


Collaborative environment with open communication and trust.
Global exposure , working with teams across regions and markets.
Real ownership & impact : your work directly shapes how the brand shows up every day.
Room to grow , with support for learning and new challenges.
Balance & flexibility , whenever possible.
A culture that’s informal, supportive, and fun, expect memes, good coffee, and lively Slack channels.


Ready to Join?

We’re excited to learn more about you!

Our Interview Process:


Application review by our People team
Intro interview with Talent / People
Interview with the Hiring Manager (Derek Klimkowski)
Final conversation (if needed)
Offer & reference checks


Our process may vary slightly by role or location, but we’ll keep you informed at every step.

Title: Systems Administrator & Business Analyst
Description:
Systems Administr ator & Business Analyst

Department: Information Technology/ Business Systems

Location: On -Site Niagara Falls, Ontario

Employment Type: Full Time

Reports To: IT Director

Innovation Flows Here.

Officially opening its doors in 2024, the University of Niagara Falls Canada (UNF) is an innovative and digitally oriented institution that prepares graduates for leadership in the digital world. We believe in delivering programs that provide a direct pathway to meaningful careers in high-demand industries. UNF is part of the Global University Systems Canada group of institutions and Global University Systems, an international network of higher education institutions.

Our location

Our campus is located in historic downtown Niagara Falls. Beyond being Canada’s #1 travel destination, Niagara Falls is a small vibrant city that offers up a slice of metropolitan living at a different pace. From world-class dining and entertainment options to luxury shopping and cultural experiences. Our location offers the amenities of a large urban centre within a comfortable, liveable community.

Position Summary

The University of Niagara Falls Canada is seeking an experienced Systems Administrator & Business Analyst to support the administration, optimization and continued development of the university's Ellucian Colleague student information system and related enterprise systems.

This is a hybrid role that combines two complementary skill sets. As a Systems Administrator, the incumbent keeps Colleague and its connected systems secure, reliable and well-maintained — owning configuration, upgrades, access, monitoring, backups and integrations. As a Business Analyst, they work directly with operational teams — particularly the Registrar's Office and Finance — to understand business needs, improve processes, gather and document requirements, and translate them into practical system solutions, reports and enhancements.

It is a hands-on, dual-skilled position requiring strong technical and system-administration capability alongside solid business-analysis and process-improvement skills, plus the stakeholder engagement to serve as a key link between institutional departments, internal IT, external vendors and Ellucian.

Key Responsibilities

System Administration


Administer, configure and maintain Ellucian Colleague and related enterprise systems, including application, environment and integration layers.
Manage system upgrades, patches, testing and release management across development, test and production environments.
Provision and manage user accounts, roles, permissions and security in line with institutional policy.
Monitor system performance, availability, capacity and data integrity; proactively identify and resolve issues.
Administer backups, recovery and business-continuity processes for supported systems.
Maintain system documentation, configuration records and technical standard operating procedures.
Coordinate incidents, changes and scheduled maintenance with internal IT, Ellucian and third-party vendors.
Develop and maintain scripts and automation to streamline administrative and operational tasks.


Business Analysis


Partner with university departments to elicit, analyze and document business and functional requirements.
Map current-state processes, perform gap analysis and design improved workflows supported by Colleague.
Translate operational requirements into functional specifications, system configurations and technical solutions.
Facilitate requirements-gathering and design sessions and manage stakeholder expectations.
Plan and coordinate system testing, including preparing test cases and leading user acceptance testing (UAT).
Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and improve efficiency, accuracy and service delivery.
Develop process maps, standard operating procedures, user documentation and training materials.
Ensure system processes support institutional policies, regulatory requirements and operational best practices.


Registrars office & Student Records Support


Provide dedicated support for student records, registration, enrolment, course scheduling, academic standing, grading and graduation processes.
Assist with the development and optimization of Registrar workflows and reporting requirements.
Support data-quality initiatives relating to student records and academic information.
Help resolve complex student-record and registration issues requiring technical intervention.
Support integrations and projects involving academic records, scheduling and student-lifecycle management.


Finance Support


Support the Finance team with Colleague processes relating to student accounts, tuition, fees, payments, refunds, financial reporting and reconciliation.
Develop and maintain financial reports and operational dashboards.
Assist with integrations involving payment platforms, banking systems and other financial applications.
Support Finance with process improvements, system testing and issue resolution.
Work with Finance and Registrar teams to ensure consistency between student, enrolment and financial data.


Reporting, Analytics, & Dashboards


Design, build and maintain operational reports, executive reports and dashboards.
Work with stakeholders to define reporting requirements, data definitions and performance indicators.
Develop automated reporting processes to reduce reliance on manual spreadsheets.
Support institutional data governance and ensure reports are accurate, consistent and appropriately secured.
Assist leadership and operational teams with timely access to reliable information for decision-making.
Collaborate with analytics teams to support live dashboards and institutional reporting requirements.


Systems Integration & Project Support


Support current and future integrations between Ellucian Colleague and other institutional systems.
Participate in the planning, design, testing and implementation of new applications and integrations.
Develop and maintain data extracts, interfaces, APIs and scheduled data-transfer processes where required.
Coordinate with vendors and internal teams to ensure integrations are secure, reliable and properly documented.
Provide technical support for strategic institutional projects involving student, academic, financial or operational systems.
Participate in requirements gathering, testing, implementation planning and post-launch support.


Stakeholder Engagment & Training


Act as a key technical and functional resource for Colleague users across the university.
Build strong working relationships with department leaders, subject-matter experts and system users.
Facilitate requirements-gathering sessions and translate business needs into practical solutions.
Provide training, guidance and knowledge transfer to staff.
Develop user guides, training materials and technical documentation.
Communicate system changes, risks, issues and project progress clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.


Data Governance, Security & Compliance


Support the accuracy, completeness and consistency of institutional data.
Ensure appropriate access controls, security practices and privacy requirements are followed.
Assist with audit requests, compliance reporting and data validation.
Identify and address data-quality issues in collaboration with relevant departments.
Support the development of institutional standards for system use, reporting and data management.


Qualifications


Postsecondary degree or diploma in information technology, computer science, information systems, business systems or a related field.
Demonstrated experience administering and supporting Ellucian Colleague in a postsecondary education environment.
Solid system-administration experience — configuration, upgrades and patching, user and access management, monitoring, backups and environment management.

System Administration

“Join us in building Careers and shaping Experiences Beyond the Box”

About Us

At Atlantic Packaging, every box tells a story and yours begins here. As a proudly Canadian-owned company with over 80 years of excellence in the corrugated packaging industry with operations within North America (Ontario, Quebec and United States), we’re committed to sustainability, customer excellence and community impact. We are hiring a Pricing Analyst for our Ontario Corrugated Team. Reporting to the Team Lead, Pricing & Sales Reporting, the Pricing Analyst is responsible for compiling data from various systems, performing variance analysis on costs and pricing, and preparing specialized reports to support the sales function.

What You'll Do


Audit prices entered on orders ensuring compliance with established guidelines
Prepare order variance report
Compile data and prepare profitability reports by customer by product
Prepare future price lists
Prepare monthly sales reports.
Perform costs comparisons and analysis
Prepare and update bi-weekly aged inventory reports and update with comments.
Prepare performance tracker files for customers
Update costing system with price information
Complete ad-hoc reports as required


What You'll Bring


University degree in Business, Commerce, or a related field emphasizing numerical analysis and quantitative methods
2 years of experience in data analysis and revenue growth
Proficiency in MS Office with intermediate to advanced knowledge of MS Excel
Good organizational skills and the ability to prioritize
Strong communication (oral and written) and presentation skills
Ability to work independently and with little supervision in a high volume fast paced environment


What We Offer


Comprehensive health, dental and vision coverage (dependents included)
Teamwork-focused culture with sustainability initiatives and social events
A culture of appreciation through a point-based recognition
Opportunities for advancement and internal movement
Education assistance for continuous skill development
Academic scholarships for employees’ children
Safety equipment and PPE support program
Knowledge of advanced material considerations is an asset.

Candidates who are 18 years or older are required to complete a criminal and background check. Details will be provided through the application process.

Job Description

We are looking for a Data Science Expert to support the development of advanced data and analytics solutions within a highly regulated manufacturing environment. The successful candidate will work closely with cross-functional teams to transform complex process and operational data into actionable insights, enabling data-driven decision-making and continuous improvement initiatives.

Location & Work Mode



Location: Toronto, ON
Work Mode: Hybrid
Seniority: Middle (4–6 years of experience)
Schedule: Flexibility to work with European time zones, including availability for an early shift (approximately 6:00 AM – 2:00 PM)



Key Responsibilities



Design, develop, and maintain ready-to-use data and analytics systems.
Extract, organize, contextualize, and transform data from multiple source systems into business-ready formats.
Collaborate with stakeholders across Manufacturing Science & Technology (MSAT), Automation, Digital, Quality, and other functions to gather analytics requirements.
Map process parameters and manufacturing data to source systems such as MES, PI Historian, LIMS, iShift, and cloud-based data platforms.
Develop data contextualization pipelines within cloud-based AI and analytics environments.
Build and maintain data visualization solutions and dashboards to support operational and business needs.
Develop and support machine learning models and advanced analytics solutions.
Ensure data integrity, consistency, and accessibility across multiple platforms.
Support continuous improvement initiatives through data-driven insights and process monitoring.



Required Qualifications



4–6 years of experience in Data Science, Data Analytics, Data Engineering, or related fields.
Strong experience working with manufacturing, process, or operational data.
Hands-on experience with:
Python
SQL (MS SQL Server)
Power BI
Snowflake
GitHub
Experience working with MES (Manufacturing Execution Systems), LIMS (Laboratory Information Management Systems), and process data platforms.
Knowledge of data modeling, data pipelines, data contextualization, and analytics solution development.
Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities.


Nice-to-Have Qualifications



Experience with PI Historian and PI Vision.
Experience with JMP, SIMCA, and SIMCA-online.
Exposure to Machine Learning and AI platforms.
Experience within Life Sciences, Pharmaceutical, Biotechnology, or other regulated industries.
Understanding of manufacturing processes and process performance monitoring.



Expected Compensation Range:

50K-90K The final compensation offered will be determined based on the candidate’s level of experience, skills, and qualifications, in compliance with applicable pay transparency requirements.

Canadian Experience Requirement:

No Canadian work experience is required for this position. Candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of previous Canadian experience.

This position is a Job creation, created to support ongoing project needs.

Candidates will receive feedback on their application within a maximum of 45 days from the date of application or from their most recent interview stage.

Why choose us



An international community bringing together more than 110 different nationalities
An environment where trust is central: 70% of our leaders started their careers at the entry level
A strong training system with our internal Academy and more than 250 modules available
A dynamic work environment that frequently comes together for internal events (afterworks, team buildings, etc.)



Amaris Consulting promotes equal opportunities. We are committed to bringing together people from diverse backgrounds and creating an inclusive work environment. In this regard, we welcome applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of sex, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, beliefs, age, marital status, disability, or other characteristics.

Amaris Consulting is an independent technology consulting firm providing guidance and solutions to businesses. With more than 1,000 clients across the globe, we have been rolling out solutions in major projects for over a decade – this is made possible by an international team of 7,600 people spread across 5 continents and more than 60 countries. Title: Analyst, Data & Analytics
Description:
Permanent Full Time

Canada Life is seeking a highly skilled Data Analyst to join the Insurance Solutions team. As a part of the Performance Management area, this role will be responsible for supporting the data management, analysis, and reporting needs of the department. The Data Analyst supports decision-making, monitors business performance, and provides actionable insights using analytics and visualizations tailored to different audiences.

The role will benefit from collaboration with subject matter experts and data scientists. If you are looking to become a subject matter expert in connected data and help guide the team in improving processes through data mining and analysis, this is the role for you.

Given the size and scope of our organization, we have the flexibility for this position to be located in the following head office locations: Toronto and London.

What You Will Do


Build, implement, and maintain data models, custom reports, and dashboards, keeping in mind the needs of varied audiences
Create visually compelling presentations and use strong communication skills to present them to stakeholders (ability to build a narrative that outlines the background and highlights the impact of initiatives)
Identify opportunities to ingest data, prioritize data needs, and build data marts to drive efficiencies in reporting functions
Leverage data expertise to support new initiatives through analysis and ongoing reporting across the entire analytics lifecycle
Communicate requirements to the Technology team for development and ensure smooth deployment of data projects after performing data quality testing
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and deliver data solutions that meet business needs
Support existing data owners in their data management practices, ensuring a single source of truth
Work with large datasets that may be inconsistent, unclean, or not fully modeled
Ensure best practices are followed with respect to data governance and structure
Communicate effectively while demonstrating critical thinking and business acumen


What You Will Bring


University or College education in a related field of study, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
Experience working with raw data and manipulating large datasets
Proficiency in Excel, Power BI, data modelling, and Databricks, with experience creating interactive dashboards
Ability to work with diverse data inputs and build data marts aligned with business requirements
Proven ability to learn quickly, work independently, and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
Ability to work with little to no documentation or instructions
Strong attention to detail, with the ability to produce high-quality outputs under tight timelines
Driven to continuously improve processes, performance, and efficiency
Knowledge of the organization, distribution channels, products, systems, and data is an asset
Ability to write complex SQL queries to extract and integrate data from multiple sources
Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python or R
Hands-on experience with Azure compute services and a good understanding of Azure Data Factory pipelines
Preferred: Microsoft Certified – Azure Data Analyst Associate (Power BI) certification


The base salary for this position is between $65,800 - $87,700 annually. This represents base salary only and does not represent other variable compensation components of our total compensation ( i.e. annual bonus, commission etc). If you are selected to move forward in our recruitment process, your recruiter will be able to discuss additional details of our total rewards program with you.

Career opportunities will be open a minimum of 5 business days from the date of posting, closing dates will vary depending on the search activity. All applications received will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

Title: BI Engineer
Description:
Who We Are

At OPENLANE we make wholesale easy so our customers can be more successful.

We’re a technology company building the world’s most advanced—and uncomplicated—digital marketplace for used vehicles.

We’re a data company helping customers buy and sell smarter with clear, actionable insights they can understand and use.

And we’re an innovation company accelerating the future of wholesale remarketing through curiosity, collaboration, and an entrepreneurial spirit.

Our Values

Driven Waybuilders. We pursue challenges that inspire us to build, create, and innovate.

Relentless Curiosity. We seek to understand and improve our customers’ experience.

Smart Risk-Taking. We transform risk into progress through data, experience, and intuition.

Fearless Ownership. We deliver what we promise and learn along the way.

We’re Looking For

We are seeking a Business Intelligence Engineer who is solutions-oriented, proactive, and thrives in ambiguity. This individual will not simply respond to requests but will lead initiatives, identify opportunities, and use data to unlock business growth. You will play a key role in maintaining data flow across systems, building scalable data models, and partnering across teams to inform decision-making. The ideal candidate will have 2+ years of experience in Business Intelligence and Data Warehousing, with deep expertise in SQL, data pipelines, visualization tools, and cloud-based data architecture.

You Are


Proactive. You take full ownership of your domain and drive action independently.
Insightful. You generate meaningful, data-driven insights that fuel decision-making.
Collaborative. You work closely with cross-functional stakeholders to solve complex problems and improve processes.
Technical. You have a strong command of data engineering, visualization, and analytical tools.


You Will


Take ownership of the Business Intelligence domain, surfacing insights, solving problems, and driving data-driven decisions
Partner with stakeholders in product, sales, and operations to ensure data quality, availability, and effective usage
Manipulate and transform large datasets using SQL and scripting languages to generate impactful business insights
Design, execute, and analyze A/B tests and other experiments to optimize strategies
Apply data science fundamentals to build predictive models and trend analyses
Develop scalable data models, dashboards, and reports using tools such as Domo
Continuously improve data pipelines, infrastructure, and analytical capabilities
Mentor colleagues to enhance analytics capabilities and foster a data-driven culture


Who You Will Work With

This role reports into the BI Manager and collaborates cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Operations, and Data Engineering teams. You will also work closely with senior leadership to support key strategic initiatives.

Must Have’s


2+ years of experience in Data Warehousing and Business Intelligence
Advanced SQL skills and experience with relational databases (e.g., Snowflake, Redshift, Oracle, SQL Server)
Strong experience in ETL/ELT development and data pipeline management
Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., Python, JavaScript, Java, Scala)
Strong foundation in data modeling, governance, and structuring datasets for long-term use
Expertise in data visualization and dashboarding (Domo preferred)
Advanced spreadsheet skills (Excel, Google Sheets)
Self-starter with strong problem-solving and strategic thinking capabilities


Nice To Have’s


Experience working with DOMO specifically
Understanding of cloud-based data architectures and security best practices
Experience creating and implementing data governance strategies
Background in data science or machine learning application
Familiarity with API integrations and automation techniques


What We Offer


Competitive pay
Medical, dental, and vision benefits with employer HSA contributions (US) and FSA options (US)
Immediately vested 401K (US) or RRSP (Canada) with company match
Paid Vacation, Personal, and Sick Time
Paid maternity and paternity leave (US)
Employer-paid short-term disability, long-term disability, life insurance, and AD&D (US)
Robust Employee Assistance Program
Employer paid Leap into Service Day to volunteer
Tuition Reimbursement for eligible programs
Opportunities to expand your skill set and share your knowledge across a publicly traded, global organization
Company culture of internal promotions, diverse career paths, and meaningful advancement


Sound like a match? Apply Now - We can't wait to hear from you!

Compensation Range Of

Annual Salary: $110,000.00 - $120,000.00 CAD

(Depending on experience, skill set, qualifications, and other relevant factors.)

Choose a workplace that empowers your impact.

Join a global workplace where employees thrive. One that embraces diversity of thought, expertise and passion. A place where you can personalize your employee journey to be — and deliver — your best.

The Analyst, Business Intelligence acts as a business partner to our finance stakeholders, performing data analysis using a wide variety of applications (including Power BI and SQL), and driving automation effort. To succeed in this role, candidates must be able to drive project completion with strong communication and project management, combined with experience in data analytics, big data mining, and data flow and structure. This role will require effective customer service management, with a proven ability to build relationships between the business groups, financial team and IT department, while being able to multitask in a complex environment.

As a Member Of This Team, You Will


Collaborate with management teams to prioritize business, analytics and information needs and understand project requirements
Work with financial and operational data from primary or secondary data sources from different stakeholder teams and business functions
Seek efficiencies in existing processes and execute process improvement initiatives, including exploring and identifying potential new tools and technologies for enhancing reporting automation capabilities
Identify, analyze, interpret, and report on trends or patterns in complex data sets
Exploring large data sets and drawing meaningful conclusions and insights, including identifying critical metrics and KPIs
Filter and “clean” data by reviewing extracts, reports, printouts, and performance indicators to identify, troubleshoot and resolve problems, including data quality, integrity issues and follow data governance policies
Assist with the preparation and development of reporting, presentations and various materials for discussion at the executive level


To Succeed In This Role, You Have


Undergraduate degree in Accounting, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related field.
Have a minimum of 3+ years of demonstrated experience in a similar role (e.g. Data Analyst or BI Data Analyst).
Team oriented individual with strong communication skills, who is comfortable engaging with different groups within the organization (including non-technical audiences).
Thrives in dynamic environments by adapting to evolving requirements and refining approaches as new information emerges, even when processes are not fully defined.
Strong project management and organizational skills and ability to work under pressure and manage high priority projects with multiple or competing deadlines.
Willingness to learn new technologies, including RPA, with a strong inclination to improve processes and not settle for ‘status quo’ to generate efficiencies and improve capabilities.
Experience with Power BI, SQL, and advanced Excel functionality (including Power Query) to develop automation solutions. Experience with other BI Tools and VBA would be an asset.
Technical expertise in data mining and analysis, with an understanding of financial reporting concepts.
Demonstrate strong problem-solving skills and innovative approaches for resolution.

Title: Customer Data Consultant
Description:
Axonify is the AI-Powered Frontline Enablement Platform that helps organizations close the gap between learning and execution. By unifying learning, execution and insights capabilities, Axonify drives real business impacts for the world's largest frontline organizations across retail, grocery, healthcare, and financial services.

More than 4 million employees across 160+ countries rely on Axonify today. It's an exciting time to join as we transform the company and build what's next.

We're a team that thinks deeply, moves with intention, and embraces new ideas. We learn quickly, keep a sharp focus on real-world impact, and take meaningful action to drive progress. And we do it as one team, with openness, creativity, and a shared drive to keep pushing what's possible.

The Role

The Customer Data Consultant is a key member of Axonify's Customer Solutions team, serving as the primary resource for customers looking to unlock the full value of their Axonify data. You'll partner directly with customers to answer complex business questions, lead analytical engagements, deliver executive-ready insights, and build scalable solutions that help customers maximize the impact of their frontline programs.

This role blends customer consulting, data analytics, technical problem solving, and business storytelling. You'll lead everything from custom data requests and Business Value Analyses to enterprise API integration consulting, while helping build the tools, frameworks, and best practices that scale how data is delivered across our customer base.

What You’ll Build

Customer Data Discovery & Custom Data Requests


Partner with customers to understand their business questions and data needs through structured discovery conversations.
Scope, prioritize, and execute Custom Data Requests by translating ambiguous business questions into clear, actionable analytical deliverables.
Own the end-to-end lifecycle of customer data requests, from intake and scoping through delivery and stakeholder presentations.
Build and maintain reusable queries, templates, and frameworks that accelerate delivery across common customer data scenarios.


Business Value Analysis


Lead the Business Value Analysis (BVA) process end-to-end—from data gathering and statistical analysis to executive-ready storytelling that quantifies program ROI.
Connect Axonify program outcomes to measurable business impact, including reduced turnover, improved compliance, and increased sales performance.
Develop scalable Business Value Analysis methodologies and analytical standards that can be consistently applied across the customer portfolio.
Collaborate with Customer Success Managers to identify Business Value Analysis opportunities throughout the customer lifecycle, including onboarding, Quarterly Business Reviews, renewals, and expansions.


In-Life API Solutions & Integrations


Lead the technical onboarding and integration of enterprise customers, guiding them from API discovery through successful production launch.
Serve as the primary technical point of contact for customer development teams, troubleshooting API integrations, authentication issues, and payload mismatches.
Architect customized API solutions that align customer workflows with Axonify's product capabilities while supporting long-term scalability.


Internal Tools & Scalable Data Infrastructure


Design and build internal tools and automations that streamline data workflows, reduce manual effort, and enable scalable delivery of customer insights.
Develop scalable content auditing and data subscription capabilities that ensure consistent, high-quality customer outputs.
Establish best practices and documentation for repeatable customer reporting solutions.
Partner with Product to identify platform capability gaps and influence future productized data solutions.


Cross-Functional Collaboration


Collaborate with Marketing to identify analytics opportunities that strengthen customer campaigns.
Support pre-sales and renewal conversations with data-driven business case materials.
Ensure data initiatives align with customer objectives and Axonify data governance standards.
Mentor Data Analysts by providing technical guidance and sharing best practices in data consulting and analysis.

Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Business Analysis, or a related field.

Title: Pricing Analyst
Description:
Clio is the global leader in legal AI technology, empowering legal professionals and law firms of every size to work smarter, faster, and more securely.

We are transforming the legal experience for all by bettering the lives of legal professionals while increasing access to justice.

Summary:

We are currently seeking a Pricing Analyst to join our Marketing Team in Vancouver, Calgary, or Toronto.

What your team does:

The Monetization team leads Clio’s AI-first pricing and packaging strategy and execution across all regions, including initiatives for new and existing customer segments, products, plans, bundles and cross-portfolio upgrades. This is a highly strategic team contributing to Clio’s success in a highly cross functional role working across nearly all functions at Clio.

Who you are:

You're analytical and curious about customer behaviour, comfortable working through large volumes of data to find the story in the numbers. You like turning ad hoc, manual processes into something repeatable, and you enjoy building partnerships across the business. You're also detail-oriented, organized, and self-managing, with a habit of verifying your own work. You build in checks, flag what looks off, and hold a high bar for accuracy.

What you’ll work on:

As a Pricing Analyst, you'll own the execution and measurement of pricing changes, from account migrations in our billing systems and Salesforce to the modeling, reporting, and testing that tell us whether a change worked.


Own recurring price-based account migrations end to end, from cohort segmentation and batch processing through QA and post-migration validation, and build the formula-driven templates that make them repeatable and auditable at scale
Support the models that price new releases and size the impact of changes on existing customers, and help package the findings into recommendations
Partner with Data & Insights to build the dashboards and automated reporting that track realized vs. list price, discount depth, and ARPA by cohort, so the team catches problems early
Work across Billing Ops, Sales Ops, CS Ops, and Enablement to automate the manual steps in pricing execution and equip Sales and CS when prices change
Help design and run in-market price tests to validate willingness to pay before changes roll out broadly
Use AI tooling to compress the analysis and execution cycle, from generating and QA'ing migration cohorts to automating the handoff into Salesforce and building intuitive internal pricing calculators and price sheets


What you may have:


2+ years in financial or business analysis and modeling, preferably for B2B SaaS, including heavy spreadsheet work with nested logic and QA across large datasets
Hands-on experience in a subscription billing system (Zuora, Stripe, Chargebee, or similar) and a CRM like Salesforce, including bulk updates and data validation across large account sets
2+ years building dashboards and queries in Looker, Tableau, or similar
Experience with pricing analysis across SaaS charge models, such as subscription, usage-based, tiered, and per-seat
Experience running cross-functional projects in Asana or similar, coordinating with ops and GTM teams to keep work moving
Strong communication skills, with the ability to deliver clear status updates, business insights, and recommendations in written, presentation, and spoken form
Experience using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) to support analysis, workflows, and day-to-day productivity


Serious bonus points if you have:


Experience with Workato or similar integration and task-automation tools
Prior experience executing pricing or plan migrations at scale


This role is a backfill for an existing position.

What you will find here:

Compensation is one of the main components of Clio’s Total Rewards Program. We have developed a series of programs and processes to ensure we are creating fair and competitive pay practices that form the foundation of our human and high-performing culture.

Some highlights of our Total Rewards program include:


Competitive, equitable salary with top-tier health benefits, dental, and vision insurance
Hybrid work environment, with expectation for local Clions (Vancouver, Calgary, Toronto, Dublin, London, New York City and Sydney) to be in office min. twice per week.
Flexible time off policy, with an encouraged 20 days off per year.
$2000 annual counseling benefit
RRSP matching and RESP contribution
Clioversary recognition program with special acknowledgement at 3, 5, 7, and 10 years


The expected salary range for this role is $97,300 to $131,700 CAD. Initial placement within the range is informed by geographic region, experience, and skillset, with room to progress as impact and tenure grow. Final offer amounts will vary based on candidate profile.

We believe that different perspectives, skills, backgrounds, and experiences result in higher-performing teams and better innovation.
