Title: Pricing Analyst, Automotive Parts
Description:
Position Summary

The Pricing Analyst is responsible for executing and optimizing SKU-level pricing strategies through detailed analysis, competitive benchmarking, and collaboration with Category and Merchandising teams. This role focuses on translating strategy into actionable pricing decisions, ensuring alignment with margin targets, competitiveness, and financial plans.

What You’ll Do


Lead the development and execution of pricing strategies across various product portfolio’s, based on our category management framework
Support our business partners by identifying performance drivers, actionable insights, and communicating recommendations to drive decision-making through data analytics
Collect, enhance and productionize data that is required to provide data driven price recommendations
Become experts on the products they support and the pricing strategies applicable to their categories
Create and implement integrated CTR pricing strategies based on market intelligence to drive bottom line results
Ensure that pricing and strategies are developed, implemented, measured, and monitored effectively and efficiently through analysis and reporting
Manage operational relationships with the Category Management and cross functional teams to ensure effective coordination, communication and timely execution of price updates
Drive ongoing pricing process improvements from both a tactical and a strategic perspective


What You Bring


University degree or College certificate in business administration, marketing, finance, economics or a related field. Knowledge of Automotive parts an asset.


Communication And Presentation Skills


Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, to effectively collaborate with stakeholders at various levels within the organization
Ability to create compelling slides and presentation decks to convey complex information in a clear and concise manner.
Use communications and presentations to influence without authority to get alignment from Category Management Teams, and other cross functional teams, on key pricing strategy decisions


Collaboration And Leadership


Thrives in a team environment through contributing to a shared team purpose, celebrating team achievements, and maintaining a positive working relationship with other team members (both on direct team and client teams)
Demonstrated leadership skills to provide thought leadership, influence stakeholders, and cultivate relationships with key stakeholders of varied levels, and representing a broad range of functions


Adaptability And Ambiguity Tolerance


Ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced business environment
Comfortable working in an ambiguous environment with rapidly changing priorities.
Ability to adapt quickly to new challenges and display curiosity for continuous learning
Highly organized and detail oriented, able to tackle multiple projects with varying scope


Analytical Skills


Extensive experience gathering and interpreting data
Demonstrated ability to think critically, solve problems, and make informed data-driven decisions
Understanding of product lifecycle, role, profile, elasticity, etc. and the impact of external factors; competitors, vendors, etc.
Proficiency in Excel, data analytics tools such as KNIME and Business Intelligence tools such as Microsoft Power BI, Python, SQL and knowledge of Azure is preferred
Possess an inquiring mind, excellent analytical and complex problem-solving skills


Our typical hiring range is between $53,000.00 and $88,000.00 CAD Annual. The target salary range is between $60,000.00 and $65,000.00 CAD Annual. Salary decisions are also dependent on other factors such as your experience, job-related knowledge, skills and competencies, market location, industry benchmarks, internal equity and other role-specific requirements.

This posting represents an existing vacancy within our organization.

With more than 90 Owned Brands, over 1,600 retail locations, financial services, exemplary e-commerce capabilities, and exciting market-leading merchandising strategies. We dream big and work as one to innovate with purpose for our customers at every level of our business, investing in new technologies and products, and doubling down on top talent to drive the company forward. The Analyst, Business Intelligence acts as a business partner to our finance stakeholders, performing data analysis using a wide variety of applications (including Power BI and SQL), and driving automation effort. To succeed in this role, candidates must be able to drive project completion with strong communication and project management, combined with experience in data analytics, big data mining, and data flow and structure. This role will require effective customer service management, with a proven ability to build relationships between the business groups, financial team and IT department, while being able to multitask in a complex environment.

As a Member Of This Team, You Will


Collaborate with management teams to prioritize business, analytics and information needs and understand project requirements
Work with financial and operational data from primary or secondary data sources from different stakeholder teams and business functions
Seek efficiencies in existing processes and execute process improvement initiatives, including exploring and identifying potential new tools and technologies for enhancing reporting automation capabilities
Identify, analyze, interpret, and report on trends or patterns in complex data sets
Exploring large data sets and drawing meaningful conclusions and insights, including identifying critical metrics and KPIs
Filter and “clean” data by reviewing extracts, reports, printouts, and performance indicators to identify, troubleshoot and resolve problems, including data quality, integrity issues and follow data governance policies
Assist with the preparation and development of reporting, presentations and various materials for discussion at the executive level


To Succeed In This Role, You Have


Undergraduate degree in Accounting, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related field.
Have a minimum of 3+ years of demonstrated experience in a similar role (e.g. Data Analyst or BI Data Analyst).
Team oriented individual with strong communication skills, who is comfortable engaging with different groups within the organization (including non-technical audiences).
Thrives in dynamic environments by adapting to evolving requirements and refining approaches as new information emerges, even when processes are not fully defined.
Strong project management and organizational skills and ability to work under pressure and manage high priority projects with multiple or competing deadlines.
Willingness to learn new technologies, including RPA, with a strong inclination to improve processes and not settle for ‘status quo’ to generate efficiencies and improve capabilities.
Experience with Power BI, SQL, and advanced Excel functionality (including Power Query) to develop automation solutions. Experience with other BI Tools and VBA would be an asset.
Technical expertise in data mining and analysis, with an understanding of financial reporting concepts.
Demonstrate strong problem-solving skills and innovative approaches for resolution.

Title: Data Analyst - Commercial Operations (Hybrid)
Description:
Job Description Summary

We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Data Analyst – Commercial Operations to support data-driven decision-making across our commercial organization. Title: Business Process Data Analyst, OTC***Analyste de données opérationnelles
Description:
We are seeking a dynamic and detail-oriented Business Process Data Analyst to join our team! In this pivotal role, you will harness your analytical expertise and technical skills to optimize business processes through data-driven insights. Your energetic approach will drive continuous improvement initiatives, support project management efforts, and empower decision-makers with actionable intelligence. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment where innovation meets precision, this opportunity is perfect for you to make a meaningful impact!

Business Process Analyst (BPA) is responsible for analyzing, optimizing, and standardizing end-to-end business processes. The role partners with cross-functional teams to identify improvement opportunities, support system integration (ERP/IBP), and enable efficient, scalable ways of working.

The role contributes to process design and transformation initiatives, leveraging business process expertise to support integrated and efficient solutions across the organization. Reporting to the Business Process Owner (BPO), the BPA actively supports defining and delivering the process roadmap for the department and/or function.

The BPA provides the analytical and documentation engine behind the BPO’s process design work. (S)he translates process direction set by the BPO into concrete artefacts (maps, Work Instructions, observation data, and analysis) and supports execution of shadowing, workshops, and continuous improvement activities on the ground.

The BPA does not own process design decisions; that accountability sits with the BPO. The BPA’s value is in rigorous, detail-accurate execution that gives the BPO reliable material to design and decide with.

The BPMO is composed by 6 Business Process Owners (OTC, FTP, PTP, MTD, LOG and RTR) reporting to each department, and multiple Business Process Analysts who reports to BPO.

Compensation: $64,800-$81,000

Key Responsibilities

Business Process Management & Continuous Improvement:


Monitor process blockers and ensure adjustment of corresponding data
Monitor data workflows and troubleshoot process-related issues
Contribute to the design and validation of standardized and optimized processes
Co-develop future-state process with BPO and/or other BPAs aligned with business and system capabilities
Keep the Work Instruction inventory current, flagging gaps or outdated content to BPO
Maintain mapping between Business Processes and underlying Operation processes / work instruction
Responsible to measure process adoption and attrition
Prepare materials for BPO forums, councils and steerco review under BPO direction


Data Governance And Quality


Help to define, develop, and document operational data processes, standards, and best practices
Action and drive completion within the business of data quality controls and standards
Manage the remediation of data audits and validations
Analyze data to identify trends, issues, and improvement opportunities
Responsible for the Operational Master Data quality for the department, support data quality and governance initiatives
Monitor process performance and proactively recommend enhancements


Stakeholder Engagement


Communicate insights and recommendations to support alignment and decision-making
Collaborate with Data Governance, IT BPEs, data analysts, and business units to align data initiatives with organizational goals
Provide training and support on data processes to end users.


Transformation, Change Management & Solution Enablement


Measure deployment readiness and process stabilization activities
Develop documentation and training materials, execute the training plan
Contribute to and support change management and adoption activities
Perform detailed analysis of system behaviors to identify root causes of process breakdowns
Extract, clean and analyze data to support BPO decision-making
Translate business needs into functional requirements
Support BPO and IT during design workshops, testing proposed configurations against designed process flow
Drive testing and validation activities (UAT)


People & Capability


Contribute to role-based “day-in-the-life” training content under BPO guidance
Coach and educate department staff on process and tools usage: floor support, one-on-one troubleshooting, and answering “how do I do this” questions as they arise
Deliver or co-deliver process / tool training session for the end users, reinforcing correct usage and reducing workarounds
Act as day-to-day point of contact for end users struggling with a process step or transaction, feeding recurring issues back into improvement funnel
Build subject-matter familiarity deep enough to eventually support BPO succession or coverage


Finance specific


Act as subject matter expert for finance processes (GL, Fixed Assets, Cost Accounting, Subledger)
Drive alignment of finance processes with ERP and reporting structures
Contribute to optimization of month-end close processes
Ensure alignment of financial data with system design and reporting needs
Support and enhance financial data integrity and reconciliation processes
Collaborate with Finance teams on reporting, forecasting, and compliance requirements
Contribute to finance transformation initiatives (ERP, IBP integration, reporting model changes)
Align business processes with financial data models and system design
Identify opportunities to automate and standardize financial processes


Job Requirements

Education


Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Computer Science, Operations Management, or a related field.


Experience


Experience in data management, documentation or data analysis
Minimum 3 to 5 years of experience in business process analysis, process improvement, or systems-related roles
Experience working with business processes and cross-functional stakeholders
Exposure to system-enabled processes (e.g., ERP or similar enterprise systems)
Experience contributing to process improvement, system implementation, or transformation initiatives


Assets


Experience working with ERP systems (e.g., SAP or equivalent)
Experience with data analysis, reporting, or process performance monitoring


Finance Specific Experience And Assets


Experience across core finance processes (e.g., General Accounting, Fixed Assets, Cost Accounting, Subledger)
Understanding of financial systems and reporting structures (SAP preferred)
Knowledge of financial reporting, controls, reconciliation and data integrity processes
CPA (Chartered Professional Accountant) designation or equivalent
SAP Finance certification (e.g., SAP Certified Application Associate)
Experience with data integration, automation, and process improvement within finance environments


Competencies

Skills


Strong analytical, problem-solving, and process thinking capabilities
Strong attention to detail and accuracy in analysis and reporting, with ability to interpret and manipulate large datasets
Strong communication and influencing skills, leveraging business process knowledge
Continuous improvement mindset with ability to identify and drive process enhancements
Ability to engage stakeholders and facilitate cross-functional alignment
A reputation for being proactive, self-driven and resourceful person that can work well both independently and as part of a team


Assets


Experience working for large corporations or Industrial companies
Robust modelling skills, with the ability to develop complex financial models and perform sensitivity analysis


Finance specific


Solid knowledge of IFRS and its practical application in financial reporting and analysis
Strong understanding of core financial concepts, including profitability, cost structures, and cash flow dynamics


Key Relationships


Collaborates with cross-functional stakeholders across Finance, IT, and other business units to support process alignment and improvements
Engages with stakeholders at various levels, including senior leadership, to gather requirements and communicate process insights
Acts as a key liaison between business teams and IT to ensure alignment between process needs and system capabilities


Working Conditions


Office-based role with extended periods of sitting and computer use.
Occasional exposure to distracting noise in open workspaces.
Mental effort required due to shifting priorities, deadlines, and accuracy demands.


Travel

Employees may need to visit other IPEX locations occasionally

Title: Data Scientist, International
Description:
About the Team

The Analytics team is looking for Data Analysts and Data Scientists to guide measurement, strategy, and tactical decision-making using Advanced Analytics approaches, as we expand our logistics platform across the globe. Data Scientists at DoorDash work to uncover insights and turn them into actionable recommendations, helping drive decisions for the entire organisation. Analytics is very integral to all operational areas at DoorDash.

About the Role

Data Science at DoorDash involves diving deeper into our data to solve crucial business problems, ideate & run experiments to solve for insights gleaned from this deep dive and work with a cross-functional team to drive real-world operational change. It is NOT just about building Machine Learning models and putting them into production. This is a rare operational and actionable data-driven experience.

We solve many exciting challenges from all three sides of our marketplace including customer acquisition, balancing supply and demand, fraud and support, marketing, marketplace efficiency, and more. If you enjoy finding patterns amidst chaos, are excited to build a market from 0 to 1, and have experience using analytics to affect revenue, growth, operations or beyond, we're looking for someone like you!

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…


Be a first-class thought partner to our product, business, finance and executive teams and help them make decisions on what's next for DoorDash
Use quantitative analysis and the presentation of data to see beyond the numbers and understand what drives our business
Build full-cycle analytics experiments, reports, and dashboards using SQL, Python, R, or other scripting and statistical tools
Produce recommendations and use statistical techniques and hypothesis testing and other experimentation techniques to validate your findings
Provide insights to enable our cross-functional team to understand marketplace dynamics, user behaviours, and long-term trends
Identify and measure levers to help move essential metrics and make recommendations
Possess excellent stakeholder management skills, know how to effectively collaborate well with strategy, operations, product, finance and engineering and set priorities
Be excited to travel to meet with business partners and the teams in each market


We're excited about you because…


3+ years of experience in data analytics, consulting, or related role
The insight to take ambiguous problems and solve them in a structured, hypothesis-driven, data-supported way
The determination to initiate and lead/own strategic projects to completion with a cross-functional team
Experience working with experimentation techniques (A/B testing, Causal Inference) and interpreting hypothesis testing
Proficiency in at least one programming language (Python, R,...)
Expertise with SQL queries, ETLs, etc…
Proficiency in one or more analytics & visualization tools
Experience building and training statistical and machine learning models (classifiers, regression models...)

Title: Pricing Analyst/Strategist
Description:
Position Overview

We’re looking for a highly analytical and commercially minded Pricing Specialist to help shape and execute our pricing strategy across Canada and the U.S. This is not a role for someone who simply maintains price lists. We’re looking for someone who is curious about why a product should be priced a certain way, how pricing impacts customer behaviour, margin and revenue, and how different pricing strategies should work across channels and markets.




You’ll work across our ecommerce business, sales channels and internal systems to help ensure our pricing is competitive, commercially sound and designed to maximise revenue and profitability.

This role is ideal for someone who loves data, enjoys solving puzzles and is comfortable moving between strategy and execution. One day you may be analysing competitor pricing and identifying opportunities across thousands of products; the next, you may be digging into ecommerce pricing logic, investigating why a price is displaying incorrectly or helping design a new pricing rule.




Key Responsibilities and How You’ll Make an Impact

Help develop and execute pricing strategy across our Canadian and U.S. businesses
Analyse pricing performance across products, categories, brands, customer segments and sales channels
Identify opportunities to improve revenue, margin, conversion and overall competitiveness
Monitor competitor pricing and market dynamics to understand where we are positioned and where opportunities exist
Develop pricing recommendations based on customer behaviour, competitive data, product economics and business objectives
Explore and refine ecommerce pricing logic, including how prices, promotions, discounts and customer-specific pricing are displayed online
Analyse price elasticity and test new pricing approaches and measure their impact
Work directly within internal systems and pricing tools to implement, test and troubleshoot pricing changes
Investigate pricing discrepancies and determine the root cause across systems, data feeds and ecommerce platforms
Build and maintain pricing rules, guardrails and processes that allow the business to make faster, smarter pricing decisions
Evaluate promotional pricing and discount strategies to understand their impact on revenue and profitability
Partner with Marketing, Sales, Purchasing, Finance, Data, Ecommerce and Technology teams on pricing initiatives
Analyse large datasets to uncover patterns, anomalies and opportunities that may not be immediately obvious
Partner with the Data team on reporting and dashboards that make pricing performance and opportunities easy to understand
Continuously look for opportunities to automate, improve and scale how pricing decisions are made across the organisation




What We’re Looking For

A highly analytical thinker who genuinely enjoys working with numbers and solving complex problems
Someone who is naturally curious and likes asking “Why is this happening?” and “How could we make this better?”
Strong commercial instincts and an understanding of how pricing influences revenue, profitability and customer behaviour
Comfortable working at both the strategic and executional level
Experience with SQL, Python, pricing automation or data visualisation tools is mandatory
Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills; experience working with large datasets is important
Experience with BI, analytics, ERP, ecommerce or pricing platforms is an asset
Strong attention to detail, particularly when working with large product catalogues and complex pricing structures
Ability to take an ambiguous business problem, dig into the data and develop a clear recommendation
Comfortable collaborating across multiple departments and translating analysis into practical business decisions
Experience in ecommerce, distribution, retail, B2B or another high-SKU environment would be particularly valuable




You’ll Love This Role If You...

Love finding patterns in data.
Get satisfaction from figuring out why something doesn’t make sense.
Think of a complicated pricing problem as a puzzle you want to solve.
Enjoy testing hypotheses rather than accepting “that’s how we’ve always done it.”
Can think strategically but are equally comfortable rolling up your sleeves and getting into the system.
And like the idea of having a direct impact on how a growing North American business makes one of its most important commercial decisions: what we charge.

Title: People Analytics & Automation Specialist
Description:
About Opendoor

At Opendoor our mission is to tilt the world in favor of homeowners and those who aim to become one. Homeownership matters. It's how people build wealth, stability, and community. It's how families put down roots, how neighborhoods strengthen, how the future gets built. We're building the modern system of homeownership giving people the freedom to buy and sell on their own terms. We’ve built an end-to-end online experience that has already helped thousands of people and we’re just getting started.

About The Role

Opendoor's People team is scaling how we use data and AI to drive compensation strategy, recruiting operations, and overall HR decision-making. We are looking for a hands-on People Analytics & Automation Specialist to help us bridge the gap between complex data and strategic action.

This role prioritizes hands-on AI capability. We are looking for someone who has built agents and automations. Alongside that, a strong data mindset, the ability to handle confidential projects with high discretion, and a growth orientation. Compensation experience is not required, and we are open to candidates from diverse analytical backgrounds who are eager to learn it.

What You'll Do


AI Agents & Enablement: Design, build, and ship agents and AI-driven workflows for compensation and People Operations. Job evaluation support, offer recommendation modelling, market data analysis, comp cycle preparation.
Dashboards & Reporting: Build and maintain dashboards and reporting for People Operations / Total Rewards (headcount, leveling, compensation analytics) and, where it overlaps, for Talent Acquisition (open requisitions, recruiting funnel and conversion), so leadership has current, trustworthy data ahead of every planning cycle.
Compensation & Leveling: Own the execution side of compensation and leveling projects, comp benchmarking, market studies, leveling structures, and equity or compensation scenario planning, using an established methodology.
Process Automation: Automate recurring People Operations work that currently eats up disproportionate time, equity grant approvals, comp cycle prep, headcount tracking, and other reporting that shouldn't take as long as it does.
TA Analytics Support: Act as a dotted-line analytics partner to Ariana and Talent Acquisition, helping surface insights like compensation-related offer rejections or band placement of recent hires, and supporting the TA team's own data storytelling when priorities overlap.
Systems & Data Quality: Work alongside the Rippling/HRIS administrator to build automations on top of Rippling, and help close data-quality and integration gaps as the team's data infrastructure matures.
Data Storytelling: Translate raw people and compensation data into clear, decision-ready narratives for leadership. This is as much a storytelling role as a data-building one.
Proactive Planning: Get ahead of the calendar by building and testing the automations and dashboards needed for major HR cycles (the upcoming mid-year comp review, annual market study, open enrollment) before they're needed, rather than under pressure.


What You'll Need


You have designed and shipped an AI agent or automated workflow that other people actually use. We will ask you to walk through it in detail: what you built, where you placed human approval gates, what you iterated on, and what broke.
A genuine data mindset and growth orientation. Backgrounds in analytical functions that involve sensitive or complex data are all strong fits.
High discretion and sound judgment. This role regularly touches confidential compensation and people data, and experience managing confidential projects (financial, M&A, or similar) is more important than a specific comp title.
Strong data storytelling and communication skills, able to turn a data set into a clear, persuasive point for an executive audience.
Comfort with Google Sheets (our primary working tool for comp data) and general data/BI fluency; SQL or Snowflake experience is a plus as we build toward more automated data infrastructure, but not required today.
Familiarity with an HRIS (Rippling or similar), comp survey platforms (AON Radford, Mercer, or similar), and equity administration tools (Equity Edge or similar) is a strong plus, not a requirement, and can be learned on the job.
Ability to work independently across two sets of priorities (People Operations/Total Rewards as the primary focus, with lighter-touch support to Talent Acquisition) and to prioritize when demands compete.


Location

This role is based in one of our offices, in-person four days per week. We're looking for candidates who are enthusiastic about an in-office culture; people who want to build alongside their teammates, not from a distance.

Description:
Are you a detail-oriented problem solver who enjoys working with data? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment where no two days look exactly the same? Do you enjoy collaborating across teams on high-impact initiatives? If so, we have an exciting role for you!

McLean & Company is the fastest growing advisory firm in the world. We are looking for an Analyst, Program Delivery to help us grow to the next level and meet the growing demand for our services. In this role, you’ll work with internal teams and external clients to support the delivery and continuous improvement of external client-facing facilitated programs designed for organizations, HR professionals and leaders

Why McLean & Company? McLean is a place where your voice will be heard – a place where you will see the impact of your work with our 30,000+ members. It is a place where you will find community and collaboration, where you will work with diverse individuals with their own unique stories and experiences. McLean is a place where success is celebrated by the whole team – a place where you are encouraged to stretch and grow.

Location: Remote within Canada. Flex of hours may occasionally be required to accommodate clients in other time zones.

Position Purpose

The Analyst, Program Delivery is a key member of the Operations team, working closely with Sales and Program Delivery to collect, analyze and report on data related to McLean programs, including workshops, training and coaching. This role also supports the coordination and delivery of McLean client engagements as needed.

Key Responsibilities

As the Analyst, Program Delivery, you will:


Work across teams to ensure accurate tracking of client entitlements and credits in Salesforce. Analyze usage data to identify trends, uncover opportunities, answer business questions, and drive operational excellence.
Play a key role in understanding the client experience by collecting feedback, managing surveys, identifying themes and surfacing insights to improve program offerings.
Leverage data storytelling and visualization techniques to develop impactful monthly and annual reports in PowerPoint for delivery teams and leadership.
Conduct ad hoc data analysis to uncover insights, support decision-making, and help solve complex business challenges.
Support the calculation of variable compensation for delivery teams including commissions and bonuses.
Represent the business in technology enhancements, dashboard builds and AI projects.
Serve as a trusted resource for Excel, data analysis, reporting, and dashboard troubleshooting.
As needed, support program logistics, including monitoring a shared inbox, assigning resources, preparing statements of work, and coordinating with clients.
As needed, provide in-session support for client engagements, including workshops and training.


Essential


Experience analyzing data and translating insights into clear, actionable reports and recommendations.
Intermediate to advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including data analysis, reporting, and troubleshooting.
Experience working with CRM platforms; Salesforce experience is considered an asset.
Strong client-service mindset with a proven ability to build relationships and collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex information in a clear and actionable way.
Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
Demonstrated problem-solving, critical thinking, and decision-making abilities.
Self-motivated and adaptable, with the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
Proficiency with Microsoft 365, including Outlook, Word, and PowerPoint.
3+ years of relevant work experience in an analytical, operational, or business support role.


Desirable


Salesforce experience
Gainsight experience
Power BI and/or Power Automate experience
Bachelor’s degree in business, analytics, or a related field

About Us

Job Summary

Seeking an experienced Power BI Developer to design, develop, and maintain enterprise-level business intelligence and analytics solutions. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Power BI, ThoughtSpot, Databricks, Azure Cloud, SQL, and Alteryx, with experience transforming complex data into meaningful insights that support business decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain interactive dashboards, reports, and scorecards using Power BI.

Develop self-service analytics solutions leveraging ThoughtSpot for business users.

Build and optimize data pipelines using Azure Data Services and Databricks.

Perform data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL/ELT) activities using Alteryx and SQL.

Create and optimize complex SQL queries, stored procedures, views, and data models.

Collaborate with business stakeholders, data engineers, and analysts to gather reporting and analytics requirements.

Design scalable semantic models and implement best practices for Power BI datasets.

Monitor report performance and optimize dashboard responsiveness.

Ensure data quality, data governance, security, and compliance with banking standards.

Support production deployments, troubleshooting, and enhancements of BI solutions.

Translate business requirements into technical specifications and analytical solutions.

Required Skills & Experience

Technical Skills

Strong experience with Power BI (DAX, Power Query, Data Modeling, Power BI Service).

Experience with ThoughtSpot for search-driven analytics and reporting.

Hands-on experience with Azure Cloud Services, including Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, Azure Storage, and Azure SQL.

Strong proficiency in Databricks, Spark, and data engineering concepts.

Advanced knowledge of SQL for data analysis, reporting, and optimization.

Experience with Alteryx Designer for data preparation, transformation, and workflow automation.

Understanding of ETL/ELT frameworks and data warehousing concepts.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working in the Banking or Financial Services industry.

Knowledge of data governance, data security, and regulatory compliance.

Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies.

Familiarity with enterprise reporting and analytics environments.

Understanding of cloud-based data architectures and big data platforms.

Key Competencies

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.

Ability to work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.

Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality solutions.

Experience Required

5+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, or Data Engineering.

3+ years of hands-on experience in Power BI development.

Experience with Databricks, Azure, SQL, ThoughtSpot, and Alteryx in enterprise environments.

Educational Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Data Analytics, Engineering, or related field.

Relevant certifications in Microsoft Power BI, Azure, Databricks, or Alteryx are preferred.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Location: This hybrid role requires 2-3 days on-site at our Burnaby, BC office.

Welcome to Specsavers – where we’re not just about eyecare and eyewear, but changing lives through better sight. Ranked the 5th Best Workplace™ in Canada and 12th globally by Great Place to Work®, we’re proud of our optometrist-owned model that makes high-quality, eyecare and eyewear accessible to all Canadians.

Founded 40 years ago in the UK by visionary husband and wife optometry duo Doug and Mary Perkins, Specsavers has remained privately owned since day one. Today, we are a $7.8 billion global business with over 45,000 colleagues across more than 2,700 retail optical locations.

In Canada, our support office is based in Burnaby, BC. Since entering the market in 2021, we’ve been scaling rapidly, now with over 270 locations nationwide. With advanced clinical equipment and a wide range of affordable, high-quality eyewear, we’re transforming the way Canadians experience eyecare.

If you’re passionate about making a difference and want to be part of a values-driven organization, join us as we continue to grow. Together, we can change lives through better sight.

What You’ll Do

The Data Analyst delivers Power BI visualizations and dashboards that tell a story using data, drive action, and deliver value to the business. You work within a cross-functional product team, with support from product owners, business analysts, data engineers and data scientists where needed. You will also support the business in the transformation by contributing towards beginners’ sessions, drop-ins, and show-and-tell sessions demonstrating the capability of Power BI and wider visualization best practice.

Key Responsibilities

Deliver


Work with stakeholders and other data team colleagues to understand the data and insights needed to address business questions and challenges
Use visualization techniques to tell data stories, delivering insight to the business in a compelling way
Design and implement analytics reporting dashboards and visualizations using SQL and Power BI
Work with engineers to model, reshape and prepare data to optimize dashboard performance
Collaborate within the wider Data Team and Technology where required for the successful end-to-end delivery of the analytics solution
Work with business end-users to ensure the best user experience
Manage stakeholder expectations on analytical work by providing regular written and verbal communications, building trust, and forming close working relationships


Transform


Be a subject matter expert in visualization and Power BI
Continually improve your own knowledge, including participating in the Specsavers data visualization and storytelling training programme, and other training events
Share your knowledge with less experienced colleagues
Keep up to date on the latest analytics & visualization innovation, share ideas and highlight opportunities to adopt them
Encourage use of data visualization and storytelling in decision making


What We’re Looking For


3-5 years of experience as a Data Analyst across the data lifecycle, from data modelling and transformation to visualization and analytics, leveraging SQL, Power BI, Databricks, and related tools.
Experience manipulating. transforming and cleansing data, and building compelling visualizations, ideally in Power BI
Experience delivering reports, dashboards, or visualization projects in a business context
Intermediate SQL for analytics
Able to convey complex concepts to non-technical audiences in a succinct and accessible way
A collaborative approach to working, with good relationship building skills
Capability in DAX, Power Query or equivalent


Nice-to-have


Experience working with stakeholders to refine requirements and design outputs
Mentoring or coaching experience
Experience in Python or PySpark
Experience working in any capacity in retail or ecommerce, marketing, supply chain, healthcare or other regulated environments such as telco, financial services and utilities.


Compensation: $80,000 - $95,000 base salary, plus quarterly bonus, profit sharing, and benefits. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience

Speccies’ Benefits


4 weeks of vacation and 1 paid volunteer day per year
1 extra paid day off plus an eyecare voucher to celebrate your birthday.
Health and dental benefits, RRSP matching and a Healthcare Spending Account active from your first day.
Mental health and wellbeing support, including $3,000 annually for practitioner care and access to our Employee Assistance Program.
Quarterly bonuses, based on your performance.
Annual Profit Share program to recognize your part in Specsavers’ success.
Free parking, access to the building gym, and a fully stocked kitchen with snacks and coffee/tea.
On‑site wellness offerings in-office, including RMT and yoga sessions.
Team and company social events, including holiday and annual celebrations.


Behaviours We Value


Collaborative: We work together as one Specsavers to deliver on our purpose
Curious: We question, explore, and seek out diverse perspectives to develop our knowledge and understanding
Courageous: We challenge the status quo, we experiment with good ideas, and we are brave, bold, and fast in our decision making
Compassionate: We care, support, and help each other
Commercial: We treat money wisely and make decisions that are good for our customers, our partners, our people and for the long term


We hope that in applying with us, you value these things as well!

Our Hybrid Work Model

Experience the best of both worlds. At Specsavers, we embrace a hybrid approach that balances in-office collaboration with the flexibility to work from home. We come together in office two to three days a week to connect, innovate, and keep our culture thriving.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At Specsavers, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that a diverse team enriches our work environment and enables us to achieve our goals. We are an equal opportunity employer and encourage candidates of all backgrounds and abilities to apply. If you believe you can contribute to our mission and vision, we welcome your application, even if you don't meet every qualification listed. We value the unique skills and perspectives each individual brings to our team.

Accessibility and Accommodations

We are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace. If you require accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know by contacting us at careers.ca@specsavers.com . We will work with you to meet your needs and ensure a fair and equitable experience.

Title: System and Data Analyst
Description:
Description

This position is open until filled. To ensure consideration, applications should be received by Monday, August 24.

Applications must have direct, hands-on experience with Yardi software to be considered.

The Systems and Data Analyst position performs advanced technical work developing and implementing solutions that support the Authority’s business strategy. This position serves as an all-tier support for the agencies Yardi system, including issue documentation, user account and access management, workflow support, and resolution of technical problems. The Analyst will triage, troubleshoot, and resolve software incident; support testing of updates and system changes; and debug reports, queries, and code.

Other Essential Functions Include But Are Not Limited To


Designing, developing, and maintaining operational and management reports, forms, letters, and statistical outputs; ensuring data accuracy through research, validation, and quality control.
Analyze and document business process and system workflows; evaluate system efficiency and ensure compatibility of in-house and SaaS applications.
Manage test environments and coordinate date refreshes.
Create, modify, and maintain SQL queries, scripts, reports, and data imports/exports; monitor system jobs and take corrective action as needed.
Develop and update software applications by converting specifications into code, compiling programs, and resolving errors.
Providing technical support for application and data-related issues; collaborate with IT team members to troubleshoot and resolve software, database, and system problems.
Work with end users to identify, document, and resolve root causes of system or process issues, ensuring timely and effective solutions.
Train end users and technical support staff on system functionality, workflow, and best practices.


Pay And Benefits

In compliance with the Equal Pay & Opportunities Act, the full salary range for the Systems and Data Analyst position is $85,020 to $127,530. We offer a generous contribution toward health care: 100% paid for employees’ only medical and vision coverage, 85% paid for dependent tier coverage. 100% paid for dental. Strong understanding of data administration and management functions, including data collection, analysis, and distribution.
Ability to improve system business processes using recognized process-improvement techniques.
Familiarity with modern database and information-system technologies.
Knowledge of program evaluation and outcome-based assessment methods.
Ability to work effectively with others, participate as a team member, communicate constructively, and navigate conflict professionally.
Skill in analyzing problems, identifying solutions, evaluating alternatives, and implementing recommendations aligned with organizational goals.
Ability to perform highly detailed work accurately and efficiently, organize tasks effectively, and work independently despite frequent interruptions.
Strong project-planning and organizational skills, with the ability to meet schedules and timelines and work with minimal direction.
Proficiency with data-analysis tools and programming languages such as SQL.
Experience with database-management systems.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Effective communication skills to explain complex or technical information to non-technical users.
Knowledge of modern office procedures, methods, and equipment, including computers and common word-processing and spreadsheet applications.


Job Skills

Technical skills


SQL (writing queries, joins, CTWs, optimization)
Microsoft Windows and Windows Server Operating Systems
Microsoft Azure
Cloud Platforms
Microsoft 365 Suite
Online Exchange
Windows Virtual Desktop
SharePoint
Networking and Security
System and Network Configuration
Virtualization
Backup and Disaster Recovery

Regulatory Knowledge
Security Best Practices

Customer Service
Verble and Written Communication

Project Management and Organizational Skills

Bachelor’s degree in a computer-related field, or MIS, or directly relevant experience can be considered in lieu of the required degree.

Title: ICQA Data Analyst
Description:
Description

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. If you'd like to help us build the place to find and buy anything online, this is your chance to make history.

Amazon Canada Fulfillment Services is hiring a Data Analyst to support the Inventory Control / Quality Assurance (ICQA) team. The Data Analyst assigned to ICQA will work closely with the ICQA and operations teams in Inbound and Outbound to provide data and analytical support for ACES initiatives, root cause investigation of defects, and will provide support to ensure compliance to ICQA-related SoX requirements.

The Data Analyst will own the insights, set up analysis, and create automated dashboards and reporting. They will be responsible for identifying data sources (internal / external) to invent and simplify mechanisms and create custom reporting and analytics automation tools.

Operating in a fast-moving and sometimes ambiguous environment, you will be required to work autonomously, taking full control and responsibility for achieving business objectives. This role provides real opportunity to develop original ideas, approaches and solutions in an ever-changing and competitive business climate.

Key job responsibilities


Development of data collection processes and data management systems
Maintenance of data integrity (0% error rate)
Designing of queries, compiling of data, and generation of reports in MS Excel
Charting and graphing of data for reporting purposes
In depth research of defect trends
Data collection and entry as needed
Data mining and problem solving
Back up for Process Assistant duties


Basic Qualifications


2+ years of professional or military experience
Work 40 hours/week, and overtime as required
Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
Are 18 years of age or older
2+ years of business analyst, data analyst or an equivalent role experience
1+ years of using SQL to extract and manipulate data experience
Bachelor's degree, or High school or equivalent diploma
2+ years of professional work experience, or experience in MS Office, with an emphasis on Excel
Experience writing complex Excel VBA macros
Experience in advanced SQL, Python, Tableau
Experience demonstrating problem solving and root cause analysis
Experience with modern software development, web development frameworks, APIs
1+ years of project management experience


Preferred Qualifications


3+ years of business analyst, data analyst or similar role experience
Experience in written and verbal communication skills to communicate with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership
Experience dealing well with ambiguity, prioritizing needs, and delivering measurable results in an agile environment
Experience programming with at least one software programming language, or experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
Knowledge of data warehousing and data modeling
Experience with data scripting languages (e.g., SQL, Python, R, or equivalent) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g., R, SAS, Matlab, or equivalent)
Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Supply Chain or related field.

Description:
Interested in joining one of Canada's top performing asset managers? We are looking for a Data Analyst to join our Enterprise Data Solutions team. In this role, you'll help build integrated, reliable, and scalable data solutions that support business decision-making across the organization. Working with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, Greenhouse, and Dayforce, you'll collaborate with business and technology partners to analyze data, support system integrations, improve data quality, and contribute to impactful enterprise-wide data initiatives. If you're curious, analytical, and enjoy working at the intersection of business, data, and technology, this could be an exciting next step in your career. Our offices operate on a hybrid model with three days per week in-office to support team collaboration.

What You Will Do


Analyze and profile data across enterprise systems to identify trends, issues, and opportunities for improvement.
Partner with business and technology stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into data solutions.
Support the design and development of scalable data models and data structures for reporting, analytics, and integrations.
Collaborate with data engineers and application teams to define and validate data transformation rules.
Test and validate REST APIs, integrations, and data flows between business applications and data platforms.
Perform data quality, reconciliation, and validation activities to ensure accuracy and completeness of information.
Develop and execute test cases for data mappings, APIs, and end-to-end integration processes.
Document data models, mappings, integration requirements, and technical processes.
Participate in Agile delivery activities, including testing, defect resolution, and release validation.
Help identify opportunities to improve data usability, consistency, and operational efficiency across the organization.


What You Bring


3-5 years of experience in data analysis, business systems analysis, data integration, or a related technology role.
Strong SQL skills with experience querying and analyzing relational data.
Experience working with enterprise applications such as Salesforce, Dayforce, Greenhouse, or similar CRM, ATS, HRIS, or SaaS platforms.
Knowledge of relational data modelling concepts and data integration principles.
Experience working with and testing REST APIs, including JSON and API testing tools such as Postman.
Strong experience in data validation, reconciliation, and data quality analysis.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
Ability to document requirements, data mappings, testing activities, and technical processes.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work across technical and non-technical teams.
Familiarity with Agile delivery practices and software development lifecycles.
Experience with Power BI or other reporting and analytics platforms.
Experience with Python or another scripting language.
Exposure to cloud-based data platforms, data warehouses, or modern data technologies.
Experience working with HR, recruiting, CRM, finance, or other enterprise business data.
Financial services or other regulated industry experience.


The starting salary for this position is $110,000 - $130,000. The starting salary provided reflects the base salary for this position as required by legislation. In addition, there is an annual performance bonus which contributes to the total compensation of this position. Further questions may be directed to the HR team during the interview process.

Title: Data Business Analyst
Description:
Location: This is a hybrid role that requires 2-3 days on-site at our Burnaby, BC office.

Welcome to Specsavers – where we’re not just about eyecare and eyewear, but changing lives through better sight. Ranked the 5th Best Workplace™ in Canada and 12th globally by Great Place to Work®, we’re proud of our optometrist-owned model that makes high-quality, eyecare and eyewear accessible to all Canadians.

Founded 40 years ago in the UK by visionary husband and wife optometry duo Doug and Mary Perkins, Specsavers has remained privately owned since day one. Today, we are a $7.8 billion global business with over 45,000 colleagues across more than 2,700 retail optical locations.

In Canada, our support office is based in Burnaby, BC. Since entering the market in 2021, we’ve been scaling rapidly, now with over 270 locations nationwide. With advanced clinical equipment and a wide range of affordable, high-quality eyewear, we’re transforming the way Canadians experience eyecare.

If you’re passionate about making a difference and want to be part of a values-driven organization, join us as we continue to grow. Together, we can change lives through better sight.

What You’ll Do

As a Data Business Analyst, you'll be responsible for eliciting requirements and shaping solutions to business problems across the full reporting lifecycle — from requirements gathering through to delivery of reports and dashboards. You'll work within an Agile framework, acting as the conduit between the business, and our Data Engineers and Visualization Analysts.

Key Responsibilities


Gather and define detailed project requirements from across the Canadian business for data reporting products
Own the end-to-end reporting lifecycle, from requirements gathering, to solution design, build support, user acceptance testing, and deployment
Run workshops, interviews, and prototyping sessions to capture and refine requirements — including situations where requirements are unclear or priorities are shifting
Define and document data mappings, and end-to-end data flows
Support data governance, data quality, and master data management initiatives
Produce Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Specification Documents (FSDs), user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria
Partner with Data Visualization Analysts to support the delivery of Power BI and self-service analytics solutions, ensuring outputs are intuitive, well-documented and accessible to business users
Ensure requirements are complete, consistent, concise, and verifiable — and traceable back to a genuine business need.
Provide input into new products and feature designs so that reporting and analytics needs are considered from the outset, not bolted on afterward

Title: Pricing Analyst
Description:
Clio is the global leader in legal AI technology, empowering legal professionals and law firms of every size to work smarter, faster, and more securely.

We are transforming the legal experience for all by bettering the lives of legal professionals while increasing access to justice.

Summary:

We are currently seeking a Pricing Analyst to join our Marketing Team in Vancouver, Calgary, or Toronto.

What your team does:

The Monetization team leads Clio’s AI-first pricing and packaging strategy and execution across all regions, including initiatives for new and existing customer segments, products, plans, bundles and cross-portfolio upgrades. This is a highly strategic team contributing to Clio’s success in a highly cross functional role working across nearly all functions at Clio.

Who you are:

You're analytical and curious about customer behaviour, comfortable working through large volumes of data to find the story in the numbers. You like turning ad hoc, manual processes into something repeatable, and you enjoy building partnerships across the business. You're also detail-oriented, organized, and self-managing, with a habit of verifying your own work. You build in checks, flag what looks off, and hold a high bar for accuracy.

What you’ll work on:

As a Pricing Analyst, you'll own the execution and measurement of pricing changes, from account migrations in our billing systems and Salesforce to the modeling, reporting, and testing that tell us whether a change worked.


Own recurring price-based account migrations end to end, from cohort segmentation and batch processing through QA and post-migration validation, and build the formula-driven templates that make them repeatable and auditable at scale
Support the models that price new releases and size the impact of changes on existing customers, and help package the findings into recommendations
Partner with Data & Insights to build the dashboards and automated reporting that track realized vs. list price, discount depth, and ARPA by cohort, so the team catches problems early
Work across Billing Ops, Sales Ops, CS Ops, and Enablement to automate the manual steps in pricing execution and equip Sales and CS when prices change
Help design and run in-market price tests to validate willingness to pay before changes roll out broadly
Use AI tooling to compress the analysis and execution cycle, from generating and QA'ing migration cohorts to automating the handoff into Salesforce and building intuitive internal pricing calculators and price sheets


What you may have:


2+ years in financial or business analysis and modeling, preferably for B2B SaaS, including heavy spreadsheet work with nested logic and QA across large datasets
Hands-on experience in a subscription billing system (Zuora, Stripe, Chargebee, or similar) and a CRM like Salesforce, including bulk updates and data validation across large account sets
2+ years building dashboards and queries in Looker, Tableau, or similar
Experience with pricing analysis across SaaS charge models, such as subscription, usage-based, tiered, and per-seat
Experience running cross-functional projects in Asana or similar, coordinating with ops and GTM teams to keep work moving
Strong communication skills, with the ability to deliver clear status updates, business insights, and recommendations in written, presentation, and spoken form
Experience using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) to support analysis, workflows, and day-to-day productivity


Serious bonus points if you have:


Experience with Workato or similar integration and task-automation tools
Prior experience executing pricing or plan migrations at scale


This role is a backfill for an existing position.

What you will find here:

Compensation is one of the main components of Clio’s Total Rewards Program. We have developed a series of programs and processes to ensure we are creating fair and competitive pay practices that form the foundation of our human and high-performing culture.

Some highlights of our Total Rewards program include:


Competitive, equitable salary with top-tier health benefits, dental, and vision insurance
Hybrid work environment, with expectation for local Clions (Vancouver, Calgary, Toronto, Dublin, London, New York City and Sydney) to be in office min. twice per week.
Flexible time off policy, with an encouraged 20 days off per year.
$2000 annual counseling benefit
RRSP matching and RESP contribution
Clioversary recognition program with special acknowledgement at 3, 5, 7, and 10 years


The expected salary range for this role is $97,300 to $131,700 CAD. Initial placement within the range is informed by geographic region, experience, and skillset, with room to progress as impact and tenure grow. Final offer amounts will vary based on candidate profile.

Diversity, Inclusion, Belonging and Equity (DIBE) & Accessibility

Our team shows up as their authentic selves, and are united by our mission. We are dedicated to diversity, equity and inclusion. We pride ourselves in building and fostering an environment where our teams feel included, valued, and enabled to do the best work of their careers, wherever they choose to log in from. We believe that different perspectives, skills, backgrounds, and experiences result in higher-performing teams and better innovation. We are committed to equal employment and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

Clio provides accessibility accommodations during the recruitment process. Should you require any accommodation, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

Learn more about our culture at clio.com/careers

We're a Human and High Performing AI company, meaning we use artificial intelligence to improve all of our operations. In recruitment, AI helps us streamline the process for greater efficiency. However, we've built our systems to ensure that a human always reviews AI-generated output, and we never make automated hiring decisions.

Disclaimer: We only communicate with candidates through official @clio.com email addresses.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
At Kabam, we’re constantly raising the bar of excellence in free-to-play gaming. We hire for passion and diversity so that we can triumph in our collective skill. Our teams are made up of a fusion of personalities and interests bound together by a collaborative nature, fun-loving culture, and a drive to do what it takes to make great games. And this is where you come in…

The Data Analyst utilizes their quantitative analytical skills and scientific thought process to interpret and

analyze large sets of complex data, while extracting meaningful insights for Kabam. This role works

closely with our internal gaming team to optimize every facet of player retention and monetization to

ensure the continued success of our games.

This role is a full-time, on-site position based 5 days a week at our Downtown Vancouver studio.

Provide Cross-functional Support

In this role, you can expect to:


Collaborate with various teams across the organization to understand their business goals and data needs.
Improve reporting processes by identifying inefficiencies and suggesting enhancements.
Assist with larger-scale projects as required, contributing data-driven insights.


Data Exploration And Analysis


Use SQL to extract and manipulate data from various sources.
Perform hands-on exploration of data sets to answer business questions.
Utilize statistical analysis to identify trends, correlations, and patterns within the data.
Create data visualizations to communicate findings effectively.


Dashboard And Report Management


Develop and maintain a suite of dashboards and reports tailored to the needs of different teams within the organization.
Ensure that dashboards and reports are up-to-date and accurate.
Prepare ad-hoc reports as requested.


A/B Testing


Design, execute, and manage multiple A/B tests to gain insights into key performance indicators (KPIs) such as retention, acquisition, and monetization.
Analyze the results of A/B tests to draw actionable conclusions.
Make data-driven recommendations for optimizing business strategies based on results of A/B testing.


Product Feature Analysis And Optimization


Measure the success of newly released product features using key metrics and data analysis.
Drive data-driven iteration and optimization of product features to enhance performance and user experience.


Task Prioritization And Project Management


Assist in task prioritization within the data team based on business needs and project requirements.
Collaborate with team members to achieve project goals efficiently.


To Be Successful In This Role, Your Background Includes


Bachelor’s Degree in related field.
3+ years of industry data analysis experience, with solid knowledge of statistical methods.
1+ years of industry data experience in games (mobile, console, PC), online casino, slot games, or any high volume B2C mobile apps.
Expert SQL skills and experience querying very large data sets.
Proven ability to thrive using multiple mixed, varied, and inconsistent data sources.
Fundamental knowledge of project management methodologies.
Regular communication with stakeholders from other departments and drive actionable items for continuous improvement.
Experience with Google BigQuery, Tableau, JIRA and/or other project management software.
Experience working for a social or mobile game developer.
Understanding of game design concepts and principles.


Benefits

Our success is due to the hard work of our people. We share our success with our people through flexible benefits and reward programs, sweet swag, snacks, and more. Here’s a look at some of the support we provide our people:


Extended Health Coverage: effective day one, no waiting period! Our benefits cover health, dental, life, disability, and extended paramedical services such as vision care, mental health practitioners, massage, physiotherapy, acupuncture, and much more.
DEIB Benefits: DEIB is important to us and to our people - that’s why our benefits include gender-affirming care, fertility care, and other hormonal treatments and drugs.
Flexible Spending Accounts: our benefits are built on a flex credit model, so you’re able to choose the coverage levels that are right for you, and allocate the rest to a group RRSP/TFSA, Health Spending account, and/or Personal Spending Account.
RRSP Matching: everyone retires eventually, and we help our people save for their futures with a contribution matching program once you reach 90 days with us.
Commuter Benefit: we believe in the power of in-person collaboration, and want to support you in making it work for you! We provide a flexible, monthly cash allowance to help cover the costs of transit, parking, or even personal logistics like childcare and pet care.
PTO and Parental Leave: we offer paid parental leave, flexible paid time off, paid time off for volunteering, sick leave, and holiday closures.
Employee and Family Assistance Program: this program provides crisis management support, immediate mental health care, and generalized support for emotional, mental, and financial well-being.
Telus Virtual Health: we provide increased access to remote healthcare providers for prescription refills or referrals from the comfort of your home.
Learning and growth: We encourage people to grow both personally and professionally, and support this through regular lunch & learns and an education stipend.
Pay transparency: We share with employees the pay range their role falls within and clear career maps to determine how they can grow within their role or level-up to a promotion.
Cool spaces: Our offices are in Vancouver, Montreal, Los Angeles, and San Francisco. Whether it’s summers on the rooftop patio in Downtown Vancouver, or watching the fireworks in Montreal’s South Shore - we want our people to feel like their time spent in office is worthwhile!
Giving back: Kabammers have a dedicated paid day off every year to volunteer to a cause close to their hearts. Some teams even band together for group volunteer days off-site!


$73,300 - $91,600 a year

The typical hiring range listed above is specific to candidates located in Vancouver. The salary will be determined based on your knowledge, skills and competencies, and you’ll have room to grow after you join!

If you’re interested in the position but your expectations don’t fully align with the provided range, we still encourage you to apply! Considerations may be made based on your experience level.

"Cascade Aerospace is one of Canada's leading specialty aerospace and defence contractors - a place where we do cool things for great customers!" We invite you to consider a career with us - come, experience our creative, innovative, and performance-based company!

Job Description

Financial Data Analyst supports financial planning, reporting, costing, and business decision-making through advanced data analysis and financial modeling. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Excel, Power BI, and database querying tools, combined with a solid foundation in accounting and ERP systems. This role will transform complex financial data into actionable insights that drive operational and financial performance.

CPA designation is not required. Candidates with strong analytical, financial modeling, and business intelligence skills are encouraged to apply.

This position requires immediate Controlled Goods clearance, therefore, only Canadian Citizens or Permanent Residents will be considered at this time.

Major Responsibilities & Duties

Financial Analysis & Reporting


Analyze large volumes of financial and operational data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
Develop and maintain recurring financial reports, dashboards, and KPIs.
Support budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis processes.
Provide actionable recommendations to management based on financial and business performance.


Financial Modeling


Build, maintain, and enhance financial models for budgeting, forecasting, scenario analysis, and strategic decision-making.
Develop profitability, pricing, and cost allocation models.
Perform sensitivity and trend analyses to support business initiatives and investments.


Business Intelligence & Data Analytics


Design and maintain interactive dashboards and reports using Power BI.
Extract, transform, and analyze data using SQL, Power Query, and other query tools.
Improve data quality, reporting accuracy, and automation across finance processes.
Collaborate with business stakeholders to define reporting requirements and data solutions.


Costing & ERP Systems


Support product costing, operational costing, and margin analysis initiatives.
Analyze manufacturing, distribution, or operational costs to identify efficiency opportunities.
Maintain and validate financial data within ERP systems.
Partner with operations, supply chain, and accounting teams to improve cost visibility and reporting.


Accounting & Financial Controls


Apply general accounting principles to ensure accuracy and consistency in reporting.
Support month-end and year-end financial reporting activities.
Assist with account reconciliations, financial audits, and internal controls as required.
Ensure data integrity between ERP systems and reporting platforms.


Core Skills


Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including: PivotTables, Power Query, Advanced formulas and functions, and Financial modeling
Strong proficiency in Power BI dashboard development and data visualization.
Experience writing and optimizing SQL queries and working with relational databases.
Strong understanding of data management, reporting automation, and analytics best practices.
Familiarity with ERP reporting tools and financial data structures.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent attention to detail and data accuracy.
Ability to translate complex financial data into clear business insights.
Effective communication and presentation skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.


Education


University degree in Business, Accounting or equivalent
CPA designation is not required.


Experience


3–7 years of experience in financial analysis, business analysis, data analytics, or related finance roles.
Experience building robust financial models and conducting financial analysis.
Experience working with ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, NetSuite, JD Edwards, or similar).
Experience with costing and general accounting practices.
Experience in manufacturing, distribution, supply chain, or operational finance environments.
Knowledge of data warehousing concepts and business intelligence tools.
Experience with advanced analytics, forecasting, and scenario planning.
Understanding of cost accounting methodologies and profitability analysis.


Reasons To Apply


Employee retention and engagement is important to Cascade; we value our employees.
Comprehensive benefits package provided. Extended benefits and the Employee Resilience Program (all 100% paid by Cascade) are offered after 3 months of employment and Pension matching after 6 months.
ATO (Approved Training Organization) provides endorsement (type) training & development.
Company-wide social events and family functions throughout the year.
Relocation Package available for qualifying candidates.


About Cascade

Cascade Aerospace Inc. is a dynamic, privately-held Canadian specialty aerospace and defence contractor focused on providing long-term integrated aircraft support programs for Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs), military, government and commercial customers.

All employees are encouraged to realize their true potential and play an active role in fostering an environment of safety, quality, customer satisfaction and continuous improvement. We are a diverse organization that strives to be respectful and inclusive of everyone and to treat employees fairly and equally.

At Cascade Aerospace we strongly believe in the value of teaming - with our employees, our customers, our suppliers, and our communities. It is by "Teaming with the best" and working collaboratively with our many partners that we are able to offer custom-tailored solutions for each customer's unique requirements. Our value proposition is that we build enduring customer relationships, and our strategic focus is customer satisfaction. It is a driver in all our decisions.

Cascade Aerospace is committed to the principle of Employment Equity. Creating an environment where diverse perspectives are valued begins with self-declaration. Count yourself in and self-declare by identifying which employment equity group(s) you belong to. In order to self-declare, please ensure to indicate this in your application, cover letter, or resume.
